chapters.title: Chapter 2551 Madam Mei
paragraphs: "Take your time, Officer Mei's mother," Yuan said.
"Just call me Madam," she said before walking outside with Officer Mei.
Once he was alone, Yuan sat on the cold floor and recalled his sparring with Officer Mei.
'Although she was very powerful... her combat experience was clearly lacking. If I didn't go easy on her, I would've defeated her with ease,' he thought to himself.

This meant that, despite having a high level of cultivation, the people of this world likely lacked combat experience. Moreover, being a police officer, Officer Mei's combat capabilities should logically be higher than those of the average person.
'How did they achieve such high cultivations? The people of this world do not appear to be immortals who have lived for countless years, either.'

Yuan could not fathom how even children could reach the Cultivation God Realm—a level that normally required tens of millions of years to attain, not including the majority who are not even capable of achieving it in the first place.
Meanwhile, outside the training room, Madam Mei and Officer Mei spoke.
"What do you want to talk about?" Officer Mei asked.
"Tell me your reason for dragging me into this mess," Madam Mei spoke with a slight frown on her face. "Is this your 'revenge'?"
"I don't know what you're talking about," she responded with a nonchalant expression.
"Do you really think I am stupid? I know you hate me for neglecting you as a child, but this situation is beyond your imagination."
"This has nothing to do with our relationship. I saw a troubled and confused individual needing help, so I reached out to the only person who could help him," Officer Mei calmly replied.
Madam Mei fell silent for a moment before asking in a low voice, almost as if she was afraid of being heard, "Does he really have the Perfected Heavenly Refinement?"
"That's what the machine said... twice."
Madam Mei rubbed her eyes in a stressed manner and released a deep sigh.
"If the world learns of his physique... I don't even want to imagine what might happen."
"Is it really that big of a deal? I mean, at the end of the day, it's just a physique.
"It is not just any physique. It is the pinnacle of humanity—or at least, that is what the experts claim. As humans, we naturally strive for perfection."
She paused, her expression turning slightly grim. "Moreover, we need a breakthrough soon, as we are beginning to struggle with... Forget it. This isn't something I should mention to a civilian."
"Regardless, what do you expect me to do in this situation?"
"Well, what can you do? Knowing your credentials, I wouldn't be surprised if you could enlist him in the military directly."
"Even if I can do that, why should I do it for him? He is nobody to me," Madam Mei sneered.
"Didn't you just say that his existence is extremely important? You even implied that he could have a significant impact on our society. If you let someone like that slip away..."
"..." Madam Mei fell silent again.
Then, without saying a word, Madam Mei turned around and walked back into the training room.
"Before we begin your assessment, I have a few questions for you," Madam Mei said as she approached Yuan.
"Why do you want to join the military?"
"I need to increase my credentials," he replied without hesitation.
Madam Mei raised an eyebrow at his answer.
"Just to increase your Credential Rank? There are others ways to do so without signing away your life, you know?"
"Well, I need to reach Rank 9 credentials if I want to cure the curses within me," he calmly said, revealing the truth.
Madam Mei's eyes widened with shock.

"You're cursed? And it's so powerful that you need Rank 9 credentials?" Madam Mei was speechless, and even though she wanted to doubt him, there were no signs of deception in Yuan's crystal-clear eyes.
After a moment of silence, Madam Mei sighed.
"Quite frankly, your reason for wanting to join the military doesn't matter in the slightest, and I have heard far worse. However, in your current state, forget about joining. You won't even qualify.
"Is it my cultivation and Credential Rank?" Yuan asked.

"Yes. Although I can help you with your credentials, you will need to reach Third Ascension before you can qualify. However, there is something I am puzzled about. If you truly have the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique, why is your cultivation so low?"
"Because where I am from, my cultivation is pretty decent," Yuan said.
"Right... but you're in our world now, so your cultivation should have soared even without needing you to do anything."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at her words and asked, "What do you mean? In fact, how do the people of this world even cultivate?"
"We cultivate through the system."
"Huh?" Yuan's face became even more puzzled after hearing her answer.
How does one cultivate through the system?
"Like this," said Madam Mei, and the aura around her suddenly began to shift.
Although Yuan couldn't sense any energy before, the moment Madam Mei started cultivating, he could clearly sense Eternal Essence exuding from her body!
"What?!" Yuan was so shocked to see another human directly emitting Eternal Essence that he cried out loud.
He had always believed that humans were incapable of absorbing Eternal Essence—that only Eternals possessed such an ability.
Yet right before his eyes, that common sense was being shattered.

However, something felt off. After examining her more closely, Yuan realized what felt odd. Although he could sense Eternal Essence within Madam Mei's body, it did not seem as though she was actively absorbing it. Instead, it was as if the Eternal Essence was being created from within her body.
"W-What am I looking at right now?" Yuan asked, unable to comprehend their cultivation method even after witnessing it firsthand.
"Our cultivation method," Madam Mei replied calmly, as though she did not even need to focus in order to cultivate.

chapters.title: Chapter 2552 Gaia's Stone
paragraphs: "I'm sorry, but I still do not understand how you are cultivating," Yuan said after a moment of silence. "Where are you obtaining your energy from? It does not seem like you are absorbing it."
"Absorbing it? Like this?"
The next moment, Madam Mei began drawing in the energy from the air in the traditional manner Yuan was familiar with.
Yuan narrowed his eyes as he quickly noticed something peculiar. When Madam Mei began cultivating in the traditional manner, he had expected her to absorb Eternal Essence.
But to his surprise, she was drawing in spiritual energy instead.
Before Yuan could question her further, Madam Mei stopped cultivating and spoke.
"Although it is possible to cultivate in that manner, it is extremely inefficient. That is why nobody does it. Instead, we cultivate through the system."
"You have the system, right?" she then asked.
Yuan nodded.
"Then why not use it to cultivate and see for yourself how it works? It should help you understand things more easily," she said.
"How do I cultivate through the system? I just acquired it today," he admitted.
Madam Mei fell silent after hearing this for the first time, and she turned to look at Officer Mei with narrowed eyes.
"I do not mind helping you, but I am not someone who acts without gaining something in return," Madam Mei said, shifting her attention back to Yuan a moment later.
She continued without pausing, "Not only will I help you join the military, but I will train you as well. In return, once you are accepted, you must join the division of my choosing."
Yuan responded without hesitation, "I do not simply want to join the military. I want to take the path that will improve my credentials the fastest."
"That is even better. The division I want you to join offers the fastest promotions in the entire military, which means your credentials will rise faster as well," she said with a proud smile.
"Then I agree to your offer."
The next moment, a notification appeared before Yuan.
<You have been offered to sign a contract by 'Mei Feng'>
[Contract Details: Mei Feng promises to help you join the military. Upon enlistment, you must join a division of her choosing.]
[Breaking the contract will result in penalties]
<Do you accept the contract?>
<Accepted>
"Alright, let's get started," Mei Feng said shortly after confirming that Yuan had accepted her contract.
"In order to cultivate through the system, you must first consume this."
Mei Feng extended her empty hand toward Yuan before slowly closing it into a fist.
A second later, she opened her hand again, revealing a crystal resting in her palm as though it had appeared from thin air.
"T-This is?!" Yuan's eyes widened with disbelief when he saw the crystal, as he recognized it.
"Gaia's Stone," Mei Feng began to explain. "In order to cultivate through the system, one must first connect their Dantian to the system."
Despite Mei Feng mentioning an unfamiliar name, the crystal in her grasp was, without a doubt, the Heaven Refining Crystal, which had granted him the Heaven Refining Physique in the first place!
"To be frank... I have consumed a crystal like this before in my world," Yuan admitted with a weird expression on his face. "In fact, it was what gave me the Heavenly Refinement physique."
Mei Feng raised her eyebrows. After a moment of silence, she responded to his words.
"Gaia's Stone has two functions. First, it connects one's Dantian to the system. The second... only activates under certain conditions—when an individual is born with their physique sealed."

"Most people are born with the Heavenly Refinement physique, but on rare occasions, some are born without it. However, that does not mean they truly lack it, as their physique are simply in a dormant state."
"That said, the majority awaken naturally over time. Only an extremely small minority requires Gaia's Stone to awaken their physique."
Yuan's eyes widened after learning the true origin of the Heaven Refining Crystal. He had always assumed it was either a treasure left behind by an Eternal or a naturally formed treasure.
However, this only raised another question.
'How did it end up in my world?' he wondered. "Also, this proves that there is a connection between the Nine Heavens and this strange world.'
Then he realized something else.
'Wait a second. Does this mean I always had the Heaven Refining Physique even as Tian Yang, and that it had been dormant until I consumed Gaia's Stone, which awakened it?'
Yuan stared at the crystal resting in Mei Feng's grasp for a moment before reaching for it.
However, just as he was about to reach it, she suddenly closed her hands and said, "Before you consume it, I want you to try cultivating through the system first, so you know what I mean."
"How do I do that?"
"Tell the system you want to start cultivating.
Yuan nodded and followed her instructions, mumbling, "System, start cultivation."
Ding!
<Error>
<Unsuitable Dantian Detected>
<Cultivation has been forcefully canceled for the user's safety>
"Well?" Mei Feng asked a moment later.
"It doesn't work," Yuan replied while shaking his head. "It says I have an unsuitable Dantian."
Mei Feng opened her palm and offered Gaia's Stone to him again.
"Try again after consuming this."
Yuan accepted the crystal, tossed it into his mouth, and swallowed it without hesitation.
<You have consumed Gaia's Stone>
<Perfected Heavenly Refinement has activated>
<Gaia's Stone has been refined>
<Gaia's Stone has merged with your Dantian>
<Your Dantian has begun to evolve>
<Your Dantian has evolved into True Heaven's Dantian>
<You have unlocked Gaia's Cultivation System>
"How do you feel?" Mei Feng asked shortly later.
"Quite frankly, I don't feel much different..." Yuan replied.
"Then try cultivating through the system again."
Without wasting a moment, Yuan immediately began his second attempt to cultivate through the system.
"System, start cultivation."
<You have begun cultivating through Gaia's Cultivation System>
<Due to your low cultivation and low Credential Rank, your Cultivation Speed has been automatically adjusted to Level 1>

chapters.title: Chapter 2553 Gaia's Cultivation System
paragraphs: <Gaia's Cultivation System has absorbed Eternal Essence>
<Gaia's Cultivation System has refined Eternal Essence into Limitless>
<You have absorbed Limitless>
'Limitless...?' Yuan raised an eyebrow at the notifications.

When Gaia's Cultivation System started working, he could feel Eternal Essence being gathered around his Dantian. However, it did not enter his Dantian until the Eternal Essence was refined into another energy that felt similar on the surface.
'This Limitless... It feels almost identical to Eternal Essence, yet there is something fundamentally different about it,' Yuan thought as he examined the strange energy.

However, because Limitless was so similar to Eternal Essence, Yuan could not determine how it differed without using it himself. And since he had only just begun cultivating, he did not possess enough of it to do so.
There was another thing Yuan quickly noticed.
His cultivation speed was extraordinarily slow—at least by his standards.
At first, Yuan found it strange. However, after giving it some thought, he realized that it made perfect sense.
After all, he was not cultivating in the traditional manner, but through Gaia's Cultivation System, which possessed an entirely separate cultivation speed.
"How long will it take me to reach this Third Ascension level?" Yuan asked Mei Feng a moment later.
"At your current speed? About twenty to thirty years," she calmly replied.
"At least twenty years? That's too long..." Yuan frowned.

"If you cultivate purely using Gaia's Cultivation System, it's normal. Not to mention, your Credential Rank is only at Rank 1. Of course, there are methods to improve your cultivation speed, the most obvious being to increase your Credential Rank."
"What other methods are there?" Yuan inquired.
Mei Feng retrieved another object and showed it to Yuan.
"Gaia's Stone? No... It's a little different," Yuan mumbled after seeing the crystal-like object on her palms that resembled Gaia's Stone at a glance.
"This is called Gaia's Gift. If you consume it, your cultivation speed will directly increase by a single rank. It's useful up to Rank 3."
'There are also levels to my cultivation speed?' Yuan raised an eyebrow.
He quickly checked his status, and sure enough, something new was present.
[Name: Yuan]
[Cultivation: Third Level First Ascension]
[Physique: Perfected Heavenly Refinement]
[Credential Rank: 1]
[Cultivation Speed: 1]
Yuan then asked, "I have been meaning to ask this for a while now, but who is Gaia?"
Mei Feng shook her head. "I do not know. I doubt anyone alive knows, either."
"I thought they were the God of this world or something along that line."
"God?" Mei Feng suddenly sneered in disdain. "There is no such thing."
Yuan decided not to question further after seeing her reaction.
"Anyway, take it. It'll improve your cultivation a little."
After accepting Gaia's Gift, Yuan immediately consumed it.
<You have consumed Gaia's Gift>
<Your Cultivation Speed has increased by 1>
The moment his cultivation speed increased by a level, Yuan could feel the system absorbing Eternal Essence and refining it into Limitless at least three times faster than before.
Ding!
<Your cultivation has reached Fourth Level First Ascension>
"You should reach the Third Ascension within five years at this rate," Mei Feng said.
Before Yuan could even say anything, she continued, "However, that is still too slow, as the next recruitment for the military will begin in half a year."
"I'll give you another Gaia's Gift later since I don't have it on hand right now. In the meantime, I want you to improve your Credential Rank."
Mei Feng suddenly handed Yuan a semi-transparent card.
"This will help you get started."
<You have received Mei Feng's Endorsement>
<Your Credential Rank has increased a level>
Yuan's Credential Rank directly increased a level.
"Moreover, as long as you have this, you will be able to gain credentials at an accelerated rate—up to Rank 5 once you join the military," Mei Feng added.

"I left my post unannounced, so I cannot stay here any longer. If you have any questions, you can ask my daughter. I will come back in a month with your second Gaia's Gift. Until then, keep working on your Credential Rank."
"Thank you for everything so far," Yuan said to her.
"I am not doing this for you," she calmly rejected his gratitude before turning around and walking to the exit.
"I'll leave him in your care for now," Mei Feng said to Officer Mei, who was standing by the door with a stunned look on her face.
"W-Wait! Why do I have to—"
"Because you found him," Mei Feng interrupted. "Also, I should not have to say this, but make sure his physique remains a secret."
Officer Mei wanted to object, but knowing her mother, she also knew that doing so would not end well for her. Moreover, it was true that she willingly got involved with Yuan.
Once Mei Feng left, Officer Mei approached Yuan and sighed. "Do you have any idea how lucky you are?"
"Not really," Yuan admitted. "Care to enlighten me?"

"First of all, the Gaia's Stone you consumed is incredibly precious and expensive. Not even I—her own daughter—have ever used one, yet she gave one to you so easily. Hell, she even plans on giving you a second one later on!"

"Then, there's her endorsement, which is arguably even a bigger deal, as that is something you only give to someone you absolutely trust. After all, if you do something bad, it'd affect her, too, and considering her status... forget it."
"In any case, if word got out about how well you have been treated here, countless people would be jealous—myself included," she sighed.
"Is that so?" Yuan calmly muttered before asking, "So, how should I go about increasing my credentials now?"
"Get a job," Officer Mei said flatly, her expression completely serious.
"Get... a job?" Yuan mumbled with a dazed expression, as though he had just heard a foreign language.
Although he had technically worked as a professional musician when he was younger, he had never truly considered it a job, especially considering how long ago it had been.

I doubt anyone alive knows, either."
"I thought they were the God of this world or something along that line."
"God?" Mei Feng suddenly sneered in disdain.
"There is no such thing."
Yuan decided not to question further after seeing her reaction.
"Anyway, take it.
It'll improve your cultivation a little."
After accepting Gaia's Gift, Yuan immediately consumed it.
<You have consumed Gaia's Gift>
<Your Cultivation Speed has increased by 1>
The moment his cultivation speed increased by a level, Yuan could feel the system absorbing Eternal Essence and refining it into Limitless at least three times faster than before.
Ding!
<Your cultivation has reached Fourth Level First Ascension>
"You should reach the Third Ascension within five years at this rate," Mei Feng said.
Before Yuan could even say anything, she continued, "However, that is still too slow, as the next recruitment for the military will begin in half a year."
"I'll give you another Gaia's Gift later since I don't have it on hand right now.
In the meantime, I want you to improve your Credential Rank."
Mei Feng suddenly handed Yuan a semi-transparent card.
"This will help you get started."
<You have received Mei Feng's Endorsement>
<Your Credential Rank has increased a level>
Yuan's Credential Rank directly increased a level.
"Moreover, as long as you have this, you will be able to gain credentials at an accelerated rate—up to Rank 5 once you join the military," Mei Feng added.
"I left my post unannounced, so I cannot stay here any longer.
If you have any questions, you can ask my daughter.
I will come back in a month with your second Gaia's Gift.
Until then, keep working on your Credential Rank."
"Thank you for everything so far," Yuan said to her.
"I am not doing this for you," she calmly rejected his gratitude before turning around and walking to the exit.
"I'll leave him in your care for now," Mei Feng said to Officer Mei, who was standing by the door with a stunned look on her face.
"W-Wait!
Why do I have to—"
"Because you found him," Mei Feng interrupted.
"Also, I should not have to say this, but make sure his physique remains a secret."
Officer Mei wanted to object, but knowing her mother, she also knew that doing so would not end well for her.
Moreover, it was true that she willingly got involved with Yuan.
Once Mei Feng left, Officer Mei approached Yuan and sighed.
"Do you have any idea how lucky you are?"
"Not really," Yuan admitted.
"Care to enlighten me?"
"First of all, the Gaia's Stone you consumed is incredibly precious and expensive.
Not even I—her own daughter—have ever used one, yet she gave one to you so easily.
Hell, she even plans on giving you a second one later on!"
"Then, there's her endorsement, which is arguably even a bigger deal, as that is something you only give to someone you absolutely trust.
After all, if you do something bad, it'd affect her, too, and considering her status... forget it."
"In any case, if word got out about how well you have been treated here, countless people would be jealous—myself included," she sighed.
"Is that so?" Yuan calmly muttered before asking, "So, how should I go about increasing my credentials now?"
"Get a job," Officer Mei said flatly, her expression completely serious.
"Get... a job?" Yuan mumbled with a dazed expression, as though he had just heard a foreign language.
Although he had technically worked as a professional musician when he was younger, he had never truly considered it a job, especially considering how long ago it had been.

chapters.title: Chapter 2554 Getting a Job
paragraphs: "What's with that reaction? Have you never worked before?" Officer Mei asked with her eyebrows raised.
"Even if you tell me to find a job, I don't know what to do. Any recommendations?" Yuan sighed.
Officer Mei pondered for a moment before responding, "If you want to increase your credentials as fast as possible, then you will want a job like mine."
"You... want me to become an officer like you?"

"Of course not. You don't even qualify in the first place," she quickly denied. "However, with my mother's Endorsement, you should be able to work as an assistant with ease. If you work as my assistant, I can keep an eye on you. As much as I dislike my mother, I don't want you to destroy her reputation."
"Working as your assistant, huh? Why not? It's not like I have anything else in mind," Yuan quickly agreed with her idea.
"In that case, let's head to the station now."
They left the villa shortly after and made their way to the police station that Officer Mei worked at on the surface.
'This Gaia's Cultivation System is quite ridiculous... It completely cultivates for me, similar to my soul cultivation technique.'
Yuan was beginning to understand how everyone, including children, acquired their high cultivation bases.
And as he gathered more Limitless, his comprehension of it improved as well.

'Limitless... It's basically Eternal Essence, but altered and weakened to allow even humans to cultivate it. It may not be as powerful as raw Eternal Essence, but it's definitely stronger than even Celestial Essence.'
Even though Yuan hadn't even begun to understand Celestial Essence, which is required to reach the Absolute God realm, he could tell that Limitless was far superior.
'Whoever created this Gaia's System that is capable of all this is definitely at the level of an Eternal, perhaps even a Prime Eternal!'
Upon arriving at the police station, Officer Mei brought Yuan to the front desk and said to the officer behind the desk, "Sign him up to be my assistant."
"What...?"
The officer stared at them in disbelief.
"He has my mother's Endorsement. You can check if you don't believe me."
"Y-Your mother's Endorsement?!" The officer stood up in shock. "Isn't your mother—"
"I don't need you to remind me of my mother's identity," Officer Mei coldly interrupted. "Hurry up and sign him up so we can start working already."
After a moment of silence, the officer sat back down and started working.
"I have never seen you so eager to work before," the officer remarked as he worked.
"I'm not doing this because I want to," Officer Mei sighed.
A few moments later, the officer looked at Yuan and asked, "Hey... weren't you the oddball who was arrested by her earlier today?"
Yuan nodded with a smile, "A lot has happened."
Since Yuan was endorsed by Officer Mei's mother, the officer decided not to question it anymore.
A few more moments later, the officer handed Yuan a badge and said, "Here you go."
The instant Yuan accepted the badge, a notification appeared before him.
<You have been accepted as an Assistant Officer>
<You have been assigned to work as Officer Mei's assistant>
'I get the job just like that?' Yuan thought, a bit dumbfounded.
"Make sure to change out of your weird outfit before you leave this building," said the officer as he glared at Yuan's robes.
"Follow me," Officer Mei said before guiding him to the men's locker room.
"Inside, you'll find some tall machines. Remove your clothes and stand inside."
"Okay."
Yuan entered the locker room shortly afterward, and sure enough, several upright, cylinder-shaped machines stood along the wall.
After removing his clothes, Yuan stepped inside the machine. Without requiring him to do anything, it began scanning him from head to toe.

After the initial scan, the machine paused for several seconds before scanning him again. This time, however, it did more than examine him, and it began creating a suit directly on his body, spraying the material over his skin.
Yuan stepped out of the machine once it was all done.
"This feels... odd," Yuan mumbled as he looked down at the skin-tight suit. It was so light and breathable that it felt as though he were not wearing anything at all.
After leaving the locker room, Yuan asked Officer Mei, "How durable is this suit?"

"Don't underestimate its durability because of how thin it looks and feels," she remarked. "It is enforced with multiple protective enchantments and can easily withstand attacks from anyone below the Fifth Ascension."
"How many cultivation realms are there?" Yuan then asked.
"There are nine realms in total."
"Nine..." Yuan swallowed nervously at this information.
'If First Ascension is God Ascension, then I can probably assume that Third Ascension is the realm of Absolute God...'
The discovery of Absolute God was already shocking enough. Yet there were six more realms above that in this world.
'Good heavens... just how advanced is the cultivation in this world? I wouldn't be surprised if the top cultivators of this world can rival even Eternals!'
"Let's get to work," Officer Mei said, snapping him out of his thoughts.
"How does it work?" he asked as he followed her outside.
"If there are no active threats or issues, we simply patrol the city."
"What about my credentials?"

"It will increase gradually as long as you are on the job, but it rises much faster when you take more active actions. For example, arresting a criminal will earn you far more credentials than simply wandering around a park."
Yuan sighed. "I still do not understand what doing a job has to do with one's credentials."

"Your credentials are essentially a measure of how much Gaia's System trusts you. The more you contribute to society without doing anything wrong, the more access you will receive, improving your overall quality of life."
"Faster cultivation. Higher clearance. Better jobs. You name it. This entire world revolves around Gaia's System."
"With a system like that, I do not see the purpose of police officers. Can't the system simply punish criminals outright?" Yuan asked.

Officer Mei raised an eyebrow at him before responding, "The system is neither omnipotent nor absolute. Although I do not know exactly how it works, it never acts according to its own interests and likely has rules of its own."

chapters.title: Chapter 2555 Getting a Job(2)
paragraphs: "Does that mean the system will not do anything even if someone commits a crime?" Yuan asked.
Officer Mei nodded.

"The only time the system issues punishment on its own is when a user violates one of its rules, such as breaking a contract. Other than that, it's up to the real justice system to punish the criminals."
"What's the crime rate like in this world?" Yuan then inquired.
"In the Minor Sectors? We get hundreds of cases every day."
"That's a lot."
"Not really. Since it accounts for all ninety-nine Minor Sectors, only a few cases occur in each Sector every day. In fact, most crimes take place between Sectors 70 and 99," Officer Mei explained.

"I have been wondering about this for a while now, but what is the difference between the Sectors?" Yuan asked. "I thought they were simply names for different areas, but from the way you describe them, there seems to be something more significant."

"The lower a Sector's number, the better the living conditions in that area. For example, those who live in Sector 1 are generally wealthy, while Sector 99 is referred to by many as the 'Slum,'" she explained with a heavy sigh.
"Since we're in Sector 10, I guess we're in a pretty good area?" Yuan remarked.
She nodded and said, "I'm actually surprised that you managed to get here with your low Credential Rank. Normally, you'd need at least Rank 3 to even get beyond Sector 30."
Yuan shrugged. "When I was teleported to this world, I was already in Sector 11. Speaking of which... why was I able to enter Sector 10 despite only having Rank 1 credentials?"

"Because there is no checkpoint between Sectors 10 and 11. Once you have passed the checkpoint at Sector 20, you can move freely through the areas beyond it, so Sectors 10 to 19. However, entering Sector 9 is a completely different matter."
"Is that so?"

The two continued chatting as they strolled through Sector 10, with Yuan mostly asking questions about their world. Although Officer Mei did not yet believe Yuan had truly come from another world, she answered his questions regardless.
"Do magical beasts exist in this world?" Yuan suddenly asked.
"Magical... beasts? What are those?" Officer Mei responded with a confused look on her face.

"I guess that answers my question," he said before giving a brief explanation. "In my world, they are something like wild beasts. Not only do they cultivate as well, but the people in my world hunt them for their resources.
"We don't have anything like that," Officer Mei shook her head.
'A world where magical beasts don't exist, huh? Albeit rare, they existed even in the Demonic Realm...' Yuan thought to himself.
And since magical beasts are failed experiments as a result of Eternals trying to clone already cloned humans, this meant that the Eternals have yet to touch this world.
'But then what about Gaia...? And according to the technique given to me by the unknown Eternal, I could find the Absolute Power here...'
Yuan lifted his head to look at the sky and sighed inwardly, 'Can I really find the Absolute Power in this place?'
Several hours later—
"It's already dark. When are we going to stop working?" Yuan asked.
Officer Mei looked at him with a puzzled face and replied, "What do you mean? Don't tell me you want to stop working after just a mere few hours?"
"Then when do we stop?" Yuan asked with a raised eyebrow.
"We don't, at least not until your Credential Rank reaches Rank 3."
Yuan's eyes widened at her words.
"So we're going to keep working around the clock until my Credential Rank increases?" he asked for confirmation.
"That's right. You want to increase your credentials as fast as possible, right? Since we only get credentials while we work, we can only keep on working."
Yuan rubbed his eyes and said, "I appreciate you helping me out, but you don't need to force yourself to work overtime for me. We can start again tomorrow."
"What are you talking about? I am not doing anything special for you; this is just my normal routine. I usually work a few weeks at a time."
Yuan's jaw dropped at her words.
"That... sounds horrible."
"Does it? It's not like I have anything else to do.
After hearing such words, Yuan realized that since everyone in this world relied on Gaia's System to cultivate, they had all the time in the world to do other things.
"If you're tired, you can head home. And since I doubt you have a place to stay, I'll let you live in the guest room for now," Officer Mei said a moment later.
Yuan shook his head and said, "No, I'm not tired. I can do this all day, every day, until I reach Credential Rank 3."
Thus, the two of them continued working through the night.
Due to their high cultivation, the people of this world could work for months—or even years—without needing a moment of rest.
This also meant that they had no need for food or water, and those who still ate did so purely for the experience.
At the end of the day, they did not encounter a single incident.
"Hey, tell me about your world," Officer Mei suddenly said.
"Oh?" Yuan looked at her with a somewhat cheeky smile. "Are you starting to believe me?"
"Of course not," she sneered. "I just happen to like fairy tales and fictional stories."
"What do you want to know about my world?" Yuan asked.
"Tell me about—"
Officer Mei suddenly stopped mid-sentence and came to a halt.
"I just received a call from the station. There is an incident that requires our immediate attention."
Without explaining further, Officer Mei started running toward the nearest teleporter.
Fortunately, the nearest teleporter was only a block away, and once both of them were on it, Officer Mei activated it, teleporting them to Sector 18.

chapters.title: Chapter 2556 Longevity
paragraphs: The moment Yuan and Officer Mei appeared in Sector 18, they could feel vibrations in the air, as well as noticeably shaking in the ground, as if there were an active earthquake.
"What is going on?" Yuan asked as he continued running behind Officer Mei.
"There appears to be an ongoing fight," she replied.
Yuan was left speechless by the cause of the incident, as he had expected something much worse given her urgency.
Once they arrived at the scene, Yuan quickly realized that it was even worse than he had imagined.

Due to the cultivation-suppressing formations that enveloped the entire city, the two people involved could only throw ordinary punches and kicks. Not only were they unable to use any techniques, but they fought as though neither had ever been in a fight before.
Yuan visibly cringed at how ridiculous the scene looked. When he turned to Officer Mei, she was already charging toward the two fighters with a solemn expression.
"Hey! Both of you! Stop it!" she shouted.
However, they completely ignored her and continued throwing wild attacks at one another.
Seeing this, Officer Mei's expression darkened.

The moment she reached them, she threw two powerful punches, each landing squarely in their stomachs. The impact forced both men to their knees, clutching their abdomens as their faces twisted in pain.
Then, without a word, she restrained them in the same golden binding that she used to restraint Yuan before.
After being restrained, the two fighters quickly calmed down.
"So, why were the two of you fighting?" Officer Mei questioned them.
"He bumped into me," one of them said.
"No! HE bumped into me!" the other one immediately refuted.

Officer Mei rubbed her eyes and sighed out loud, "I will give you two choices. One, I remove your restraints, and the two of you shake hands and walk away, or two... I bring you back to the station and write you down, which will result in a loss of credentials. Which would you prefer?"
The two men stared at each other for a moment before responding, "One...
Officer Mei released their restraints and watched them shake hands before parting ways as if nothing had happened.
"What was that about?" Yuan remarked with a dumbfounded face.
"What do you mean? Were you expecting something else?" Officer Mei looked at him with raised eyebrows.
"Honestly, I was. You had such a serious expression on your face that I thought something major had happened."
"Something major? Like what?"
Yuan shook his head and said, "Never mind."
He then looked at the sky and continued, "Can I ask you about the formation that suppresses our cultivation? What is its purpose?"
"Isn't it obvious? It's to protect this world from ourselves," she quickly replied.
"Take those two idiots just now, for example. If they had access to their cultivation, their little scuffle could've been disastrous."
"That makes sense..." Yuan nodded.

Despite the humorous fight they had just been engaged in, the two men possessed cultivation bases Yuan could not see through. Had they used their power recklessly and without restraint, they could have easily destroyed the entire city.
Moreover, Yuan had done the same thing on his own Earth, restricting everyone's cultivation so they wouldn't accidentally destroy the world with their newfound powers.
Yuan stared at the sky in silence, a pondering expression on his face.
"What are you thinking about now?" Officer Mei asked, her interest piqued by his expression.

"I am wondering why everyone cultivates if they cannot even use their power," Yuan replied. "Hell, I would not even call it cultivation when their strength improves without them needing to do anything. Is it simply to live longer, perhaps?"
"Huh? What are you talking about?" Officer Mei muttered with a puzzled look on her face. "How does improving our cultivation increase our longevity?"
"What?"
It was Yuan's turn to be confused.
"Let me get something straight... Your longevity doesn't increase alongside your cultivation?" Yuan asked for confirmation.
"Of course not," she replied, sounding like she was only stating the obvious.

'So despite possessing such high cultivation, it does not affect their longevity? Is this the consequence of cultivating entirely through the system?' Yuan wondered inwardly after learning this surprising information.
"Uh... What is the average lifespan in this world?" Yuan then asked.
"About three to five hundred years. However, a few individuals have lived for as long as a thousand."
"I see... So it is still much longer than an ordinary mortal's lifespan, but compared to cultivators, it is basically nothing."
"What on earth are you talking about?" Officer Mei inquired.
"Believe it or not, but the cultivators in my world can live for tens of thousands of years with ease, and once we reach a certain cultivation realm, we basically become immortal."
"What?! Immortal?!" Officer Mei exclaimed in disbelief. "That's the most outrageous thing you've said to date!"
Yuan shrugged and said, "Many people in my world cultivate for immortality."
"H-How does it work?" Officer Mei asked in a nervous voice.
"Do you remember when your mother cultivated manually and called it inefficient? That is how the cultivators in my world all cultivate."

"What...? You can increase your longevity if you cultivate like that?" Officer Mei muttered in a daze. "But it barely improves our cultivation... In fact, most of us would long perish before we even increase our cultivation by a single level if we used that method."
"That's because you've inflated your cultivation with the system's assistance." Yuan shook his head.
After a slight pause, he added, "That being said, this is just my speculation."
"Is that so? Anyway, let's get back to work." Officer Mei said.

The two continued patrolling the city between the 10th and 19th Sectors and, over the next several days, encountered more incidents. Yet most of them were either fights or arguments sparked by the slightest provocations.
'This world... is quite peaceful,' Yuan thought to himself.

Meanwhile, somewhere within the boundless Starry Sky, a massive figure that had been slumbering for countless years suddenly opened their eyes and muttered in a puzzled voice, "My system was destroyed...? Who could've done it?"

After a moment of silence, they turned toward the Nine Heavens with narrowed eyes and wondered inwardly, 'This wasn't supposed to happen! What went wrong? Who intervened with my plans? I need to find out!'

sentences.text: The moment Yuan and Officer Mei appeared in Sector 18, they could feel vibrations in the air, as well as noticeably shaking in the ground, as if there were an active earthquake.
"What is going on?" Yuan asked as he continued running behind Officer Mei.
"There appears to be an ongoing fight," she replied.
Yuan was left speechless by the cause of the incident, as he had expected something much worse given her urgency.
Once they arrived at the scene, Yuan quickly realized that it was even worse than he had imagined.
Due to the cultivation-suppressing formations that enveloped the entire city, the two people involved could only throw ordinary punches and kicks.
Not only were they unable to use any techniques, but they fought as though neither had ever been in a fight before.
Yuan visibly cringed at how ridiculous the scene looked.
When he turned to Officer Mei, she was already charging toward the two fighters with a solemn expression.
"Hey!
Both of you!
Stop it!" she shouted.
However, they completely ignored her and continued throwing wild attacks at one another.
Seeing this, Officer Mei's expression darkened.
The moment she reached them, she threw two powerful punches, each landing squarely in their stomachs.
The impact forced both men to their knees, clutching their abdomens as their faces twisted in pain.
Then, without a word, she restrained them in the same golden binding that she used to restraint Yuan before.
After being restrained, the two fighters quickly calmed down.
"So, why were the two of you fighting?" Officer Mei questioned them.
"He bumped into me," one of them said.
"No!
HE bumped into me!" the other one immediately refuted.
Officer Mei rubbed her eyes and sighed out loud, "I will give you two choices.
One, I remove your restraints, and the two of you shake hands and walk away, or two...
I bring you back to the station and write you down, which will result in a loss of credentials.
Which would you prefer?"
The two men stared at each other for a moment before responding, "One...
Officer Mei released their restraints and watched them shake hands before parting ways as if nothing had happened.
"What was that about?" Yuan remarked with a dumbfounded face.
"What do you mean?
Were you expecting something else?" Officer Mei looked at him with raised eyebrows.
"Honestly, I was.
You had such a serious expression on your face that I thought something major had happened."
"Something major?
Like what?"
Yuan shook his head and said, "Never mind."
He then looked at the sky and continued, "Can I ask you about the formation that suppresses our cultivation?
What is its purpose?"
"Isn't it obvious?
It's to protect this world from ourselves," she quickly replied.
"Take those two idiots just now, for example.
If they had access to their cultivation, their little scuffle could've been disastrous."
"That makes sense..." Yuan nodded.
Despite the humorous fight they had just been engaged in, the two men possessed cultivation bases Yuan could not see through.
Had they used their power recklessly and without restraint, they could have easily destroyed the entire city.

"What are you thinking about now?" Officer Mei asked, her interest piqued by his expression.

"How does improving our cultivation increase our longevity?"
"What?"

"Of course not," she replied, sounding like she was only stating the obvious.

Is this the consequence of cultivating entirely through the system?' Yuan wondered inwardly after learning this surprising information.

"About three to five hundred years.
However, a few individuals have lived for as long as a thousand."
"I see...
So it is still much longer than an ordinary mortal's lifespan, but compared to cultivators, it is basically nothing."
"What on earth are you talking about?" Officer Mei inquired.
"Believe it or not, but the cultivators in my world can live for tens of thousands of years with ease, and once we reach a certain cultivation realm, we basically become immortal."
"What?!
Immortal?!" Officer Mei exclaimed in disbelief.
"That's the most outrageous thing you've said to date!"
Yuan shrugged and said, "Many people in my world cultivate for immortality."
"H-How does it work?" Officer Mei asked in a nervous voice.
"Do you remember when your mother cultivated manually and called it inefficient?
That is how the cultivators in my world all cultivate."
"What...?
You can increase your longevity if you cultivate like that?" Officer Mei muttered in a daze.

chapters.title: Chapter 2557 Gaia's Sanctum
paragraphs: Time passed quickly, and before Yuan realized, it had been almost an entire month since he arrived in this mysterious world.
<Your cultivation has reached Ninth Level First Ascension>
<Your Credential Rank has increased a level>
<You have acquired the required Credential Rank for Level 3 treatment>
<Begin Treatment?>
<Treatment Has Begun>
<Utilizing Level 3 Treatment>
<Treatment Completed>
<A curse has been removed from the user>
After working for twenty-eight days without rest, Yuan's Credential Rank finally reached Rank 3, the bare minimum to qualify to join the military.
However, his cultivation was still in the First Ascension, and he needed to reach the Third Ascension to qualify fully.
"Hey, my mother just messaged me. She said that she'll be at the house in an hour, so let's get back to the station and clock out," Officer Mei said to Yuan after receiving the message.
They returned to the station shortly after and clocked out.
"How was it, Assistant Officer?"
The officer who signed Yuan up for the job was still there when they returned.
"A little more boring than I'd anticipated, not that I am complaining," he admitted.
The officer chuckled at his words and said, "If you want more action, you should work at the 9th Precinct, which deals with the slums."
"I would... but I already have another job planned," said Yuan while shaking his head.
"Oh? Are you quitting already? What will you be doing next?"
"I'm joining the military."
The officer's eyes widened with shock at Yuan's words.
Then, he spoke in a hesitant voice, "I don't want to be rude, but I don't think you'll survive the military. Hell, you won't even get in with your cultivation at such a low level."
Yuan shrugged and said, "I may not qualify now, but I still have some time to fix it. As for whether or not I will survive the military... only time will tell."
After clocking out, Yuan followed Officer Mei back to her villa, where they waited for Mei Feng to show up.
A little over an hour later, Mei Feng finally arrived at the villa.
"You're still only at the First Ascension, huh? A little slower than I anticipated," she remarked the moment she saw Yuan.
"At least my Credential Rank has increased to 3," Yuan said.
Without wasting any time, Mei Feng retrieved the second Gaia's Gift and casually handed it to him.
Had Officer Mei not revealed the truth, Yuan would never have realized how precious the treasure was, given how nonchalantly Mei Feng treated it.
"Thank you." Yuan accepted the treasure and immediately consumed it, increasing his Cultivation Speed by a level.
<You have consumed Gaia's Gift>
<Your Cultivation Speed has increased by 1>
<Your cultivation has reached First Level Second Ascension>
Yuan could feel his body surging with newfound energy after reaching Second Ascension.
'Sure enough, Second Ascension is basically the realm of Cultivation God!' Yuan silently compared the two.
"You should reach the Third Ascension within a year at this rate, but it's still not fast enough since we need to get you to the Third Ascension before the recruitment in five months."
"What other methods are there that speed up one's cultivation?" Yuan asked.
"Gaia's Sanctum," she replied.
"What's that?" Yuan raised an eyebrow at this new word.

"It's a place where people can partake in special trials to improve their cultivation. However, it's quite tedious and difficult, so only those who really want to speed up their cultivation go there."
"Trials, huh? Sounds fun. Where is it? I'll head there right now."
"Let's slow down a little. There's still something you must do before you can go there."
"What I must do?" Yuan raised his eyebrows in a puzzled manner.
"Follow me."
Mei Feng brought Yuan to the living room, where a lone machine now stood.
"What the...?" Officer Mei muttered when she saw it.
The machine hadn't been there before, so her mother must've brought it there.
"Wait... Isn't this equipment used by the military?" Officer Mei remarked after taking a closer look at the machine. "I thought it was not allowed to be taken off the premises."
"It's not allowed, which is why I sneaked it here and we have to get this over with as soon as possible before someone notices," Mei Feng said in a calm manner.
"Are you insane?!" Officer Mei exclaimed. "I know you can get away with a lot of things because of your position in the military, but this is too much even for you!"
Mei Feng shrugged and defended herself, "It's not like we can wait until he joins the military."
She turned to look at Yuan and continued, "What are you waiting for? Get inside."
Although he had no idea what the machine was for, Yuan entered the machine and waited for Mei Feng to do her thing.
A few minutes later—
<With the authority of Mei Feng, your physique has been hidden and changed to Superior Heavenly Refinement>
Once Yuan exited the machine, Mei Feng gave a quick explanation, "We don't need the entire world to know about your Perfected Heavenly Refinement since it'll cause too much trouble."
"I didn't know you could alter one's status like this..." Yuan remarked.

"It's not permanent, and your real physique can still be seen by those with a higher Credential Rank than me. With that being said, as long as you don't do anything too outrageous, you shouldn't attract their attention," she said.
"Anyway, I have to bring this machine back. Mei, bring him to Gaia's Sanctum and show him how it works. I'll come back one more time right before the recruitment."
After giving Officer Mei more work, Mei Feng left with the machine.
"Haa..." Officer Mei released a long sigh before turning to look at Yuan.
"Let's go."
They left the villa shortly after and began making their way to Gaia's Sanctum.
"By the way, what rank is Superior Heavenly Refinement?" Yuan asked as they traveled.

chapters.title: Chapter 2558 Gaia's Sanctum(2)
paragraphs: Hearing Yuan's question, Officer Mei explained, "The nine standard ranks of Heavenly Refinement are arranged from lowest to highest: Heavenly Refinement, Tempered Heavenly Refinement, Superior Heavenly Refinement, Supreme Heavenly Refinement, Inexhaustible Heavenly Refinement, Imperious Heavenly Refinement, Indestructible Heavenly Refinement, Invincible Heavenly Refinement, and Perfected Heavenly Refinement."
"So your mother disguised my physique as the third lowest rank, huh? I guess that makes sense, considering my low cultivation," Yuan muttered with a thoughtful expression.
He then asked, "What about you? What rank is your physique at?"
"I'm currently at Supreme Heavenly Refinement," she revealed.
"Is that impressive? What's the average physique rank in this world?" Yuan then asked.

"The average person who doesn't really focus on their cultivation usually stops at Tempered Heavenly Refinement. Meanwhile, those who put in a little more effort will achieve Superior Heavenly Refinement, and those who are serious about their cultivation will reach Supreme Heavenly Refinement," she replied.
"As for Inexhaustible Heavenly Refinement and the ranks above it, only those who join the military can attain them. The technique and resources required to reach those levels are heavily restricted."

"Now that I think about it, what is the difference between the ranks of the physique?" Yuan continued to ask. "Even though I possess Perfected Heavenly Refinement, it doesn't seem to affect my cultivation speed."
"That... I am not too sure about. All I know is that it's better to have a higher-ranked physique. As for the details, you can ask my mother."
"Alright."
Some time later, they stepped on the teleportation platform, and Officer Mei teleported them directly to Gaia's Sanctum.
"This is... Gaia's Sanctum?" Yuan muttered in a daze as he examined his surroundings with wide eyes.
He found himself inside a vast indoor stadium so immense that its walls could not be seen with the naked eye.
The floor was covered in marble-like tiles, and tens of thousands of people filled the area, with most of them staring intently at the projections suspended above.
When Yuan looked at one of the many projections, he saw two individuals engaged in battle in an arena surrounded by water, as if they were in the middle of the sea.
"I can improve my cultivation here...?" Yuan asked aloud, wearing a dumbfounded expression. "How does that even work? I was expecting trials, but this just looks like a series of sparring matches."

"There are three types of trials you can participate in," Officer Mei explained. "The first is called One Above All, one-on-one matches where you fight someone of a similar ranking, climbing higher as you win. The second is Last Man Standing, where a hundred people fight until only one remains. The third is Endless Assault, where you must fight artificial beings created by the system until you are defeated."
"If you perform well during a trial, the system will reward you. Most of the time, those rewards come in the form of a boost to your cultivation."
Yuan was left speechless by these so-called trials.
'This feels like something straight out of a video game...' he thought to himself.
"So, which trial increases my cultivation the fastest?" Yuan asked a moment later.
"That depends on whichever one you think you'll do the best at. After all, the higher rank you achieve, the more your cultivation increases."
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "What happens if I rank high in all three of them? Do I get three times the reward?"
Officer Mei raised an eyebrow and responded, "I guess so."
"Then I'll start with the one-on-one matches," Yuan then said. "Where do I go to get started?"
"Follow me."
As Yuan followed Officer Mei, he thought to himself, 'The cultivation in this world is so exaggerated and inflated that it feels... somewhat pointless.'
He couldn't fathom why the system was handing out cultivation levels like some sort of currency.
'Even if they have a high cultivation, it's not like they can do anything with it... Nor does it increase their longevity. So what is the point? Why is everyone cultivating?'
Although Yuan was deeply puzzled by this world, he had a feeling that the military held the answers he sought.
Realizing there was no point in pondering over something with no clear answers, Yuan decided to just focus on improving his cultivation and increasing his Credential Rank.
Some time later, they arrived at the reception.
"My friend would like to sign up for the one-on-one matches," Officer Mei said to one of the workers there while pointing at Yuan.
The worker looked at Yuan and asked him, "Have you been here before?"
"No, this is my first time."
"In that case, we will need to register you first."
The worker gestured at the machine before her and said, "Please.
Already used to this routine, Yuan shoved his hand into the machine without a word.
[Name: Yuan]
[Cultivation: First Level Second Ascension]
[Physique: Superior Heavenly Refinement]
[Credential Rank: 3]
<You have been registered as a Player at Gaia's Sanctum>
The worker raised an eyebrow after seeing Yuan's low cultivation.
"Are you sure you want to participate in One Above All? I suggest starting with Endless Assault to get a feel for it since this is your first time."
Hearing this, Yuan asked, "Does one's cultivation matter in the one-on-one matches?"

"Of course it does. While you won't need to worry too much in the beginning, since you will first be matched against those at the bottom of the rankings, there will still be a gap in cultivation, as most people do not participate in One Above All until they have reached at least the Third Ascension. If you're unlucky, you could even encounter someone at Fourth Ascension."
"Meanwhile, Endless Assault is more beginner-friendly because your opponents are artificial and will be matched to your cultivation level."
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding with an excited smile.
"Sign me up for One Above All."
The worker stared at Yuan in stunned silence for a moment and shook his head inwardly.
'He'll learn the hard way.'

chapters.title: Chapter 2559 First Match
paragraphs: "I have checked you in for One Above All."
The worker said to Yuan shortly after.
Yuan turned to Officer Mei and asked, "What now?"
"Now you can enter the arena and wait for your matchmaking," she said.
As she led him to the waiting area, she explained a few rules.

"During the fight, your cultivation will not be suppressed, so you can fight without reserve. Although you can't die while inside Gaia's Sanctum, and all damage is reverted after leaving the arena, you will feel everything."
"Are weapons allowed?" Yuan then asked.
"Well, that depends on your ranking. In the lower ranks, you are only allowed to use your body and martial techniques, but upon reaching a certain rank, you can start fighting with weapons."
"How many ranks are there?"

"You start without a rank, and as you progress, you will reach Novice, Warrior, Expert, Master, Grandmaster, Gladiator, Elite Gladiator, Supreme Gladiator, and One Above All, with the highest rank only attainable by the strongest on the ranking."
"By the way, each trial has its own ranking."
"I see."
Some time later, they reached a teleportation platform, and Officer Mei said, "You'll be teleported to the preparation area once you step on that. Good luck."
"See you later."
Yuan did not waste any time and immediately stepped onto the platform, disappearing from the lobby.
<You have entered the waiting room for One Above All>
Yuan looked around the waiting room. He was alone in a spacious, square-shaped room furnished with a couch, a bathroom, and even a bed.
"So, how does this work?" he wondered out loud.
<Begin matchmaking?>
A notification popped up the next moment.
"Begin."
Yuan responded without thinking.
<Checking Status>
<Player Profile has been created>
[Player: Yuan]
[Rank: Unranked]
[Cultivation: First Level Second Ascension]
<You have entered matchmaking for One Above All>
A few moments later—
<Opponent Found>
<Your match will begin in one minute>
A minute later—
<Your match will begin now>
<Teleporting to arena in 3... 2.. 1...>
When the countdown reached zero, Yuan was teleported to a new location, and he found himself standing beneath a blazing sun, with soft, unstable sand shifting beneath his feet.
Not too far away stood a lone figure—a young man who appeared to be a teenager. Yet, he was exuding the aura of a Third Ascension cultivator.
"Second Ascension? Lucky me! This is essentially a free win!" The young man laughed excitedly after seeing Yuan's cultivation.
Meanwhile, Yuan wasn't even paying attention to his opponent and was focused on himself, or more precisely, the new energy flowing within him.
"So this is Limitless, huh?" Yuan muttered as he was finally allowed to use it, which helped him gain a better understanding of it.
Although it felt similar to Eternal Essence, it was far purer—as though it had already been refined.

If Eternal Essence was the raw energy from which all existence originated, then Limitless was its refined, more accessible form. However, that purity came at a cost. While even humans could wield Limitless, it was nowhere near as powerful or destructive as Eternal Essence.
"Hey, trash! What are you dozing off on?!" The young man cursed at Yuan when he realized that he was being ignored.
<The match will begin in 10 seconds>
Yuan finally looked at his opponent, who was glaring daggers at him, and spoke with a calm smile, "I will give you a ten-minute head start. I won't attack you until the ten minutes are up."
"You're looking down on me?! Even though you've only reached Second Ascension as an adult?! How ridiculous!
"Your cultivation level isn't everything in a fight."
"Maybe that's true for you, who has an insignificant cultivation!"
<Match start>
"But I am different!"
Without moving from his spot, the young man extended an arm toward Yuan and began gathering energy in his palm.
'What an obvious attack...' Yuan inwardly shook his head.
In the very next moment, the young man unleashed a wave of Limitless energy from his palm, sending it hurtling toward Yuan like an energy blast—just as Yuan had predicted.

Although Yuan had anticipated the young man's attack, he was still surprised by the amount of power behind it. It was almost as though the young man had no intention of conserving his energy and planned to end the fight in a single strike.
Of course, Yuan avoided the attack with ease and, after doing so, said to the young man, "That was quite a powerful attack. I bet that would have done a lot of damage... if it had hit me."
"T-This bastard...!" The young man cursed in a low voice, sounding a little out of breath.
Yuan raised an eyebrow and remarked, "Don't tell me you're tired already? After a single attack?"
"Shut the hell up! I am just getting started!"
The young man shouted as he started bombarding Yuan with even more predictable attacks.
Seeing this, Yuan could only shake his head. It felt as though he were fighting a greenhorn who possessed a powerful treasure but had no idea how to wield it properly.
"Why do you not just surrender?" Yuan asked the young man two minutes later. "I really do not want to spend the next eight minutes watching you catch your breath."
However, the young man did not respond. No—he could not. After unleashing everything he had in only a few attacks, he was already completely out of energy.
Yuan was left speechless by the way his first match was unfolding. Although he had kept his expectations low, he had at least expected a proper fight.
Instead, his opponent was so inexperienced that Yuan felt as though he were bullying a little kid who had never fought before.
"Is this your first match, too?" Yuan asked.
Unbeknownst to Yuan, this was the young man's fourth match, and he had two victories under his belt.
"Y-You dirty little bastard...! If you are a real fighter, then fight me properly instead of using such dirty tactics!" the young man finally shouted in frustration, accusing Yuan of playing dirty.

chapters.title: Chapter 2560 Win Streak
paragraphs: "I'm using... dirty tactics?" Yuan could hardly believe his ears.
"So you expect me to just stand there and take your attacks?"
"I expect you to fight me properly, not run around and force me to waste my energy!" the young man exclaimed indignantly, as though he were the one being wronged.

Yuan scratched his head and asked, "So you are blaming me for your own lack of control and efficiency? Instead of wasting your energy like an idiot who refuses to learn, you should try a different approach when one method does not work."
"I am doing you a favor by letting you attack me for free, yet here you are, wasting my generosity..." Yuan shook his head.
In truth, Yuan had wanted to see how the cultivators of this world used Limitless, but he quickly realized his miscalculation.
'If I want to observe a proper cultivator, I should do so at a higher rank. Most people at the lower ranks will probably be like this amateur...' he sighed inwardly.
Yuan used a movement technique and suddenly vanished from the young man's sight.
"H-He vanished?!" the young man cried out loud.
Then, he heard a familiar voice resounding from behind him.
"I know I said that I'd give you ten minutes, but... I doubt anything would change even if I gave you a hundred minutes, so I will end things here."
Before the young man could react, he felt a sharp, piercing pain in his neck.
<You have died>
When the young man came to, he was back in the waiting room, a death notification floating before him.
"What the hell was that?!" the young man cried out loud.
He had watched many matches prior to participating in them himself, but he had never seen a cultivator fight the way his opponent had.
Meanwhile, Yuan was also teleported back to the waiting room after his victory.
<You have won your match>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<Your cultivation has reached Second Level Second Ascension>
"My cultivation increases just like that? I still have five months before the recruitment, so I might as well increase my cultivation as much as possible!"
With that in mind, Yuan immediately started matchmaking for his second fight.
A minute later, he was teleported to the arena.
This time, he found himself on a floating platform in the middle of the sea—the same arena he had seen on the display not long ago.
Standing on the opposite side of the platform was another young man, seemingly in his teens, and his cultivation was also at the Third Ascension.
The young man raised an eyebrow after seeing Yuan's cultivation. He rubbed his eyes and looked again to make sure he wasn't imagining things.
"Haha! A free win!"
<Match will begin in 10 seconds>
This time, Yuan remained silent as he waited for the countdown to reach zero.
Ten seconds later, the match began. The young man made the first move, attacking in a manner similar to Yuan's previous opponent.
Yuan avoided the attack with ease, and the young man immediately followed up with another powerful attack.
"W-Why aren't my attacks hitting him?!"
The young man exclaimed in shock.
Once the young man began to show signs of exhaustion, Yuan struck, defeating him in a single blow.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 2>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
<Your cultivation has reached Third Level Second Ascension>
Yuan didn't waste any time and immediately started his next match.
Half an hour later, Yuan won his 10th match in a row.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 10>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
<Your cultivation has reached Sixth Level Second Ascension>
<You have won 10 matches in total>
<You have reached Novice Rank>

Over the course of those ten matches, Yuan closely observed his opponents during the first minute of each fight. Seven of them fought in a similar manner, while the opponents in the final three matches actually tried to confront him head-on.
However, they only did so after exhausting more than half of their energy.
Back in the waiting room, Yuan pondered aloud, "The cultivators of this world seem to lack stamina..."

At first, Yuan thought they were simply wasting energy without restraint, or that they didn't know how to control it properly. However, even if that were the case, cultivators comparable to Absolute Gods should not be exhausting themselves in a few short minutes, even if they fought at full power.
"Is there a reason why they're exhausting themselves so quickly?" Yuan wondered as he left the waiting room.
Although he wanted to continue fighting, he wasn't alone, and, not wanting to make Officer Mei wait too long, he decided to take a break.
Once he returned to the lobby, Yuan quickly spotted Officer Mei among the crowd near the spectators' area, watching the matches displayed overhead.
'There are a lot more people now...' Yuan thought to himself as he approached the crowd.
"What are you watching?" he asked when he reached Officer Mei.
"Hm? You are done already?" Officer Mei responded without looking at him, her eyes fixed on the display.
Curious about what had captured her attention, Yuan turned to the display as well.
There were two individuals locked in a fierce battle, much like how normal cultivators in his world would fight.
"Hm?"
Yuan's eyebrows rose in surprise when he saw them. However, it was not their experienced movements or their weapons that caught his attention. Rather, it was their faces—their familiar faces.
"Wang Ming and Shi Lang?" Yuan muttered in disbelief.
And just like the men Yuan knew, Wang Ming wielded a sword-like weapon, while Shi Lang fought with a long spear-like weapon.
"What are those glowing weapons they are using?" Yuan asked Officer Mei a moment later.

chapters.title: Chapter 2561 Gaia Points
paragraphs: "Their weapons? They are called Limitless Armaments," Officer Mei responded.
"So the glowing blades are created from Limitless? Who are these two, anyway?"
"The one with the spear is called Shi Fa, and his opponent is Wu Wang. They are both Gladiators and in the top 500."
"Top 500, huh? That's pretty impressive," Yuan muttered, wondering if he needed to reach such a high rank before he could fight competent opponents.
"How was your match? Did you win?" Officer Mei suddenly asked him.
"What do you think?"

After a moment of silence, she responded, "Quite frankly, even though you have a low cultivation base, your combat expertise is one of the best I've seen, rivaling even those two Gladiators. I think you have a good chance of winning as long as your opponent wasn't in the Fourth Ascension."
Officer Mei trembled inwardly just recalling her spar with Yuan.
Yuan chuckled and said, "Although the experience was not what I anticipated, it was fun nonetheless. I even managed to reach the rank of Novice."
"What?" Officer Mei finally stopped watching the display and turned to look at Yuan with a puzzled face.
"How is that possible? You need at least twenty victories—or ten in a row to reach Novice as a beginner. How many matches did you do in such a short time?"
"Ten, and I won all of them," Yuan calmly replied.
Officer Mei's eyes widened with shock at his words, as she'd only expected him to complete two to three matches in such a short time.
"Hah!" A disdainful sneer resounded nearby before mocking Yuan out loud. "Buddy, if you're going to lie to impress a girl, try not to make it so obvious."
Another remarked while chuckling, "Ten wins in a row? At the Second Ascension? Hahaha!"
Despite the mockery, Yuan remained calm, even ignoring them.
Meanwhile, Officer Mei doubted Yuan only for a moment—at least until she noticed his cultivation had skyrocketed to Sixth Level Second Ascension.

'Good lord! He actually went on a ten-win streak on his first day! And it hasn't even been an hour since he started!' she cried inwardly, realizing that Yuan was even more monstrous than she'd thought.
"Are you going to continue?" she asked him a moment later.
Yuan nodded, "I want to see how far I can go. You can head back first if you want."
"I don't mind waiting," she said.
"I want to see how long before you get a spotlight on the display.
"Then I will continue my matches now," said Yuan.
However, as he turned around and started walking away, someone placed a hand on his shoulder, halting him.
Yuan slowly turned around to see a young man standing behind him with a wide grin on his face.
"Want to spar with me instead?"
"What would I gain out of beating a nobody like you?" Yuan asked with a puzzled face.
"I'd rather not waste my time," he added.
"What did you just say?" The young man immediately frowned.
Then, a look of realization crossed his face. "Oh, I see. You are just afraid that you will lose to me and expose yourself."
"If you went on a 10-win streak, you should have no issues fighting me, who also just happened to reach Novice."
Yuan sighed out loud and said, "I couldn't care less whether you believe me or not, but I am not going to waste my time if fighting you has no benefits."
"Benefits, huh? How about this? If you manage to defeat me, I will give you fifty points."
Yuan raised an eyebrow and asked, "Points? What is that?"
The young man stared at Yuan with a dumbfounded look.
"You don't even know about points?"

Officer Mei quickly spoke, "Ah, I forgot to mention it to you earlier since I wasn't expecting you to reach Novice so quickly, but once you reach that rank, you can obtain points for every win, and you can use them to exchange for additional rewards. Of course, you can also trade them."
'Sounds like a system that can easily be abused...' Yuan thought to himself.
"Fifty points, huh? Is that a lot?"
"Well, you get around 5 points per victory, more if you're on a win-streak," Officer Mei said.
"Sounds good." Yuan nodded. "However, I don't have any points."
"That's fine," said the young man, as he just wanted the opportunity to put liars like Yuan in his place. "I don't need anything from you even if you lose to me."
"Alright. How do we do this?"
"We can set up a custom match. It won't count towards your records, either. What's your player name?"
"Yuan.
"My name is Gu Kecheng. Make sure you accept my request once you see my name."
Yuan fell silent after hearing the young man's name.
"Alright..." he said a moment later.
They went to the waiting room shortly after.
After waiting around for a few minutes, Yuan received a custom match request.
<Player Gu Kecheng(Novice) has sent you a match request for One Above All>
<Win Condition: 50 Gaia Points> <Lose Condition: N/A>
[Player: Gu Kecheng]
[Cultivation: Fourth Level Fourth Ascension]
[One Above All Rank: Novice]
[One Above All Highest Win Streak: 3]
Meanwhile, inside Gu Kecheng's waiting room, his eyes widened with shock after Yuan accepted his match request.
<Player Yuan(Novice) has accepted your match request for One Above All>
[Player: Yuan]
[Cultivation: Sixth Level Second Ascension]
[One Above All Rank: Novice]
[One Above All Highest Win Streak: 10]
"T-Ten wins in a row?! He actually has a ten-win streak?!" he cried out in disbelief.
As the challenger, Gu Kecheng could not view their opponent's status, except for their rank, until the challenge was accepted, so he was caught off guard by the unexpected situation.
"Fuck! My fifty points! I am screwed!"
<Match will begin in 10 seconds>
"N-No! This doesn't automatically mean that I will lose to him! My cultivation is still two realms higher than his!"
<Your match will begin now>
<Teleporting to arena in 3...2...1...>
