"That's fine," said the young man, as he just wanted the opportunity to put liars like Yuan in his place.
"I don't need anything from you even if you lose to me."
"Alright.
How do we do this?"
"We can set up a custom match.
It won't count towards your records, either.
What's your player name?"
"Yuan.
"My name is Gu Kecheng.
Make sure you accept my request once you see my name."
Yuan fell silent after hearing the young man's name.
"Alright..." he said a moment later.
They went to the waiting room shortly after.
After waiting around for a few minutes, Yuan received a custom match request.
<Player Gu Kecheng(Novice) has sent you a match request for One Above All>
<Win Condition: 50 Gaia Points> <Lose Condition: N/A>
[Player: Gu Kecheng]
[Cultivation: Fourth Level Fourth Ascension]
[One Above All Rank: Novice]
[One Above All Highest Win Streak: 3]
Meanwhile, inside Gu Kecheng's waiting room, his eyes widened with shock after Yuan accepted his match request.
<Player Yuan(Novice) has accepted your match request for One Above All>
[Player: Yuan]
[Cultivation: Sixth Level Second Ascension]
[One Above All Rank: Novice]
[One Above All Highest Win Streak: 10]
"T-Ten wins in a row?!
He actually has a ten-win streak?!" he cried out in disbelief.
As the challenger, Gu Kecheng could not view their opponent's status, except for their rank, until the challenge was accepted, so he was caught off guard by the unexpected situation.
"Fuck!
My fifty points!
I am screwed!"
<Match will begin in 10 seconds>
"N-No!
This doesn't automatically mean that I will lose to him!
My cultivation is still two realms higher than his!"
<Your match will begin now>
<Teleporting to arena in 3...2...1...>

chapters.title: Chapter 2562 Custom Match
paragraphs: Yuan and Gu Kecheng were both teleported to a snowy arena, surrounded by towering white mountains, their knees buried in soft, pristine snow. Not only that, but there was an ongoing snowstorm so extreme that it blurred their vision.
'Whiteout! This is my favorite map!' A wide grin appeared on Gu Kecheng's face after seeing his most experienced arena.
This map not only hindered one's movement and vision but was also bitterly cold. Because of its extreme temperature, it was considered one of the most hated arenas available.
However, Gu Kecheng enjoyed the cold and had always won on this map, so his doubts vanished instantly.
The falling snow did not just block one's vision; it also had a unique characteristic that messed with one's divine sense, making it more difficult to find people.
As for the thick layer of snow on the ground, it reached their knees.
'Whoever makes the first move wins!' Gu Kecheng thought as he focused entirely on locating his opponent. In an arena like this, the first to find the other usually claimed victory.
Ten seconds... twenty seconds... half a minute...
An entire minute later—
'What is going on?! I cannot sense him at all!' Gu Kecheng cried inwardly.
Normally, even the slightest movement would produce a sound in the snow. Yet, Gu Kecheng could not hear a single sound.
'Is he also standing still? Then I just need to find him using my senses. With my superior cultivation, there's no way he could find me before I find him!'
Although he had already been trying to find Yuan using his divine sense from the very beginning, he wasn't completely focused on it.
Suddenly, a calm voice resounded, and it came from directly behind Gu Kecheng.
"Are you going to stand there all day?"
Gu Kecheng was greatly startled to hear Yuan's voice so close to him.
'When did he get behind me?!' he exclaimed inwardly.

Despite his shock, Gu Kecheng immediately spun around and unleashed a wave of Limitless, blasting everything behind him away. He poured so much power into the attack that it dispersed half of the snowstorm temporarily and even obliterated an entire mountain.
Gu Kecheng expected to be teleported back to the waiting room with the victory notification before him soon, but his expectations were betrayed once again when Yuan's voice returned.
"Where are you aiming? I'm right here."
Once again, Yuan's voice came from behind Gu Kecheng—only this time, he sounded even closer than before.
"Fuck!"
Gu Kecheng cursed out loud as he attacked in the direction of Yuan's voice.
"That was close. You almost hit me," Yuan's voice continued to provoke him.
"Stop messing with me, you bastard!" Gu Kecheng screamed loudly.
"So you want to lose already?"
Before Gu Kecheng could respond, he felt someone pressing a hand on his shoulder, sending chills down his spine.
"You're dead!"
Without looking back, Gu Kecheng swung his arm, creating a massive arc of Limitless that tore through the air like an unstoppable blade.
Yet, Gu Kecheng could still feel someone's hand resting on his shoulder.
'What the hell am I fighting?! A ghost?!' he cried inwardly as cold sweat formed on his forehead, only to freeze moments later.
"You're not any better than my previous opponents. No... You might be even worse..." Yuan sighed, sounding disappointed.
Gu Kecheng trembled in anger before his aura exploded like a bomb.
"DIE!"
He roared and unleashed as much power as he could, releasing Limitless in every direction.
For a brief moment, silence filled the white world. The only sound that remained was Gu Kecheng's heavy breathing.
"D-Did I finally get him...?" Gu Kecheng mumbled, his vision blurred from exhausting all his energy.
However, a black silhouette suddenly appeared not far in front of him, slowly approaching him like a ghost.
Gu Kecheng wanted to attack again, but he had completely exhausted his energy and could only watch helplessly as the silhouette drew closer and closer.
"Weren't you watching those two Gladiators fight just now? Yet here you are, wasting your energy and blindly attacking."
"W-Why can't I sense your presence even though you're standing right in front of me...?" Gu Kecheng asked with a bewildered look on his face.
"Try to figure that out yourself."
Suddenly, the silhouette vanished before Gu Kecheng's eyes.
A split second later, his vision went black.
Before he realized it, Gu Kecheng was back inside the waiting room with a notification before him.
<You have died>
"Argh!"
Gu Kecheng fell to his knees while screaming as a searing pain erupted from his neck. Although one could not die within Gaia's Sanctum, one would still feel the pain of it.
Meanwhile, Yuan returned to the lobby after winning the match.
When he approached Officer Mei and the group gathered around her, they all stared at him with wide eyes.
Unbeknownst to Yuan, his custom match against Gu Kecheng had been broadcast on the display at Gu Kecheng's personal request.
Although Gu Kecheng could not find Yuan to save his life, everyone in the lobby had witnessed the entire match. From their perspective, Yuan had been teleporting around like some kind of ghost.
"W-Was that some kind of movement technique?" Officer Mei asked him.
"What?" Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"We saw your match," she explained, pointing at the display above them.
"Oh. Well, I wouldn't call it a movement technique, but it's something like that, I guess."
"H-Hey! I will buy that technique from you for 500 Gaia Points!"
Someone in the crowd suddenly shouted.
Yuan turned to look at him and responded with a calm smile, "Sorry, but it's not for sale."
He then said to Officer Mei, "I am going to see what I can purchase with Gaia Points."
She nodded.
"I'll take you there."
However, just as they started walking, a familiar face blocked their path.
"Stop!" Gu Kecheng shouted.
"What do you want now?" Yuan asked him.
"R-Rematch! I want a rematch!" Gu Kecheng demanded.
"Sure..." Yuan calmly responded.
A smile started forming on Gu Kecheng's face, but it swiftly vanished when Yuan continued, "Once you have more points to give me, that is."

chapters.title: Chapter 2563 Gaia's Exchange
paragraphs: "W-What did you just say?" Gu Kecheng muttered with a dumbfounded look on his face.
"How many times do I have to repeat myself?" Yuan sighed, sounding annoyed. "I don't want to waste my time. If you want to fight me, make sure you have some points. At least 50."
Gu Kecheng stared at Yuan in utter silence, looking completely stunned.
After a moment, his expression shifted, and his face rapidly turned bright red.
Then, without warning, he stepped forward, drew back his arm, and attempted to throw a punch.
Yuan, who saw the attack coming from miles away, casually dodged it before grabbing Gu Kecheng by his neck and slamming him onto the ground with a heavy thud.
"If you can't beat me with your entire cultivation, what makes you think you can beat me without it?" Yuan sneered as he looked down on Gu Kecheng with disdain.
"B-Bastard...! Do you know who I am?!"

"No, I don't—but let me guess. You are some brat from an influential family, and you're going to cry to your parents about me, begging them to take care of me because you're too pathetic to do anything yourself."
"You—!"
"Shut up." Yuan slammed his head onto the ground, interrupting him. "If you're going to cry to your parents, go ahead. But be prepared for the consequences."
Yuan released Gu Kecheng the next moment and wiped his hands on his suit, as though he had touched something filthy and wanted to clean them.

Officer Mei watched the entire exchange with a nonchalant expression. Since Gu Kecheng had made the first move, she did not blame Yuan for retaliating. And because their confrontation was nothing more than a minor scuffle, she saw no reason to intervene.
"Let's go." Yuan walked around Ge Kecheng, who could only sit on the ground, his head as red as a tomato.
Ge Kecheng turned to glare at Yuan's back and muttered, "I will make you pay for this humiliation!"
Some time later, Officer Mei brought Yuan to a location with several machines arranged in an orderly fashion.
"You can exchange your points here."
"How many points do you have, Officer Mei?" Yuan asked her out of curiosity.
"Just call me Mei Xiaoyun," she said. "Anyway, I have about a thousand points."
"A thousand points? That sounds like a lot. What rank are you?"
"I'm only at Expert since I don't come here often.
Yuan's eyes widened at her words.
If a single victory earned an average of five points, then she would have needed to win at least two hundred matches to accumulate one thousand points. Yet, she was only ranked Expert.
This made Yuan wonder how many matches he would need to win before reaching Gladiator to fight Wu Wang or Shi Fa.
Yuan turned his attention to the machines a moment later.
"How does it work?" he asked.
"Place your hand into the slot over there," Mei Xiaoyun pointed.
The moment Yuan slotted his hand into the machine, a screen appeared before him.
<Reading Player Status>
<Available Gaia's Points: 50>
<Welcome to Gaia's Exchange, Player Yuan>
[Martial Techniques]
[Cultivation Techniques]
[Cultivation Resources]
[General Resources]
There were several categories, and Yuan slowly looked through each of them one by one.
He started with Martial Techniques, and surprisingly, there were a ton of them. Tens of thousands, in fact.

'There are so many martial techniques, yet every cultivator I have fought so far has used Limitless like an amateur without a single technique... Why is that?' Yuan wondered inwardly, but he quickly realized the problem shortly after when he considered buying one to examine it.

Even the cheapest martial technique costs more than a thousand Gaia Points, and if Mei Xiaoyun—an Expert with over 200 victories—could barely afford one, then the vast majority of players would have no chance of purchasing it.
Yuan looked at the Cultivation Techniques next.
"Wow..." Yuan muttered in surprise at how cheaply the cultivation techniques were sold compared to the martial techniques.

Although there were only around a hundred cultivation techniques, the cheapest cost just one hundred Gaia Points, while the most expensive cost ten thousand. In comparison, the most expensive martial techniques cost a million points.

However, once Yuan thought about it, the pricing made sense. After all, nearly everyone in this world cultivated through Gaia's Cultivation System, making traditional cultivation techniques basically obsolete.
He moved on to Cultivation Resources next, and the first item on the list he noticed was Gaia's Stone.
"A single Gaia's Stone costs only ten points? It's cheaper than I imagined," he muttered aloud.
Hearing this, Mei Xiaoyun said, "That's largely because they are already widely available with limited usage."
"Take a look at the cost of Gaia's Gift," she then said.
Yuan looked through the list until he found Gaia's Gift.
His eyes widened when he saw that a single Gaia's Gift would cost him ten thousand points.
"Ten thousand points! Not only that, but it's the lowest quality!" he exclaimed.
Besides the high cost, Yuan was also surprised to see several tiers of Gaia's Gift available.
[Gaia's Gift: 10,000]
[Superior Gaia's Gift: 75,000]
[Flawless Gaia's Gift: 500,000]
"Hm? What is this Gaia's Blessing that costs two million points? It's double the cost of the most expensive martial technique," Yuan asked when he saw it.
"You need it to reach Rank 9 Cultivation Speed," Mei Xiaoyun explained. "However, nobody has ever reached such a level, and most people do not even surpass Rank 5."

After a slight pause, she continued, "You asked me about the differences between the ranks of Heavenly Refinement, right? Now that I think about it, it was recently proven that the stronger one's physique is, the higher their cultivation speed can improve."
"So even if one with a low-ranking physique consumes Gaia's Gift, it's not guaranteed that their Cultivation Speed would rank up?" Yuan asked.
"That's correct."
"I see..."
After going through Cultivation Resources, Yuan looked in the final catalog, General Resources.
"Hm?"
His eyes suddenly lit up when he recognized some of the names listed, as they were also available in the Nine Heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 2564 Third Ascension
paragraphs: 'T-These treasures! They also exist in the Nine Heavens!' Yuan cried inwardly upon recognizing some of the treasures listed.
This was a huge discovery, as it implied a connection between the Nine Heavens and this world.
Some time later, Yuan removed his hand from the machine and said, "There are some interesting things for sale, but I do not have enough points to purchase the things I want."
"Well, the only way you can get more points is through matches."
"What about earning points from other players, like the fifty points I earned from Gu Kecheng? It would be much faster if I could keep earning them that way," Yuan said.

"There is a limit to how many points you can earn through custom matches, and that limit depends on your rank. At your current rank, you can only earn around one hundred points per year through that method. Also, the system can tell when people are exchanging points through custom matches, which is prohibited and punishable."
"Hm? What about that one guy who offered to pay me 500 points for my technique back there? How would he go about doing that?"
"It just means he'll purchase the items in your stead using his own points. That's how most people do it."
"I see... Well, I have to raise my rank anyway, so I'll earn them through normal matches. What are you going to do while I fight?"

Mei Xiaoyun calmly replied, "Since I am already here, I might as well participate in a few matches, too. Once I am bored, I'll return to my job. Make sure you don't forget about the recruitment, which will happen in five months."
Yuan nodded, "I won't. Then, see you later."
Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun separated after going to their own waiting room.
<You have entered matchmaking for One Above All>
<Opponent Found>
<Your match will begin in one minute>
<Your match will begin now>
<Teleporting to arena in 3... 2.. 1...>
Yuan began his grind in One Above All, participating in match after match without pause.
Since each match lasted anywhere from one to five minutes, Yuan would complete at least thirty matches per hour.
Every opponent he faced in the Novice Rank was between the Third and Fourth Ascension, and due to their lack of combat experience, none of them could even touch Yuan's shadow before being defeated.
It didn't take long before Yuan racked up a high Win Streak.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 51>
<You have earned 5 Gaia Points>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have earned 20 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
<Your cultivation has reached First Level Third Ascension>
<You have reached Warrior Rank>
In just a little over an hour, Yuan achieved his goal of Third Ascension, fulfilling the requirement needed to join the military.
"I reached my goal much faster than I anticipated..." Yuan muttered as he sat on the soft bed in the waiting room.
"Should I keep going and see how much I can improve my cultivation before the recruitment? I doubt many of those attending will be barely meeting the requirements, after all."
After taking a moment to rest, Yuan began his first match as a Warrior.
Unbeknownst to him, his high win streak had caused his matches to start being broadcast in the lobby for everyone to see.

Normally, the lobby displays only broadcast matches from Master Rank and above. However, on rare occasions—such as when someone with outstanding performance, like Yuan, appeared—they would cast a spotlight on them, regardless of their rank.
As a result, Yuan became one of the very few Novices whose matches were displayed for everyone to see.
"Hey... Isn't that the guy who claimed to be on a 10-win streak not long ago?
A few spectators remembered Yuan, recalling his match with Gu Kecheng.
"Heavens! He's beating his opponents with seemingly zero effort! And what kind of movement technique is he using?!"

Those who were unfamiliar with Yuan were immediately captivated by his fighting style, especially his movement technique that allowed him to vanish and appear anywhere at will, almost as if he could teleport on demand.
"Hey... that technique..."
Although most spectators present were unfamiliar with Yuan's movement technique, a few immediately recognized it.
"That fucking idiot! Which Division does he belong to?! Isn't he aware that we're strictly forbidden from using that technique in public?!"
"There's no way he doesn't know the rules. He's definitely doing it on purpose!"
One of them suddenly rushed to the reception desk and shoved a badge in front of the worker.
"Who is the Warrior-ranked player being broadcast on Display 2 right now?"
The worker initially wore a puzzled expression, but the moment he saw the badge—one issued only to military personnel—his demeanor immediately turned serious.
"Give me a moment to check!"
A few moments later, the worker said, "That player is named Yuan, and he signed up only a few hours ago today!"
"Which Division does he belong to?!" The soldier immediately inquired.
"Uhh... he doesn't appear to belong to the military," said the worker when he couldn't see Yuan's affiliation.
'What?! That's impossible! How's he using a technique that's only accessible to us?!' The soldier cried inwardly after learning that Yuan was a mere civilian.
"Check again!" The soldier demanded, not willing to believe that a civilian could learn their technique. One of their most difficult to learn, to the boot.
"You can come back here to check yourself if you don't believe me," said the worker while shaking his head. "He really doesn't belong to the military, and there's no way to hide that information."
The soldier gritted his teeth in frustration. After all, he knew better than anyone that it was impossible for a soldier to conceal their identity.

'Are you telling me that a civilian somehow gained access to Void Control and even mastered it to a level that most senior soldiers cannot achieve?!' the soldier cried inwardly, the shock so overwhelming that his entire body went numb.

sentences.text: 'T-These treasures!
They also exist in the Nine Heavens!' Yuan cried inwardly upon recognizing some of the treasures listed.
This was a huge discovery, as it implied a connection between the Nine Heavens and this world.
Some time later, Yuan removed his hand from the machine and said, "There are some interesting things for sale, but I do not have enough points to purchase the things I want."
"Well, the only way you can get more points is through matches."
"What about earning points from other players, like the fifty points I earned from Gu Kecheng?
It would be much faster if I could keep earning them that way," Yuan said.
"There is a limit to how many points you can earn through custom matches, and that limit depends on your rank.
At your current rank, you can only earn around one hundred points per year through that method.
Also, the system can tell when people are exchanging points through custom matches, which is prohibited and punishable."
"Hm?
What about that one guy who offered to pay me 500 points for my technique back there?
How would he go about doing that?"
"It just means he'll purchase the items in your stead using his own points.
That's how most people do it."
"I see...
Well, I have to raise my rank anyway, so I'll earn them through normal matches.
What are you going to do while I fight?"
Mei Xiaoyun calmly replied, "Since I am already here, I might as well participate in a few matches, too.
Once I am bored, I'll return to my job.
Make sure you don't forget about the recruitment, which will happen in five months."
Yuan nodded, "I won't.
Then, see you later."
Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun separated after going to their own waiting room.

Yuan began his grind in One Above All, participating in match after match without pause.
Since each match lasted anywhere from one to five minutes, Yuan would complete at least thirty matches per hour.
Every opponent he faced in the Novice Rank was between the Third and Fourth Ascension, and due to their lack of combat experience, none of them could even touch Yuan's shadow before being defeated.
It didn't take long before Yuan racked up a high Win Streak.

I doubt many of those attending will be barely meeting the requirements, after all."
After taking a moment to rest, Yuan began his first match as a Warrior.
Unbeknownst to him, his high win streak had caused his matches to start being broadcast in the lobby for everyone to see.
Normally, the lobby displays only broadcast matches from Master Rank and above.
However, on rare occasions—such as when someone with outstanding performance, like Yuan, appeared—they would cast a spotlight on them, regardless of their rank.
As a result, Yuan became one of the very few Novices whose matches were displayed for everyone to see.
"Hey...
Isn't that the guy who claimed to be on a 10-win streak not long ago?
A few spectators remembered Yuan, recalling his match with Gu Kecheng.
"Heavens!
He's beating his opponents with seemingly zero effort!
And what kind of movement technique is he using?!"

Those who were unfamiliar with Yuan were immediately captivated by his fighting style, especially his movement technique that allowed him to vanish and appear anywhere at will, almost as if he could teleport on demand.
"Hey... that technique..."
Although most spectators present were unfamiliar with Yuan's movement technique, a few immediately recognized it.
"That fucking idiot!
Which Division does he belong to?!
Isn't he aware that we're strictly forbidden from using that technique in public?!"
"There's no way he doesn't know the rules.
He's definitely doing it on purpose!"
One of them suddenly rushed to the reception desk and shoved a badge in front of the worker.
"Who is the Warrior-ranked player being broadcast on Display 2 right now?"
The worker initially wore a puzzled expression, but the moment he saw the badge—one issued only to military personnel—his demeanor immediately turned serious.
"Give me a moment to check!"
A few moments later, the worker said, "That player is named Yuan, and he signed up only a few hours ago today!"
"Which Division does he belong to?!" The soldier immediately inquired.
"Uhh... he doesn't appear to belong to the military," said the worker when he couldn't see Yuan's affiliation.
'What?!
That's impossible!
How's he using a technique that's only accessible to us?!' The soldier cried inwardly after learning that Yuan was a mere civilian.
"Check again!" The soldier demanded, not willing to believe that a civilian could learn their technique.
One of their most difficult to learn, to the boot.

"He really doesn't belong to the military, and there's no way to hide that information."

'Are you telling me that a civilian somehow gained access to Void Control and even mastered it to a level that most senior soldiers cannot achieve?!' the soldier cried inwardly, the shock so overwhelming that his entire body went numb.

chapters.title: Chapter 2565 100th Win Streak
paragraphs: "Hey." The soldier glared at the worker and demanded, "Restrict and remove all records of Player Yuan's matches."
"T-That would be a little..." The worker hesitated.
Even if the man was a soldier, unless he had enough authority, he couldn't make such demands.
The soldier shoved his badge into the worker's face and said, "Look closely again."
The worker narrowed his eyes at the badge.
The moment he recognized the rank engraved on it, his eyes widened in shock.
"M-My apologies! I will carry out your command immediately!"
A few moments later, the display broadcasting Yuan's match suddenly vanished, replaced by another, leaving the spectators confused.
"What the heck? What happened to that guy's match?"
"The only time a match is removed in the middle of a fight is when the workers deliberately change the display."
"Why would they do that? What was wrong with his match?"
Displeased by this, some of the spectators went to complain to the workers.
"Hey! Why'd you cut off Player Yuan's match? There are a lot of people watching that!"
"I apologize for the inconvenience, but it was requested by a soldier," said the worker with an apologetic bow.
"A soldier...?"
The man turned and spotted the soldier who had requested the removal walking away in the distance.
"W-Wu Wang?!" he exclaimed in shock, unable to understand why someone so powerful had intervened.
A few moments later, Wu Wang returned to his colleague, who immediately inquired, "So, which Division does that asshole belong to?"
Wu Wang shook his head and responded, still with a doubtful look on his face, "Apparently, he doesn't belong to the military."
"What?! That's impossible!" Shi Fa exclaimed in disbelief, reacting similarly to Wu Wang minutes ago.
"I don't know how he's acquired the technique, but this has some serious implications," said Wu Wang with a deep frown on his face.
The only way for a civilian to acquire a technique restricted to the military was for a soldier to share it with them, and such a crime could be punishable by death.
"What now?" Shi Fa asked a moment later.
"We can only wait for him to come out to question him," said Wu Wang.
"Should we contact our supervisor?"
"No... Let us handle this ourselves for now. If it turns out that we truly have a leaker, we will deal with it then."
Thus, the two of them started waiting for Yuan. Unbeknownst to them, they'd be standing there for a long time.
Meanwhile, completely unaware of this, Yuan continued fighting in matches.
For his first match as an Expert, Yuan faced a Fifth Ascension cultivator for the first time.
'Oh?'
Yuan was pleasantly surprised when his opponent did not immediately bombard him with large, powerful attacks from the get-go and instead spent time analyzing him.
However, they lacked patience, and when Yuan did not act for a few minutes, they attacked without learning anything from him.
'At least they are not attacking at random...' Yuan thought as he evaded their attacks with precise, skillful movements, weaving between them like the wind.
'Who the heck is this guy?! He's dodging all of my attacks with ease!' Yuan's opponent cried inwardly.
He knew something was wrong when his opponent, as an Expert, was a mere Third Ascension, but he could've never anticipated Yuan would be so skillful.
'His movements are similar to those of Gladiator rank! How the hell is he only at Third Ascension?!'

Although he felt pressured, the Fifth Ascension cultivator fought with everything he had. Yet, no matter how much effort he put into his attacks, he could not even catch Yuan's shadow, let alone touch him.
He also tried using large-scale attacks that were impossible to dodge, but Yuan would vanish into thin air right before his attack would've struck him.
"What?! Where did he—"

Before the Fifth Ascension cultivator could even realize what had happened, his vision blurred for a split second. The next moment, he found himself back in the waiting room, staring at a defeat screen.
Of course, his neck was burning, feeling like he had just had his head chopped off.
"Replay the match for me!
The man shouted loudly. Shortly after, another screen appeared before him, replaying his entire match just now.
After watching his match to the end, the man finally realized what had caused his defeat, but he was still puzzled by Yuan's movement technique.
"What technique is that?! Did he acquire it from the exchange? No, there's no way he could afford such a profound technique at his rank! He must have come from an influential family!"

The only logical reason for an abnormal existence like Yuan's was that he'd come from a powerful family, allowing him to acquire techniques and training that were far beyond the level of an ordinary civilian.

As the day went on, Yuan continued fighting matches nonstop. He'd hoped to reach at least Fourth Ascension by the end of the day, but he realized that after reaching Third Ascension, his cultivation had stopped improving as fast.
Still, he'd managed to reach the fourth level.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 100>
<You have earned 5 Gaia Points>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have earned 20 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
<Your cultivation has reached Fourth Level Third Ascension>
Yuan intended to continue until he experienced his first lost, but when he attempted to start his 101st match, he was stopped by a certain notification.
<You have reached your match limit for the month>
"What? I can only do a hundred matches a month?"
Yuan wanted to be surprised, but he immediately understood why there was such a limit.
'If there wasn't a limit, everyone's cultivation would be much more inflated,' he thought to himself.
However, rather than leaving, Yuan decided to remain inside the waiting room to study Limitless, completely unaware that there were people waiting for him outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 2566 Definitely Not Me
paragraphs: "Fuck! How long does he intend to fight?! It's been two weeks now!" Wu Wang cursed out loud as his patience started to run thin.
"At the rate he was winning matches, he should've reached the 100-match limit long ago," Shi Fa muttered out loud, looking confused. "Let's wait a little longer. He's probably taking a break."
However, even after an entire month, Yuan remained nowhere to be seen.
"That little fucker! Did he sneak out while we weren't looking?!" Wu Wang exclaimed, aggressively tapping his foot on the ground.
"There's no way. We haven't left since we started waiting for him, so he's definitely still inside. Don't tell me that he waited an entire month inside for the monthly reset?" Shi Fa sighed out loud.
Although such cases were uncommon, it was not unheard of.
"Damn it... What now? It's not like we have unlimited time here, either. Hell, we have to go back to base next month!" Wu Wang gritted his teeth.
"We can only hope for him to come out before we have to return to base... or we'd have to report the situation to our supervisors," Shi Fa shook his head.
While they could have gone to their supervisor immediately, the main reason they haven't yet is that they want the credits to themselves.
"Wait. I have an idea."
Shi Fa said.
"What is it?"
"Wait right here. I will be right back."
Without elaborating, Shi Fa left the scene.
Meanwhile, Yuan continued to matchmake as soon as the monthly limit was reset.

However, instead of finishing each match within minutes, Yuan decided to take his time over the next hundred matches. After all, there was no reason to burn through all of his matches in a single day when he could prolong them while experimenting with and training his control over Limitless.
"Hm? Third Ascension?"
Yuan's opponent raised his eyebrows in a surprised manner.
"You must be that monster from the rumors," he remarked, as if he recognized Yuan.
"What rumors?" Yuan asked with an intrigued expression.

"There's been a certain rumor going around Gaia's Sanctum over the past month. According to it, there is a Third Ascension cultivator who is not only ranked Expert but also possesses combat skills rivaling even those of a Gladiator," his opponent explained.
"Surely, that rumor must be referring to you."
"That's definitely not me then," Yuan calmly replied, dumbfounding his opponent, who was certain that he would admit to it.

Before his opponent could respond, Yuan continued, "Although I am indeed at the Third Ascension, my combat experience far surpasses that of a mere Gladiator. Therefore, I am not the one being mentioned in the rumor."
His opponent stared at him in stunned silence, as though he had never encountered anyone so arrogant before.
Although he wanted to keep chatting, the match had begun.
"I will determine for myself whether your ability surpasses a Gladiator!"
"Unfortunately, you're not qualified."
Instead of avoiding, Yuan began attacking from the very start for the first time. However, he made sure to control his strength.

Although his cultivation was far inferior to that of his Fifth Ascension opponent, Yuan had already proven that even his reserves of Limitless were enough to defeat them. This was largely because his opponents did not know how to protect themselves with Limitless, essentially fighting as though they were naked.
Of course, these people did not temper their bodies either. In other words, the people of this world possessed immense potential, yet they were wasting it due to their lack of experience.
At first glance, their cultivation and world appeared incredibly advanced, but the more Yuan learned about them, the more he realized how weak they truly were.
However, this didn't mean Yuan looked down on them. After all, he knew that there were some capable people in this world, such as Wu Wang and Shi Fa.
Unfortunately, he was restricted from their world and secrets until he joined the military.

'H-How is he wielding so much Limitless without exhausting himself?! He has been expending Limitless since the beginning of the match, and more than half an hour has already passed!' the Fifth Ascension cultivator cried inwardly as he barely dodged Yuan's attacks.

'Not only that, but his attacks are incredibly deceiving! While they are small and appear weak at first glance, they are ridiculously destructive, possessing more power than anything someone at his cultivation level should be capable of!'

The Fifth Ascension cultivator had doubted the rumors from the very beginning, but he was now shocked to the core, as the truth turned out to be far more terrifying than the rumors, which had made Yuan seem like a mostly defensive fighter who spent the majority of his time evading attacks.
Eventually, after running out of Limitless and stamina, the Fifth Ascension cultivator fell to his knees.
He lifted his head to look at Yuan with a defeated look.
"You were right... I was not... qualified..." he muttered in a low voice before his vision blurred, and he was sent back to the waiting room.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 101>
<You have earned 5 Gaia Points>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have earned 50 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
'Limitless... What a unique energy,' Yuan thought to himself as he stared at his palm.
Now that he was actually using Limitless, he could accurately compare it to the other energy.
"If I had to compare it with something similar, it would be Chaotic Essence... but for humans," he thought out loud.
While it was not as destructive as Chaotic Essence, which was the main reason why humans could not cultivate it, it was just as powerful.
Some time later, Yuan started another matchmaking.

Meanwhile, the Fifth Ascension cultivator left his waiting room and returned to the lobby after spending some time contemplating his match with Yuan. However, right as he returned to the lobby, two individuals stepped in front of him and blocked his path.
"G-Gladiator Wu and Gladiator Shi!"
The Fifth Ascension cultivator's eyes widened with shock as he immediately recognized the two standing before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2567 The Gladiators' Message
paragraphs: "H-How can I help you, Gladiator Wu, Gladiator Shi?"
The Fifth Ascension cultivator bowed respectfully before the two soldiers.
But even if Wu Wang and Shi Fa weren't ranked in the top 500 in One Above All, the Fifth Ascension cultivator would still have shown the same level of respect because of their status as soldiers.
"You just fought with Player Yuan, correct?" Wu Wang questioned with a serious face.
"Player Yuan...? Oh, you mean that Third Ascension monster? Yes, I just had a match with him. Is something wrong?"
"No, it's nothing. You may leave," Wu Wang said, immediately beckoning him to leave.
"Huh?"

The Fifth Ascension cultivator wore a puzzled expression on his face after being dismissed so quickly. Admittedly, he wanted to continue talking with them a little longer since they were his idols. However, not wanting to be a nuisance, he nodded and left.
'What was that about?' he wondered inwardly as he left.
"That bastard is really still fighting inside!" Wu Wang gritted his teeth in frustration after confirming that Yuan was still inside.
He turned to Shi Fa and asked, "What is your plan now? Although it's great that we've confirmed his presence inside, it is not as though we can forcefully kick him out."
Although they had the authority to remove Yuan's matches from the lobby displays, that was the extent of their power.
"Since we know he is currently Expert-ranked, we can deliberately send other Experts into the matches. If they encounter him, we can have them relay our message on our behalf," Shi Fa said.
"Wait! That's actually genius! Why didn't we think of that sooner?!" Wu Wang's eyes lit up with excitement.
Thus, they started gathering as many Experts that were present in the lobby. Given their status as soldiers and their rank, everyone listened to their instructions without issue.
To make things more efficient, they went to the reception, where they had the workers broadcast their recruitment.
About an hour later, a little over a thousand Experts gathered before Wu Wang and Shi Fa.

"Alright, listen up, everyone. We need to contact someone currently fighting inside One Above All, so we would like you to matchmake until you find him. This person goes by Player Yuan, a Third Ascension cultivator. You should immediately recognize him since he's probably the only one with such a low cultivation at that rank.
The Experts immediately started mumbling to each other.
"There's a Third Ascension at our rank? Who's this Player Yuan?"
"He must be the one from the rumors that started spreading about a month ago."
"Oh, I've heard about him, too. I thought it was exaggerated and fake when I first heard about it, though."
Not everyone recognized Yuan, but many of them had because of the rumors.
"We're not asking you to do this for free, either. Whoever relays the message to him will receive 100 points, as well as a training session with one of us," Shi Fa added.

When the Experts heard this, excitement flickered in their eyes. Although one hundred points were already enticing—equivalent to roughly fifty free victories—the most appealing reward was the chance to train with a Gladiator.
Shortly after, Shi Fa revealed their message before sending these Experts inside to begin their matchmake.

"Because I've been sent here to relay a message to you from Gladiator Wu and Gladiator Shi!"
"Gladiator Wu? Gladiator Shi?" Yuan had to think for a moment before finally recalling the two men who resembled Wang Ming and Shi Lang.
"Oh, those two? I don't remember even speaking with them, so why do they have a message for me?" Yuan inquired.
The man cleared his throat before telling Yuan what he had been asked to say, "Player Yuan, you are to stop all matches and return to the lobby immediately."
"That's it?" Yuan asked when the man stopped speaking after a mere sentence.
"That's it."
"They didn't tell you the reason I have to return to the lobby?"
"They did not. Regardless of their reason, they are not only Gladiators, but soldiers too. And when a soldier gives an order, we, as mere civilians, must obey."
"Is that so?" Yuan murmured with a thoughtful expression.
He could not help but wonder why two men he had never met or spoken to would suddenly tell him to stop fighting, even going so far as to send people after him.
After a moment of silence, Yuan nodded and said, "You can tell them that I have received their message."
"Good. Then let's—"
Before the man could even finish his sentence, Yuan vanished from his view, and a second later, he was back inside the waiting room with a defeated message staring back at him.
"W-What?!" the man exclaimed in shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 2568 The Gladiators' Message(2)
paragraphs: After losing his match to Yuan before he could even react, the man left the waiting room to notify Wu Wang and Shi Fa of the good news.
"Gladiator Wu! Gladiator Shi! I've done it! I met with Player Yuan and relayed your message to him!" he said with a prideful look on his face.
"Finally!" Wu Wang excitedly clenched his fists at the news.
And over the next several minutes, they waited for Yuan to leave matchmaking and return to the lobby.
However, when over ten minutes had passed and Yuan was nowhere to be seen, Wu Wang glared at the man and spoke in a cold voice, "If you think we're fools..."

"N-No! I swear on my mother that I am not lying to you! I really matched with Player Yuan and told him the message—word for word!" The man hastily shook his hand, swearing that he was telling the truth and nothing but the truth.
"Then where the hell is Player Yuan?!" Wu Wang angrily shouted.
"It's possible that our message had scared him into hiding," Shi Fa suddenly said.
"What? That's so pointless! Unless he intends to stay inside for the rest of his life, he will have to surrender himself eventually, so why drag this out?"
"Who knows? But we can only continue waiting for him to come out right now..."
Meanwhile, Yuan continued to matchmake despite receiving the Gladiators' message.
'I don't know what sort of business they have with me, but if they can't even tell me the reason, they can wait for me to finish this month's limit,' Yuan said to himself.
Several matches later, Yuan encountered another opponent who had been sent by the Gladiators to relay their message to him.
Since there was no way for these people to know that someone had already spoken to Yuan, they could only keep going until they either gave up willingly or found Yuan.
"Player Yuan! I have a message for you from Gladiator Shi and Gladiator Wu, who are waiting for you in the lobby outside! You are to stop all matches and return to the lobby immediately."
"Is that so? Let them know that I have received their message," Yuan repeated what he said to the last guy.
Then, he defeated his opponent and continued matchmaking for the next round.
Meanwhile, the one who just fought Yuan returned to the two outside with a grin on her face.
"Gladiators! I have encountered Player Yuan and relayed your message to him!" she proudly declared.
However, the two only frowned at her words, confirming their suspicion that Yuan was still inside and deliberately avoiding them.
"Wait a second!" The man who'd found Yuan first suddenly said. "I was the first to relay the message to him!"
The woman sneered at his words and replied, "If that were the case, then why was Player Yuan still inside, even matching with me? Because you didn't really encounter him."
She refused to believe the man's claim, even calling him a liar outright.
"Bullshit! I really did meet him! He is just refusing to come out for some reason!" The man exclaimed, defending himself.
"Just you wait! He won't come out!"
"He will!"
"He won't!"
Sure enough, just like the man had predicted, Yuan was nowhere to be seen even after ten minutes of waiting.
"No way..." The woman fell to the ground, dazed.
"What did I tell you?" The man sneered.
Then, he turned to look at the Gladiators and asked, "Um... about the reward."
Wu Wang narrowed his eyes at the man but said nothing.
Seeing this, Shi Fa spoke, "Since we cannot really confirm whether or not anyone here has actually encountered him until he comes out, we will delay the rewards until we can."
"I understand..."
Although the man was disappointed, there was nothing he could do but keep on waiting.
Over the next several days, more and more people would encounter Yuan and relay the Gladiators' message to him, unaware that others had already done so.
Of course, Yuan would always reply with the same words.
"Let them know that I have received their message."
Eventually, after nearly two weeks of fighting after the monthly reset, Yuan reached his second limit.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 200>
<You have earned 5 Gaia Points>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have earned 50 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
<Your cultivation has reached Ninth Level Third Ascension>
"Now then... now that I have reached the monthly limit and amassed plenty of points, it's about time that I take a break."
Yuan calmly left the waiting room despite knowing what was waiting for him on the other side.
The moment Yuan returned to the lobby, he was met by a large group of people standing outside, surrounding the entrance with enraged expressions.
"T-That's him! He's Player Yuan!"
One of them immediately shouted the second they saw Yuan coming back out.
Then, two figures approached Yuan and stood directly before him, their expressions looking the most angrily out of everyone there.
"Player Yuan, I presume?"
"Indeed. Who's asking?" Yuan asked, pretending not to know them.
"We're the ones who sent these people to relay our message to you!" Wu Wang shouted angrily.
"Oh, Gladiator Wu and Gladiator Shi? How can I help you?" Yuan calmly responded.
"So you did receive our message! Why didn't you come out immediately, as we told you?!"

"Why should I?" Yuan remarked. "My mother always taught me not to listen to strangers, and all I was told was that there were two strangers looking for me. If you were in my shoes, would you come out? Moreover, I only said that I'd received the message, nothing about agreeing to it."
"Are you mocking us right now?" Shi Fa finally joined, a deep frown on his face.

"No, I am dead serious," Yuan replied with a serious expression. "Try to see things from my perspective. Two strangers had sent hundreds of people after you without giving any reason. Wouldn't you also be a little nervous and afraid if you were in my shoes?"
"Anyway, what business do you have with me?" Yuan continued, his complete lack of concern for the situation leaving everyone present speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 2569 Void Control
paragraphs: "This arrogant little..." Wu Wang gritted his teeth in frustration. Despite having his bearing trained in the military, he could barely restrain himself from punching Yuan.
Shi Fa raised his hand in front of Wu Wang and said to Yuan, "Before we talk business, I want to know who here had relayed our message to you first."
Immediately, the man who had encountered Yuan first rushed to the front and said, "It was me, right?!"
However, Yuan shook his head and said, "I don't remember."
"What?! You're lying!" The man shouted while pointing at him with a trembling finger.
Yuan smiled and said, "Fine, if you insist, let's just say it's you."

After a moment of silence, Shi Fa sighed out loud, "Since the situation is like this, rather than just rewarding one person, we will reward everyone who has encountered him before he came out. However, since we don't have that many points to give out, we'll just give everyone here a training session. Anyone displeased by the outcome?"
Everyone present shook their heads.
"Good. Give Wu Wang your information, and we'll reach out to you once we are ready."
"Now then... You, follow me." Shi Fa glared at Yuan.
Yuan didn't make things difficult for him any longer and quietly followed him.
Some time later, Yuan entered a private room with Shi Fa.
After closing the door, Shi Fa turned to face Yuan with a serious expression.
"I will get straight to the point. Who did you learn that technique from?" Shi Fa questioned.
Yuan raised an eyebrow, looking genuinely puzzled by his question, "Excuse me?"
"You heard me!"
"I don't know which technique you're referring to."
"Are you still playing dumb?! There's only one technique I am talking about—the one that a civilian like you shouldn't possess!"
Yuan frowned and responded in an irritated tone, "Can you stop being so damn vague and tell me the name of this technique because I really have no idea what you're talking about?
"Void Control! I am talking about Void Control!" Shi Fa exclaimed angrily.
"Void... Control?"
Yuan was unfamiliar with the name of this technique, but he knew of one with a similar name.
'Is he talking about Void Manipulation? So it's a technique that's only accessible by the military, huh?'
"I think there's been a misunderstanding," Yuan said a moment later. "The technique you think is Void Control is called Void Manipulation. And quite frankly, it's technically not even a technique."
"What are you talking about? Of course it's a technique!" Shi Fa replied with a deep frown.
However, Yuan then said, "Regardless of whether it's a technique or not, I didn't learn this technique from anyone."
"Are you claiming that you discovered and learned it all by yourself? Do you really expect me to believe that?"
Of course, Yuan didn't discover Void Manipulation alone. However, since telling the truth would only complicate things, he decided to lie.
"Well, I am a genius," Yuan replied in a bragging tone.

Shi Fa narrowed his eyes at Yuan and spoke, "If you aren't aware, a civilian possessing this technique is strictly prohibited, regardless of how you acquired it, and if we report you, there's a good chance you'll be executed."
"Is that a threat?" Yuan asked.
"No, it's the law and your reality in the near future. However, if you tell us who gave you the technique, we'll put in a good word for you and avoid the death penalty."
"So what you're saying is, as long as I join the military, everything will be fine? That's great, since I plan on joining during the next recruitment."
"That... That's not how things work!" Shi Fa exclaimed.
The door suddenly opened, and Wu Wang, who had just finished with his business outside, walked inside.
"Did you learn how he acquired Void Control yet?" Wu Wang asked as he closed the door behind him.
Shi Fa shook his head and sighed aloud, "He claims to have discovered the technique by himself."
"Hah!" Wu Wang immediately sneered loudly. "He discovered the technique himself? Even a monkey can make more believable lies!"
He turned to look at Yuan with narrowed eyes and continued in a cold voice, "If he won't willingly tell us, we can beat it out of him.
Wu Wang approached Yuan with a wide grin.
However, Shi Fa quickly stopped him and said, "Even if he's committed a crime, we cannot harm a civilian if he's not an active threat, unless you're also trying to get in trouble."
"Then what do you suggest?" Wu Wang asked.
"I have a suggestion," Yuan suddenly said.
"Huh? Who the hell is asking you?" Wu Wang sneered.
"Let's hear it." Shi Fa said.
"Let's play a game. If you win, I will tell you how I acquired the technique. However, if you lose, you'll forget about the whole thing."
"A game...?" Shi Fa raised his eyebrows with a puzzled face.
"Have you ever played tag before?"
"I have."
"Good. Then in a custom game, we'll be playing tag. However, we can only use Void Control—unless you cannot use it."
"Of course I can use Void Control," Shi Fa said.

"In that case, what do you say? If you don't want to play, you can just go ahead and report me. I highly doubt I'll get the death penalty, though. Hell, just to make things even more entertaining, I'll make it two on one."
Shi Fa turned to look at Wu Wang and asked using voice transmission, "What do you think of his proposal?"
"Why not?"
To Shi Fa's surprise, Wu Wang actually wanted to play.
"We just need to catch him, right? Even if his Void Control is stronger than ours, there's no way he can defeat both of us at once!" Wu Wang continued with a confident smile.
"Also, if we form a contract, he won't be able to back out of his own words. In other words, it's a win-win for us."
"Alright."
Shi Fa then said to Yuan, "We'll play your little game."

In other words, it's a win-win for us."
"Alright."
Shi Fa then said to Yuan, "We'll play your little game."

chapters.title: Chapter 2570 Tag
paragraphs: "We'll make the contract," Wu Wang said.
A few moments later—
<You have been offered to sign a contract by 'Wu Wang'>

[Contract Details: Wu Wang and Shi Fa will play 'tag' with you in a custom match. If you lose, you will reveal to them every detail pertaining to how you acquired 'Void Control'. If you win, they will no longer question you, nor report you to the military, and let you go.]
[Breaking the contract will result in penalties]
<Do you accept the contract?>
<Accepted>
"Great. Now let's get started," said Wu Wang.
Yuan then said, "I should have asked earlier, but is it possible to have 2-on-1 custom matches?"
"Yes, it's possible, as long as we do it for Last One Standing."
They left the room shortly after and made their way straight to the entrance for Last One Standing.
"Don't even think about running away," Wu Wang warned him.
Yuan silently shrugged before entering the waiting room.
A few minutes later, he received a custom match offer.
<Player Wu Wang(Grandmaster) and Player Shi Fa(Grandmaster) has sent you a match request for Last Man Standing>
<Win Condition: N/A> <Lose Condition: N/A>
[Player: Wu Wang]
[Cultivation: Second Level Sixth Ascension]
[One Above All: Gladiator]
[One Above All Highest Win Streak: 122]
[Last Man Standing: Grandmaster]
[Last Man Standing Highest Win Streak: 5]
[Endless Assault: Round 30]
[Player: Shi Fa]
[Cultivation: Third Level Sixth Ascension]
[One Above All: Gladiator]
[One Above All Highest Win Streak: 131]
[Last Man Standing: Grandmaster]
[Last Man Standing Highest Win Streak: 5]
[Endless Assault: Round 31]
Meanwhile, Shi Fa and Wu Wang were left speechless by Yuan's player record.
[Player: Yuan]
[Cultivation: Ninth Level Third Ascension]
[One Above All Rank: Expert]
[One Above All Highest Win Streak: 200]
"This bastard actually has a 200-win streak!" Wu Wang could hardly believe his eyes.
A few moments later, the three of them were teleported to the arena—a massive 500-mile-long round platform seated in the middle of a colossal colosseum.

Since Last Man Standing was designed for one hundred people to fight simultaneously, the arena seemed far too spacious for only three participants. However, considering they were about to play tag, it was the perfect setting.
"So, let's make this clear. The moment either of us touches you, it's our win," Shi Fa said.
Yuan nodded, "Sure."
"What about the time limit?" Wu Wang asked.
"I'll let you decide."
"You'll regret it."
"Try me."
Shi Fa and Wu Wang spent the next minute discussing the time limit with each other.
Eventually, Wu Wang said, "Since we don't want to bully you, we'll make the time limit 15 minutes."
"Fifteen... minutes?" Yuan muttered with a dumbfounded look on his face after hearing it.
"What? Is it too long? Well, too bad." Wu Wang smiled.
"Hahaha!" Yuan suddenly burst out laughing.
"No, I am fine with fifteen minutes," he continued as he wiped the tears in his eyes.
The reason Yuan allowed them to set the time limit was that he anticipated they would give themselves less time than they would have received had he set it himself.
However, in Wu Wang and Shi Fa's eyes, fifteen minutes was already more than enough time. Continuously using Void Control rapidly drained one's energy, and Yuan would be facing two opponents at once.
"In that case, we will start at your signal," Shi Fa said.
"The moment you use Void Control, we will begin."
Yuan nodded.
After a few seconds of stillness, Yuan suddenly vanished into thin air.
A split second later, both Wu Wang and Shi Fa also disappeared, chasing after Yuan.
Yuan appeared about half a mile away a second later, and the two soldiers swiftly appeared beside him half a second later.
However, before they could even start reaching for him, Yuan vanished into the void again.
'He's fast! Much faster than what we witnessed before!' Shi Fa quickly realized that they had been underestimating Yuan.
"He's faster than before. Instead of going after him simultaneously, we'll go at intervals," Wu Wang said.
Shi Fa nodded in agreement. "I'll go first."
Once Yuan reappeared, Shi Fa chased after him.
The moment Yuan vanished again, Wu Wang made his move.
The two continued this pattern for the next five minutes. Yet, even after using Void Control more than a hundred times, neither of them came close to tagging Yuan.
'Fuck! This is bad!' Shi Fa cried inwardly.
Even though they still had ten minutes remaining, the rate at which they were exhausting their energy meant they realistically had only another five minutes before they ran out completely.
After another two minutes, both Wu Wang and Shi Fa noticeably slowed down.
'How is he not slowing down at all?!' Wu Wang cried inwardly.
Logically, Yuan—whose cultivation was far inferior to theirs—should have been exhausting himself much faster. But somehow, he did not appear tired in the slightest.
Suddenly, Yuan teleported right behind Wu Wang and spoke, "Do you know why I laughed?"
"You!"
Wu Wang quickly swung around to tag him, but Yuan had vanished already.
"Because I was expecting you to give yourselves a couple of hours to tag me."
Yuan's voice resounded right behind Wu Wang again.
Shi Fa tried to tag him from behind this time but failed.
"If this is all you've got, you'll never tag me even if I gave you a lifetime to try," Yuan said.
After hearing his provocation, Wu Wang and Shi Fa stopped caring about their strategy and started chasing him together.
However, they quickly realized something was different—something had changed.
'I...I cannot sense where he's going anymore!' Shi Fa's eyes widened with shock as he halted and stared at the empty space before him.
Wu Wang also froze when he could no longer sense Yuan.
"What did he do?! How come I cannot sense him anymore?!" Wu Wang exclaimed in disbelief.
"I don't know... I have never seen this before," Shi Fa shook his head, looking just as puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 2571 Limitless Cultivation Technique
paragraphs: "Are you sure you want to stand there and waste time? You have... two minutes left to catch me," Yuan said.

Wu Wang and Shi Fa gritted their teeth in frustration. Even though they knew they had no chance of catching him at this point, they didn't just want to give up and used whatever little energy they had left to chase after Yuan.
Unfortunately, not only were they exhausted, but they couldn't even sense Yuan after he disappeared into the void, almost as if he vanished from existence completely.
Two minutes... one minute... thirty seconds...
"And... time's up," Yuan said to them as he calmly emerged from the void, looking completely fine.
Meanwhile, both Wu Wang and Shi Fa were soaked in sweat and panting like dogs, completely out of breath.
"How... How is that possible?" Wu Wang questioned with a puzzled frown.
"What are you talking about?" Yuan asked.
"How come we cannot sense you when you use Void Control? We have never seen anything like that before," he elaborated on his own confusion.
However, Yuan smiled and said, "I would tell you... But that would break the contract, as you're no longer allowed to question me regarding the technique."
"T-That's...!" Wu Wang opened his mouth to respond but quickly closed it again without uttering another word.
Shi Fa patted Wu Wang shoulder and shook his head, "Forget it."
He then turned to Yuan and spoke, "Since you've won, we will pretend to have seen nothing, nor will we report you to the military."
"But I must ask... are you really planning on joining the military?"
Since Shi Fa's question had nothing to do with the contract, Yuan answered truthfully, "I am, and I will be at the next recruitment."
"Is that so?" Shi Fa mumbled.
A few moments later, Shi Fa and Wu Wang abandoned the match and left Gaia's Sanctum without speaking another word to Yuan.
Now that he was alone and had narrowly avoided trouble, Yuan left the waiting room and made his way to the exchange machines to spend his Gaia Points.
Despite having a two-hundred-win streak, Yuan had only managed to accumulate a little over six thousand and five hundred points.
'Is it even possible to obtain enough points for the most expensive items through matches alone?' Yuan wondered as he went to look at the cultivation techniques category.
After reviewing the list of cultivation techniques again, Yuan purchased one for 1,000 points rather than the cheapest option.
<Confirm Purchase of Limitless Cultivation Technique(1) for 1,000 Gaia Points>
<Confirmed>
<You have purchased Limitless Cultivation Technique(1)>
Rather than acquiring a physical manual for the technique, it was directly transferred into his mind.
'As I thought... this technique allows humans to cultivate Limitless in the traditional method without the system!' Yuan smiled inwardly after reading through its contents.

Although this technique may be pointless to the cultivators of this world who solely rely on Gaia's Cultivation System, Yuan wanted to bring it back to the Nine Heavens and see if the humans of his world could cultivate Limitless through it.
However, there was one major problem.
The Limitless Cultivation Technique he had just purchased for a thousand points was only one part of several available ones. In fact, there were three other parts, all available on the exchange.
Yet, as far as he could tell, he didn't need the other three parts to start cultivating Limitless.
'What will change with the other parts?' Yuan wondered inwardly.
Unfortunately, the next part required 10,000 points, and he had only a little over 5,000 left.
"Hm? Wait a second..."
Yuan suddenly thought of something.
'Although I am limited to a hundred matches a month... does it apply to every single mode, or is it simply just One Above All?'
Yuan approached a worker and asked, "If I have reached my monthly match limit for One Above All, does it affect the others, such as Last Man Standing?
"No, each mode has its own limit, so if you finish all hundred matches for One Above All, you can still do another hundred matches for Last Man Standing," replied the worker.
Yuan's eyes widened at this new information, kicking himself inwardly for not asking earlier, as he could've earned many more points by now.
"Thank you."
Without wasting any more time, Yuan immediately made his way to Last Man Standing, as he still had about two weeks before his monthly reset for One Above All.
<You have entered matchmaking for Last Man Standing>
While he waited for matchmaking, Yuan recalled what Mei Xiaoyun had told him about the mode, where a hundred players fought in an arena until only one remained.
<Your match will begin now>
<Teleporting to arena in 3...2...1...>
A moment later, Yuan found himself back in the colosseum where he played tag with Wu Wang and Shi Fa not long ago. But instead of only three participants, there were a hundred this time.
'Hm?'
Yuan raised an eyebrow when he realized that everyone there was at least in the Fourth Ascension, with a few even in the Fifth Ascension.

Since his ranking in One Above All does not carry over to other modes, he should be unranked right now, so it was a bit surprising to see so many cultivators who would be in Expert rank in One Above All for his first match.
Unbeknownst to Yuan, since Last Man Standing was much more difficult than One Above All, most people tend to wait until they are at least Expert in One Above All before trying the mode.
Regardless, it didn't matter to Yuan.

The match began half a minute after everyone was teleported to the arena. Immediately, it was as though a war had erupted, with dozens of people clashing at once, their Limitless spewing in every direction.
'I should refrain from using Void Manipulation to avoid unnecessary trouble,' Yuan thought to himself, as he did not want more soldiers going after him before the recruitment.

chapters.title: Chapter 2572 Last Man Standing
paragraphs: "Hah!"
"Yah!"

After the match began, it didn't take even a full minute for participants to start dropping. Meanwhile, Yuan, who decided not to use Void Manipulation, used Shadow Veil to completely erase his presence, and with everyone focused on the fight, nobody noticed him even though he was standing still in the middle of the arena.
'If I want to finish a hundred matches in less than a week, I will need to be more active...'
With that in mind, Yuan started going after the easiest targets first—those who had just defeated their opponent and were exhausted—eliminating them in a single strike.
Using such a method, it didn't take long for the number of participants to drop below ten.
Of course, even with so few people left, none of them noticed Yuan.
Eventually, there was only one participant left... or so the man thought.
"Huh? Why am I still here? Everyone should have been defeated!"
The man who thought he had won looked around to make sure he didn't miss anyone, and sure enough, he couldn't see or sense anybody in the arena.
Yet, even after waiting for some time, he was not teleported back to the waiting room. This made him worried that something might have happened with Gaia's Sanctum, and he was stuck inside.

However, he suddenly felt a sharp pain in his chest the next moment. At first, he thought it was stress from the thought of being stuck, but when he subconsciously turned around, his eyes widened with shock and bewilderment.
"H-How the—"
Standing behind him was a handsome man whom he did not recall seeing at any point during the entire match!
But alas, before he could even question it, he was sent back to the waiting room with a defeated message.
While the man watched the replay to see exactly what had happened, Yuan moved on to the next match, repeating the same tactic and winning with ease and little to no effort.
Soon, a new rumor began spreading throughout Gaia's Sanctum, mentioning a ghost who roamed Last Man Standing!

"I'm telling you! That man did not exist until the very end! It's a ghost! A real ghost, I say!" Someone who had managed to make it to the end, only to be killed by Yuan, attested to the rumors' truth.
Mei Xiaoyun, who had just finished her matches and prepared to leave Gaia's Sanctum, stopped when she overheard the rumor.
"Ghost of the Colosseum?" she muttered at the nickname the people had given to Yuan.
"L-Look! He's right there! Ghost of the Colosseum!" Someone shouted, pointing to the display showcasing Last Man Standing.
Curious, Mei Xiaoyun walked over to the screen and watched it.
"Hm? Isn't that..."
Mei Xiaoyun's eyes widened with surprise when she saw a familiar face nonchalantly approaching and defeating his opponents in the arena.
'What's going on? How come everyone is ignoring him, even when he's standing right in their view?' Mei Xiaoyun wondered, curious and baffled at the same time by what she was witnessing.
'No... they're not ignoring him! It's more like they don't even notice him!'
The other spectators were just as baffled—if not even more shocked—by what they were witnessing.

Those who had refused to believe the rumors had no choice but to accept them after seeing the Ghost of the Colosseum firsthand, while those who had spread the rumors felt vindicated, as this proved they had not been exaggerating.
"Surely, this must be some kind of elaborated prank, set up to mess with us..." Someone there muttered in a dazed voice.
"And how would they achieve that? It's not a custom game, so everyone there was randomly chosen by the matchmaking..."
"I don't know, but it's easier to believe that whatever I am seeing right now..."
"Hey, isn't he the same guy who was using that weird movement technique in One Above All?"
Someone there recognized Yuan.
"Who?"
The man proceeded to recall the last rumor about Yuan.
"Seriously, who the hell is this guy?"
Mei Xiaoyun stayed and watched several matches before leaving Gaia's Sanctum, returning to work.
Time passed quickly, and in just five days since he started his first Last Man Standing match, Yuan reached his monthly limit.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 100>
<You have defeated 42 players>
<You have earned 42 Gaia Points>
<You have earned 50 Gaia Points for being the last man standing>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
<You have earned 100 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have reached Third Level Fourth Ascension>
<You have reached Expert Rank>
"Last Man Standing sure gives a lot more points than One Above All," Yuan remarked with a satisfied smile.

In less than a week, Yuan had earned more than twenty thousand points—more than enough to purchase the second part of the Limitless Cultivation Technique, and twenty times what he had earned from One Above All.
However, Yuan did not immediately exchange his points; instead, he went to participate in Endless Assault.
Unlike One Above All and Last Man Standing, since Endless Assault did not involve fighting other players, Yuan was able to start immediately.
<Start Floor 1?>
<Starting Floor 1>
Ten seconds later, Yuan was teleported to a seemingly boundless, empty plain with no walls and a blank sky overhead.
<Enemies will spawn in ten seconds>
Soon, a single enemy appeared.
Yuan raised an eyebrow. His opponent was a faceless, human-shaped entity.
Although it lacked a face, Yuan could tell that it had taken on his appearance, as it possessed the same height and build as him.
As for its cultivation, it was also at Third Level Fourth Ascension, mimicking his own.
"Do I have to fight it barehanded, too?" Yuan wondered out loud.
<You may choose a weapon>
"Oh? In that case, give me a sword."
A moment later, a large sword materialized before him.
A smile tugged at Yuan's lips when he saw its shape. It closely resembled Number One Under Heaven, making him wonder if the system had read his mind and chosen his preferred weapon.
