Mei Xiaoyun's eyes widened with surprise when she saw a familiar face nonchalantly approaching and defeating his opponents in the arena.
'What's going on?
How come everyone is ignoring him, even when he's standing right in their view?' Mei Xiaoyun wondered, curious and baffled at the same time by what she was witnessing.
'No... they're not ignoring him!
It's more like they don't even notice him!'
The other spectators were just as baffled—if not even more shocked—by what they were witnessing.

Those who had refused to believe the rumors had no choice but to accept them after seeing the Ghost of the Colosseum firsthand, while those who had spread the rumors felt vindicated, as this proved they had not been exaggerating.
"Surely, this must be some kind of elaborated prank, set up to mess with us..." Someone there muttered in a dazed voice.
"And how would they achieve that?
It's not a custom game, so everyone there was randomly chosen by the matchmaking..."
"I don't know, but it's easier to believe that whatever I am seeing right now..."
"Hey, isn't he the same guy who was using that weird movement technique in One Above All?"
Someone there recognized Yuan.
"Who?"
The man proceeded to recall the last rumor about Yuan.
"Seriously, who the hell is this guy?"
Mei Xiaoyun stayed and watched several matches before leaving Gaia's Sanctum, returning to work.
Time passed quickly, and in just five days since he started his first Last Man Standing match, Yuan reached his monthly limit.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 100>
<You have defeated 42 players>
<You have earned 42 Gaia Points>
<You have earned 50 Gaia Points for being the last man standing>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
<You have earned 100 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have reached Third Level Fourth Ascension>
<You have reached Expert Rank>
"Last Man Standing sure gives a lot more points than One Above All," Yuan remarked with a satisfied smile.

In less than a week, Yuan had earned more than twenty thousand points—more than enough to purchase the second part of the Limitless Cultivation Technique, and twenty times what he had earned from One Above All.
However, Yuan did not immediately exchange his points; instead, he went to participate in Endless Assault.
Unlike One Above All and Last Man Standing, since Endless Assault did not involve fighting other players, Yuan was able to start immediately.
<Start Floor 1?>
<Starting Floor 1>
Ten seconds later, Yuan was teleported to a seemingly boundless, empty plain with no walls and a blank sky overhead.
<Enemies will spawn in ten seconds>
Soon, a single enemy appeared.
Yuan raised an eyebrow.
His opponent was a faceless, human-shaped entity.
Although it lacked a face, Yuan could tell that it had taken on his appearance, as it possessed the same height and build as him.
As for its cultivation, it was also at Third Level Fourth Ascension, mimicking his own.
"Do I have to fight it barehanded, too?" Yuan wondered out loud.
<You may choose a weapon>
"Oh?
In that case, give me a sword."
A moment later, a large sword materialized before him.
A smile tugged at Yuan's lips when he saw its shape.
It closely resembled Number One Under Heaven, making him wonder if the system had read his mind and chosen his preferred weapon.

chapters.title: Chapter 2573 Come Find Me
paragraphs: <Match Start>
Shortly after acquiring his weapon, the match began.
However, neither Yuan nor his opponent moved.
Yuan wanted to see what his opponent was capable of, but it did not move at all.
Seeing this, Yuan took a step toward it.
The faceless figure also moved, but its movements made Yuan raise his eyebrows in puzzlement, as it moved like a complete amateur.
Yuan assumed it was because he was only on the first floor, so his opponents would all be easy to defeat.
He silently approached the faceless figure using Void Manipulation before defeating it in a single strike, proving his theory to be correct.
<You have cleared the First Floor>
<You have received 10 Gaia Points as a reward>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<Proceed to Second Floor?>
"Proceed."
Not wanting to waste time, Yuan quickly rushed through the floor. As he climbed higher and higher, his opponent would become more skillful and have higher cultivation.
Yet, Yuan completely demolished all of his opponents with a single strike until the 10th floor.
And since he was fighting an artificial being, he used Void Manipulation without reserve.
Of course, there was still a chance his matches might be displayed in the lobby, so he left after defeating the 10th floor to ask about it.
"Endless Assault? No, that mode is the only one that won't be displayed." The worker responded to Yuan's question.
Once his concern was resolved, Yuan returned to climbing Endless Assault with an ease of mind.
In less than an hour, he reached floor twenty-five. Then, after another ten minutes, he reached floor thirty.
At this point, all of his opponents moved like experts, and their cultivation was even at Ninth Level Sixth Ascension.

But despite their superior cultivation, Yuan's combat expertise and techniques were still far superior, allowing him to continue defeating his opponents, albeit with more difficulty and a little more time.
Eventually, he reached the 40th floor.

Yuan's eyes widened with surprise when his opponent from the 40th floor started exuding Eternal Essence even before the match began. Although it was very subtle, it didn't change the fact that he would start fighting opponents who could wield Eternal Essence.
"Now that I think about it, I haven't tried using Eternal Essence in this world yet," Yuan muttered in a low voice, as he'd been focused on Limitless this entire time.
When the match started, Yuan immediately tried to use Eternal Essence.
However, when he tried, a notification popped up before him.
<The usage of Eternal Essence is strictly prohibited>
<Reading the user's status>
<You have been granted temporary access to the usage of Eternal Essence by Gaia>
"What?" Yuan wore a puzzled look on his face, wondering if it meant that he was specifically granted access by Gaia, the creator of the system.
"Am I... being watched by Gaia right now?" Yuan frowned at this thought.
Unfortunately, there was nothing he could realistically do in this situation.
Then, another notification appeared.
<Come Find Me>
Yuan's eyes widened at this notification, which confirmed his suspicion that Gaia could see and hear him through the system.
"Who are you? Are you an Eternal? Why did you bring me to this world?"
However, the system did not respond.
"I know you can hear me!"
<Come Find Me>
The system repeated.
Yuan wanted to keep questioning Gaia, but the match had begun, and his opponent was already attacking him.
"Get lost, I am busy here!" Yuan roared as he unleashed a wave of Eternal Essence at his opponent, defeating them in the blink of an eye.
"Answer me, Gaia! Who are you?!
But alas, Gaia would not respond again, no matter how many times he tried speaking to them.
"Fuck... at least give me a hint or something." Yuan cursed at it and gave up on trying to communicate with Gaia.
With no other choice, Yuan continued to climb the floors.
However, every single floor after the 40th floor greatly increased in difficulty, and the Eternal Essence wielded by his opponents became more profound and powerful.
By the time he reached the 45th floor, his opponent wielded Eternal Essence that was on par with Saaruk during their last fight.
Meanwhile, their cultivation peaked at the 7th Ascension. Of course, now that they were wielding Eternal Essence, their cultivation had become irrelevant.
"Now this is getting really interesting..." Yuan mumbled with an excited smile on his face.
A moment later, they clashed, their Eternal Essence scattering in every direction.
Meanwhile, shortly after Yuan reached the 40th floor, the lobby went into an uproar, with nearly everyone gathered before a screen displaying three lists of names.
Obviously, these lists were the rankings for the three available modes at Gaia's Sanctum.
As for what caused the uproar... the ranking for Eternal Assault was suddenly updated with shocking results that left everyone shocked and speechless.
"L-Look! Someone else has managed to breakthrough past the 40th floor for the first time in over a hundred years!"

It was such a big deal simply because there were fewer than 10 names on the ranking that had managed to ascend past the 40th floor, and all of these people were legendary figures. However, the newly introduced name was one that most people were not familiar with.
"Player Yuan? Who the heck is that?"
"Surely, it can't be the same Player Yuan from the rumors, right?"

"That's impossible! I investigated him recently and learned that he'd only just started participating in Gaia's Sanctum less than two months ago! Moreover, his cultivation is nowhere near enough to reach the 40th floor, much less climb past it!"
"To think there are two people with the same name, both of whom have been doing ridiculous things... what a crazy coincidence."
The crowd only continued to grow larger as time passed, as pretty much everyone wanted to see how far this individual could climb.
A few hours later—
"My lord! He's reached the 41st floor! And in such a short time, too!"
The crowd started celebrating as if it were their own achievement.

chapters.title: Chapter 2574 Foolish Mortal
paragraphs: "42nd floor! He's reached the 42nd floor now!"
The spectators stared at the screen with wide eyes, their gazes filled with awe and anticipation.
A day later, the leaderboard was updated again with Yuan reaching the 43rd floor.
"43rd floor! Do you guys think he will reach the 50th floor?"
"I don't know who this Player Yuan is, but there's no way he'd be able to beat the 50th floor when even the strongest cultivator in the world couldn't pass it."
"Is there a reason why most people are bottlenecked at the 40th floor?" Someone there suddenly asked, genuinely puzzled.
"The enemies from the 40th floor and onward wield a weird and powerful energy that most people cannot deal with," someone replied.

Someone else then said, "According to one of the cultivators who barely managed to clear the 40th floor, one must reach at least the Seventh Ascension and Imperious Heavenly Refinement to even attempt the 40th floor."
"Heavens, that's quite a harsh requirement..."
"There's a reason why there is only one individual who has managed to make it to the 50th floor."
After that was mentioned, everyone there subconsciously glanced at the name at the top of the list.
"Tian Yuchen."
A few people there mumbled this name.
"Tian Yuchen... the first cultivator to attain the Invincible Heavenly Refinement physique two thousand years ago."
"If anyone could beat the 50th floor, they'd need at least the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique of legends."
After another day, Yuan reached the 44th floor, placing him in the top five.
As for those ranked above him, two were stuck on the 46th floor, one had reached the 47th floor, and Tian Yuchen, who held the top position for over two thousand years, had stopped at the 50th floor.
Two days later, Yuan reached the 45th floor, where his opponent was as strong as Saaruk.

However, this only meant that his opponent's Eternal Essence was on par with Saaruk's. In reality, the faceless figure was much more difficult to deal with since it had a human body and fought like an expert.
In fact, even with his millions of years of experience, Yuan struggled slightly against it.
Despite that, Yuan welcomed the challenge, as it was nearly impossible to find an opponent who could make him struggle these days. More importantly, this helped him grow.
For the first time in a long time, Yuan could feel himself improving and getting stronger through battle against a powerful opponent.
One day... three days... five days...
It took an entire week, but Yuan finally managed to defeat his opponent.
<You have clearedfor the full chapter.
<You have received 100,000 Gaia Points as a reward>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<Your cultivation has reached Seventh Level Fourth Ascension>
<Proceed to the 46th floor?>
Yuan did not proceed immediately and instead took some time to rest.

"If the 45th floor is already this difficult, how much more difficult will the 46th floor be? What about beyond that? Will I have to fight an opponent with Eternal Essence on par with Prime Eternals?" Yuan wondered out loud.
He could've never anticipated this place to have such a difficult trial.
"Gaia... just who the hell are you?"
Some time later, once he was prepared, Yuan proceeded to the 46th floor.
Yuan's eyes widened at the figure standing before him on the 46th floor, his body instinctively trembling in fear beneath the aura and Eternal Essence it emitted.
Although his opponent's Eternal Essence was nowhere near the level of a Prime Eternal, it was stronger than anything he'd experienced before.
"Foolish mortal..."
A low voice suddenly resounded.
"Huh?" Yuan wore a dumbfounded expression, wondering if he was hearing things—or if his opponent had spoken just now.
"You can... speak?" Yuan asked it.
However, the faceless figure did not respond.
"I must be getting tired from all that fighting..." Yuan rubbed his eyes and sighed.
<Match start>
The moment the match began, the faceless figure struck, unleashing a wave of Eternal Essence that surged toward Yuan like a colossal tsunami.
"This is?!"

Yuan immediately countered, releasing as much Eternal Essence as he could muster. However, even with his one trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence, it was completely overwhelmed by the incoming attack.
The second Yuan saw that he could not defend against the attack, so he used Void Manipulation to avoid it.
"Foolish mortal..."
The voice echoed in Yuan's ears once more.
The next moment, Yuan found himself back in the waiting room, a defeat message hovering before him as his entire body ached with immense pain.
<You have been defeated>
Yuan stared at the message before him, barely paying attention to the pain.
'He killed me in the middle of my Void Manipulation!' Yuan cried inwardly when he realized what had just happened.
Yuan suddenly felt an odd sensation, prompting him to look down.
His hands were trembling, not from fear but from excitement.
In all of his lifetimes, he had never experienced such an overwhelming defeat before.
"Hahaha!"
After a moment of silence, Yuan suddenly burst out laughing.
"Damn it, that was fun! Let's do it again!"
Without hesitation, he immediately went for round two with the faceless figure on the 46th floor.
"Foolish mortal..."
The entity uttered the same two words before attacking Yuan in a similar fashion.
Yuan used Void Manipulation again.

This time, he saw the entity attacking him through the void. However, even though he could see it, the attack was too fast for him to react. No, it was almost as if his opponent had perfectly anticipated where he'd go, striking before he even moved.
A moment later, Yuan was sent back to the waiting room.
"Is it impossible for me to defeat the 46th floor at my current level?" he wondered out loud with a heavy sigh.
Despite that, he did not feel discouraged. If anything, his motivation was through the roof.
After taking a moment to calm his emotions, Yuan challenged the 46th floor again... again... and again.
He wanted to keep challenging the 46th floor until he cleared it, regardless of how long it would take, but alas, he was forced to stop when a certain notification appeared before him.
<You can only challenge the same floor 50 times a month>

chapters.title: Chapter 2575 Tian Yuchen
paragraphs: "So I can only do this fifty times a month, huh? What a pity," Yuan sighed out loud after seeing the notification, as he was beginning to get the hang of the 46th floor.
'With that said... I don't think I can clear the 46th stage simply by brute forcing it,' he thought inwardly as he exited the waiting room.
"Anyway, now that it's a new month, I can continue matchmaking for One Above All and Last Man Standing."
But before he continued matchmaking, Yuan made his way to the exchange to purchase some items with the points he'd amassed from Last Man Standing and Endless Assault.
<Reading Player Status>
<Available Gaia's Points: 575,533>
<Welcome to Gaia's Exchange, Player Yuan>
"Half a million, huh?"
He thought Last Man Standing rewarded a lot of points, but it turns out that Endless Assault rewarded the most points, with floors 41st and onward rewarding over 50,000 points.
<Confirm Purchase of Limitless Cultivation Technique(2) for 10,000 Gaia Points>
<Confirmed>
<You have purchased Limitless Cultivation Technique(2)>
The first thing Yuan purchased was the second part of the Limitless Cultivation Technique, as he wanted to see how it differed from part one and whether he should continue collecting the other parts.
'Interesting... although the second part appears gibberish at a glance, if combined with the first part, it greatly improves the technique's efficiency and speed.'
In the end, Yuan decided to finish the collection. However, he was only able to purchase one more since the final part was too expensive for him at the moment.
<Confirm Purchase of Limitless Cultivation Technique(3) for 150,000 Gaia Points>
<Confirmed>
<You have purchased Limitless Cultivation Technique(3)>
The final part of the technique required 750,000 points, so Yuan decided to put it on hold for now and purchase something else that would directly benefit him.
<Confirm Purchase of Superior Gaia's Gift for 75,000 points?>
<Confirmed>
<You have purchased Superior Gaia's Gift>
After purchasing the treasure, Yuan heard something small drop from the machine. When he looked down, he saw that it had produced the treasure.
He grabbed the Superior Gaia's Gift and, without hesitation, tossed it into his mouth as if it were a piece of candy.
<You have consumed Superior Gaia's Gift>
<Your Cultivation Speed has increased by 1>
[Cultivation Speed: 4]
Since he still had plenty of points, Yuan purchased another one.
<You have consumed Superior Gaia's Gift>
<Your Cultivation Speed has increased by 1>
[Cultivation Speed: 5]
After some consideration, Yuan decided to purchase another one.
<You have consumed Superior Gaia's Gift>
<Your Cultivation Speed has increased by 1>
[Cultivation Speed: 6]

Most people would not consume so much Gaia's Gift at once since they needed to have the proper physique. However, Yuan was already at Perfected Heavenly Refinement, so he wasn't worried that his cultivation speed might be bottlenecked by it.
'Wow! This feels great!' Yuan thought to himself as he examined his own body.
With his current cultivation speed, it rivaled his true cultivation speed in the Nine Heavens.
No... it even surpassed it!
Once he was done, Yuan immediately made his way to the matchmaking room for One Above All.
However, on his way there, he noticed a massive crowd gathered.
With his interest piqued, Yuan approached the crowd to see what they were all looking at.
That was when he discovered the rankings.
"He's not moving past the 46th floor... do you think he's reached his peak?"
"Give it a few more days. It took him several days to clear the 45th floor, after all."
Yuan ignored the crowd's chatter and focused on the Endless Assault leaderboard.

"What...?" Yuan muttered in surprise when he saw the ranking and that there were four people ahead of him—technically two since the other two were also stuck on the 46th floor. But since they'd reached it earlier than Yuan, they were above his name.
'There are eight other people who have cleared past the 40th floor, and four of them have even cleared past the 45th floor?!'
'Not just that, but someone has reached all the way to the 50th floor?!'
Yuan narrowed his eyes at the name on the top of the leaderboard and swallowed nervously.
'Tian... Yuchen?'
The surname 'Tian' made him wonder if it was just a coincidence or if they had a connection with him.
'50th floor... I cannot even imagine how powerful the enemy would be on the 47th floor, much less the 50th floor!' Yuan shook his head inwardly.
Yuan did not linger and left the crowd shortly after, entering One Above All to matchmake.
A week later—
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 300>
<You have earned 5 Gaia Points>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have earned 50 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
<You have reached Eighth Level Fourth Ascension>
<You have reached Master Rank>

<You have reached First Level Fifth Ascension>
<You have reached Master Rank>
'Oh? I am already at Master Rank?' Yuan had anticipated it would take another hundred wins to reach Master, but it seemed like one could rank up faster in Last Man Standing than One Above All.

Now that he'd reached the monthly limit for both One Above All and Last Man Standing, Yuan prepared to challenge the 46th floor again. However, rather than rushing to fight it, he spent time studying the Limitless Cultivation Technique.

'It's unlikely that the people of this world can use Eternal Essence, so Tian Yuchen must've reached the 50th floor using Limitless alone. In that case... I must figure out how he achieved it!' Yuan thought to himself.

What a pity," Yuan sighed out loud after seeing the notification, as he was beginning to get the hang of the 46th floor.
'With that said...
I don't think I can clear the 46th stage simply by brute forcing it,' he thought inwardly as he exited the waiting room.
"Anyway, now that it's a new month, I can continue matchmaking for One Above All and Last Man Standing."
But before he continued matchmaking, Yuan made his way to the exchange to purchase some items with the points he'd amassed from Last Man Standing and Endless Assault.
<Reading Player Status>
<Available Gaia's Points: 575,533>
<Welcome to Gaia's Exchange, Player Yuan>
"Half a million, huh?"
He thought Last Man Standing rewarded a lot of points, but it turns out that Endless Assault rewarded the most points, with floors 41st and onward rewarding over 50,000 points.
<Confirm Purchase of Limitless Cultivation Technique(2) for 10,000 Gaia Points>
<Confirmed>
<You have purchased Limitless Cultivation Technique(2)>
The first thing Yuan purchased was the second part of the Limitless Cultivation Technique, as he wanted to see how it differed from part one and whether he should continue collecting the other parts.
'Interesting... although the second part appears gibberish at a glance, if combined with the first part, it greatly improves the technique's efficiency and speed.'
In the end, Yuan decided to finish the collection.
However, he was only able to purchase one more since the final part was too expensive for him at the moment.
<Confirm Purchase of Limitless Cultivation Technique(3) for 150,000 Gaia Points>
<Confirmed>
<You have purchased Limitless Cultivation Technique(3)>

<Confirmed>

<You have consumed Superior Gaia's Gift>

Most people would not consume so much Gaia's Gift at once since they needed to have the proper physique.

'Wow!
This feels great!' Yuan thought to himself as he examined his own body.
With his current cultivation speed, it rivaled his true cultivation speed in the Nine Heavens.
No... it even surpassed it!

"He's not moving past the 46th floor... do you think he's reached his peak?"
"Give it a few more days.

"What...?" Yuan muttered in surprise when he saw the ranking and that there were four people ahead of him—technically two since the other two were also stuck on the 46th floor.

'There are eight other people who have cleared past the 40th floor, and four of them have even cleared past the 45th floor?!'
'Not just that, but someone has reached all the way to the 50th floor?!'
Yuan narrowed his eyes at the name on the top of the leaderboard and swallowed nervously.
'Tian...
Yuchen?'
The surname 'Tian' made him wonder if it was just a coincidence or if they had a connection with him.
'50th floor...
I cannot even imagine how powerful the enemy would be on the 47th floor, much less the 50th floor!' Yuan shook his head inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2576 Leaving Gaia's Sanctum
paragraphs: After spending an entire week studying all three parts of the Limitless Cultivation Technique, Yuan gave up and sighed, "It's no use. I will need the complete technique if I want to study this technique properly..."
Without any choice, Yuan entered Endless Assault and proceeded to die fifty times in a row to the enemy on the 46th floor.
Of course, every time he died, he would hear the faceless entity mocking him.
"Foolish mortal..."
"Damn it... Not only does its Eternal Essence far exceed mine, but it can even predict where I am going with my Void Manipulation, so its Void Understanding is also likely higher than mine..."
It had been a long time since Yuan felt such a bottleneck, and it was one that he couldn't brute-force.
Some time later, Yuan returned to One Above All and Last Man Standing, continuing his dominance in both modes.
By now, his name had become so widespread that nearly everyone below the rank of Elite Gladiator knew about him.
In One Above All, he was nicknamed the Win-Streak-Killer because anyone who encountered him was practically guaranteed to lose, and many lost their win streaks to him.
In Last Man Standing, he was still called the Ghost of the Colosseum by many, but some have started to call him the Immortal Ghost, as he was essentially unkillable.
"Damn it! Where the hell did this guy come from?! He's been terrorizing everyone for the last three months!"
"I'm just glad that he's no longer in Expert rank. I don't ever want to fight him again."
"Imagine having to fight a monster like him as an unranked or even as a Novice..."
"I don't get how he's so powerful with such a low cultivation base! There must be a secret to his strength!"
Meanwhile, Yuan achieved his 400th win streak for One Above All and his 300th win streak for Last Man Standing.
But alas, he was still stuck on the 46th floor of Endless Assault.
Then, another month passed.
Since the military recruitment was scheduled to start this month, Yuan did not waste any time on his matches and finished them as soon as possible.
For One Above All, he defeated all of his opponents almost as soon as the match started.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 500>
<You have earned 100 Gaia Points>
<You have received Limitless as a reward>
<You have earned 500 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have received bonus Limitless for
<You have reached Fifth Level Fifth Ascension>
<You have reached Grandmaster Rank>
As for Last Man Standing, Yuan stopped waiting for the other players to defeat one another and instead actively hunted them.
<You have won your match>
<You are on a winning streak!>
<Win Streak: 400>
<You have defeated 88 players>
<You have earned 88 Gaia Points>
<You have earned 1,000 Gaia Points for being the last man standing>

<You have received bonus Limitless for your win streak>
<You have earned 1,000 additional Gaia Points for your win streak>
<You have reached Ninth Level Fifth Ascension>
<You have reached Gladiator Rank>
"Has anybody figured out how he's avoiding our detection for Last Man Standing?!"
"It must be some kind of concealment technique, but where did he acquire it? I didn't see anything like that in the exchange shop, either."
"He can't keep getting away with this! Somebody! Anybody! Please stop him!"
The people expected Yuan to keep terrorizing them, but unbeknownst to them, they would stop hearing from him for a long time.

In just three short days, Yuan reached his monthly limit for One Above All and Last Man Standing. And once he used all 50 attempts on the 46th floor, Yuan finally left Gaia's Sanctum after spending five months inside fighting nonstop.
Unfortunately, he was unable to collect enough points to purchase the final part of the Limitless Cultivation Technique before the recruitment. However, he swore to return as soon as possible.
Some time later, Yuan returned to Mei Xiaoyun's villa.
"You're finally here!" Mei Xiaoyun spoke aloud after seeing him for the first time in months.
"Am I late?" Yuan asked.
"No, you're just in time," Mei Feng, who was also present, said. "However, in the military, if you're not early, you're late, so keep that in mind.
"Am I going to take the recruitment right now?" Yuan then asked.
"Let me check your status first to see how much you've progressed in the last five months," Mei Feng said, pointing to the nearby machine she had prepared in advance.
Yuan casually approached the machine and fed it some of his blood.
"What the hell is this?! What in heaven's name did you do in the last five months?!" Mei Feng exclaimed in shock after seeing Yuan's status and improvement, her eyes and mouth as wide as saucers.
Mei Xiaoyun was stunned speechless.
[Yuan]
[Cultivation: Ninth Level Fifth Ascension]
[Physique: Superior Heavenly Refinement]
[Credential Rank: 3]
[Cultivation Speed: 6]
"Ninth Level Fifth Ascension?! You improved your cultivation by nearly five realms in less than half a year?! That's impossible!"
"Really? I just spent all of my time inside Gaia's Sanctum," Yuan calmly replied.
Mei Feng stared at him in silence.
A long moment of silence later, she spoke in a dazed voice, "Quite frankly, I'm a little afraid to ask you about your time there..."
She turned to look at his status again.
"Your cultivation speed... did you consume three Superior Gaia's Gifts?" she asked.
"I did. I purchased them with Gaia's Points."
"You acquired over 225,000 points in half a year...? That usually takes even Gladiators decades to acquire..."
Unbeknownst to her, Yuan had actually acquired several times more than that amount.
"Haaa... I'm glad that you went out of your way to improve so much, but this... this is a little troublesome," Mei Feng said after another moment of silence.
"Why? What's wrong?" Yuan asked, looking puzzled by her words.

chapters.title: Chapter 2577 Military Base
paragraphs: "Your cultivation speed is too high for someone with only a Supreme Heavenly Refinement physique," Mei Xiaoyun explained the issue at hand to Yuan.
Mei Feng nodded and said, "I should've explained it to you earlier, but I never anticipated you would progress so fast. This is partially my fault."

However, Yuan then said, "Actually, Mei Xiaoyun already explained it to me earlier. I guess it slipped my mind since I was so focused on improving as much as possible before the recruitment. So, what should I do now?"

"We will need to adjust your physique again, but I didn't bring the machine with me, and quite frankly, it's too risky to bring it out now. Luckily for us, the recruitment will take place on base, where the machine is located. I'll bring you there under the pretense of a tour," Mei Feng said.
"Okay," Yuan nodded. "Anything else?"

After a brief moment of silence, Mei Feng sighed out loud, "I was going to personally test your combat abilities, but seeing how you acquired so many points at Gaia's Sanctum in such a short time...I won't need to waste my time."
Some time later, they prepared to leave for the base.
"Can I come with you?" Mei Xiaoyung suddenly asked.
Mei Feng raised an eyebrow and responded in a somewhat surprised tone, "I thought you hated the military."
"I still do," she said, but refused to elaborate further.
"Do as you please," Mei Feng said with a nonchalant shrug.
After leaving the villa, the three of them teleported to the military base, which was located somewhere outside the city.
"G-General!" The guards at the gate hastily saluted Mei Feng as she approached.
"I am bringing two civilians into the base with me. Sign them up," she said.
"Right away!"
The soldiers moved with precision and swiftness, signing both Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun in the guest log within a minute.
Normally, they would check guests' backgrounds and have them sign paperwork, but because of Mei Feng's rank, they skipped those steps.
"I have been wondering about this for a while now, but what's your mother's status within the military? How high is a General?" Yuan asked Mei Xiaoyun.
"General is the second-highest rank in the military," Mei Xiaoyun responded.
"That's...pretty incredible."
He looked at her and continued asking, "What about you? Why aren't you in the military?"
"Why would I be?" she answered in a somewhat disdainful tone, as if offended by his question.
Seeing her reaction, Yuan decided not to pursue further.
Once they were registered, they followed Mei Feng into the base.
"Get in." Mei Feng said to them as she entered a nearby vehicle.
The military base was so vast that traveling on foot was impractical. As for teleporters, they were strictly prohibited inside the military base for security reasons.
'So they do have cars in this world...' Yuan thought to himself as Mei Feng drove them around the base until they reached a massive building that stretched for miles and miles at a glance.
But before they could reach the building, they had to go through another security checkpoint.
"Greetings, General!" The soldiers saluted her.
"I'm going to give these two a tour," she said to them, but she gave them more information this time.
"One is my daughter, and the other is someone who will join our ranks soon. I personally recruited him."
The soldiers' eyes widened at her words, but they remained silent.
Once Mei Feng left the scene, the soldiers spoke to each other.
"How long has it been since General Mei recruited someone?"
"I think it's been twenty years since she recruited that monster."
"Her standards are so high that everyone she recruits turns out to be monsters. I wonder if and how this new one will shake the military."
"Wanna make a bet? On whether this new one will surpass the last one."
"There's no way he's more talented than the last one she recruited. That kind of monster shows up once in a lifetime."
"Is that your choice? Then I'll bet that he's even more ridiculous."
"What's the price for the loser?"
"How does lunch sound?"
"Sounds good."
Upon arriving at the building, Mei Feng scanned her badge on the pad by the door, opening it once it verified her credentials.
Once they entered the building, the number of people drastically increased, all of them wearing a similar black uniform.
"General!"
"Good morning, General!"
"General!
Every soldier they passed would stop in their tracks to greet Mei Feng.
'They're treating her like the Celestial Emperor, and she's only the second-highest rank?' Yuan thought to himself.
Some time later, they entered a certain room—an office.
The first thing Yuan noticed upon entering the room was the portraits on the wall, all of which featured Mei Feng.
"Is this...your room?" Yuan had to ask.
"Yes, this is my private office," she said, pointing at the machine by the wall.
"Let's get this over with as soon as possible."
"Why do you even have this in your office?" Yuan inquired as he entered the machine.
"For work. And it's the only reason I could sneak it out last time."
A few moments later—
<With the authority of Mei Feng, your physique has been changed to Inexhaustible Heavenly Refinement>
"Although your cultivation is a little low for someone with a Rank 6 Cultivation Speed, it's believable enough."
"Any questions before I take you to the recruitment area?" Mei Feng asked.
"I do, but it's not related to the recruitment."
"What is it?"
"I want to learn more about Gaia. Your credentials as a General should be pretty high, so can you—"
"No." Mei Feng rejected his proposal before he could even finish his sentence.
"Can I ask why?"
"Because anything Gaia-related is top secret. If you want to know, you have to climb the ranks and increase your credentials."
Yuan narrowed his eyes at her words and said, "You told me that you didn't know about Gaia's existence before."
"Evidently, I lied. Because it's not something a civilian should know about."
"Then do you know Gaia's identity?"
After a moment of silence, Mei Feng nodded, "I do, but don't even bother asking because I won't tell you."

paragraphs: "If you're not going to tell me anything about Gaia, can you at least tell me what Credential Rank I need to acquire to learn about them?" Yuan then asked.
"Why do you even want to know about Gaia? Aren't you from another world?" Mei Feng replied.
"I need to meet them," said Yuan, but he didn't elaborate.
"You want to meet...with Gaia?" Mei Feng raised her eyebrows, looking surprised.
"Are you going to tell me that it's not possible because nobody has ever seen them before?" Yuan sighed.
"What are you talking about? Gaia is very much real, and I have even personally met h—" Mei Feng abruptly stopped herself, even putting her hands over her mouth.
'Damn! I nearly revealed top secret information to a civilian!' she cried inwardly.
"I'm done with this topic," she quickly said. "Any other questions?"
Yuan pondered for a moment before asking, "Then do you know about Tian Yuchen?"
"Tian Yuchen? The legendary cultivator from 2,000 years ago?"
He nodded.
"I know that he's renowned for his cultivation and Endless Assault achievement in Gaia's Sanctum, but that's pretty much it. Why are you suddenly asking about him?"
"Because I saw him on the Endless Assault ranking and got curious."
"Well, if you want to learn more about him, you can visit the library after you join the military. We have access to things that the rest of the world isn't privy to," said Mei Feng.
"Actually..." Yuan then said, "While we're on this topic, why is the military hiding so much from the civilians?"
"This is just how things work around here," Mei Feng said, shrugging and showing no desire to elaborate further.
"Alright. That's all I want to ask."
Of course, he still had a lot of questions, but he had a feeling that Mei Feng would simply refuse to answer or give him vague responses.
'If she's anything like the Meifeng I know, it'll be virtually impossible to get any information that she doesn't want to reveal out of her.'
Some time later, Mei Feng brought Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun to the recruitment area.
Although several days remained before the recruitment was scheduled to begin, a massive crowd had already gathered at the recruitment area.
At a glance, there were at least a hundred thousand people present. Most of them were young men and women, with only a small portion appearing older.
"Want to join the military with me?" Yuan suddenly turned to ask Mei Xiaoyun in a half-joking and half-serious tone.
She immediately sneered, "If I wanted to join the military, I would've done so ages ago."
Suddenly, Mei Feng's voice resounded in Yuan's head as she spoke to him using voice transmission, 'If you can convince my daughter to join the military, I'll give you a reward.'
Yuan raised an eyebrow at such a random request, but before he could respond, Mei Feng said, "I have somewhere to be, so I will be taking my leave now. Good luck...not that you need it."
She turned around and quickly vanished into the distance.
Once Mei Feng was gone, Yuan turned to ask Mei Xiaoyun, "If you don't mind me asking, why do you seem to hate the military so much? Is it related to your grudge for your mother?"
"Why are you suddenly being so nosy?" Mei Xiaoyun glared at him with narrowed eyes.

Yuan smiled and said, "Believe it or not, I know someone in my world who looks exactly like you and your mother. Coincidentally, they are also mother and daughter. And since I am very closely related to them, I cannot help but be curious about your relationship with your mother and if there's anything that can be done to fix it."

"There's nothing to fix," Mei Xiaoyun said. "And my reason for disliking my mother and the military is very simple, too. I was neglected as a child, with the root cause being her job in the military."
"You should be more honest with yourself," Yuan suddenly said.
"What the hell are you talking about?" Mei Xiaoyun frowned.

Yuan chuckled and said, "You may be able to fool yourself, but you cannot fool my eyes. Whenever you look at your mother, there is clear admiration in your gaze. If you ask me, I think you actually admire her."
"T-That's absurd!"

"You followed us because you wanted to spend more time with your mother, right? I think there is a better way to do that—and that is to join the military. Not only would it make seeing your mother easier, but you would also be able to talk about things you normally cannot."

"Your mother is quite similar to the person I know in my world. If that is the case, then I am willing to bet that she actually wants to talk to you, but simply does not know what to talk about. After all, she cannot disclose anything military-related to you, even if you are her daughter."
Mei Xiaoyun stared at him with her mouth slightly opened, a stunned expression on her face.
After a moment of silence, she responded in a nervous voice, "S-Shut up! Don't speak as if you know everything about me or my mother when we're basically still strangers!"
Yuan did not give up and said, "How about this? If you join the military with me, I will..."
Yuan continued his sentence using voice transmission, "I will teach you how I acquired the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique. Hell, I will even train you."
"I don't need your training," she sneered.

Despite saying that, she was enticed by his offer. After all, in less than half a year, Yuan had somehow managed to catch up with her cultivation. Of course, there was also his Perfected Heavenly Temperament physique.
"Take some time to think it over," said Yuan before falling silent and waiting for the recruitment to begin.
Two days later, several people in military uniforms appeared in the area, their presence instantly silencing the entire area.

chapters.title: Chapter 2579 Military Recruitment(2)
paragraphs: "Welcome to this year's military recruitment. I'm Sergeant Zao, in charge of overseeing this year's recruitment. First and foremost, I'm delighted to see so many eager to join the military this year, but unfortunately, we have only so much space, and we want only the best. Therefore, we will be hosting several trials to weed out those not qualified."
Without wasting any time, Sergeant Zao immediately went into the details of the first trial.

"For the first trial, all of you will be required to run two laps around the base, which is about a thousand miles per lap. During the run, not only do you have to wear weights, but you will have to avoid the traps that will constantly try to hit you. Being hit by a trap won't automatically disqualify you as long as you're not hit in any vital spot. That means if you're hit in the head or heart even once, you'll be disqualified."
"Also, there won't be any time limit, but there will be a limit to how many people can proceed to the next trial, so don't try to take your time."
Sergeant Zao pointed toward the east and continued, "Before you begin the run, you will each grab a badge, a tracker, and your weights."
"I don't want to waste my breath since at least half of you will drop out, so I will speak more in the second trial. Good luck."
After Sergeant Zao ended his sentence, several soldiers could be heard beckoning the participants to acquire their items.
"Come over here and get your gear! If you're missing even one item before starting the run, you will automatically be disqualified!"
The sea of participants immediately moved toward the soldiers to grab their things before they ran.
"Don't push! Your time r won't start until you receive all items and pass the starting line!"
"Are you coming with me?" Yuan turned to ask Mei Xiaoyun.
"You can go ahead," she said.
Yuan nodded and left without saying anything else.
Some time later, Yuan received three items: a badge with the number 42011, a paper-thin silver bracelet, and a black necklace.
Although the black necklace was weightless in his hands, the moment Yuan put it on, he felt his entire body grow several times heavier, as though he were suddenly carrying a mountain on his back.
Though it was still manageable.
Meanwhile, many participants dropped to the ground the moment they put on the necklace and were unable to get back up, which disqualified them on the spot.

However, even more people were disqualified before they put on the necklace, as the bracelet they wore was used to detect those who did not meet the bare minimum cultivation and credential requirements.
"Requirements not met. Disqualified.
The bracelet would glow crimson red and even announce it aloud to those who did not qualify, publicly shaming them for trying to sneak past the requirements.
As for those who qualified, their bracelets would glow azure.
Once Yuan wore all three items and walked past the starting line, he started running at full speed, shooting forward like a bullet.
"What the hell is that speed?!"
His speed shocked not just the other participants but also the soldiers there.
"There's no way he's moving that fast while weighted! Is his necklace even functioning properly?!"
The participants cried out, suspecting that something was wrong with Yuan's necklace, which allowed him to run at full speed.
At the same time, somewhere inside the military building, a large group of high-ranking soldiers were watching the recruitment on a big screen.
"Who is that kid passing everyone?" Someone suddenly asked.
"Number 42011. According to his bracelet, he's at Ninth Level Fifth Ascension, his physique at Inexhaustible Heavenly Refinement."
"What? Those stats are on par with some of our elite soldiers! Where the hell did he come from?"
"Give me a minute to look him up."
However, even after several minutes, the soldier could not find any information on Yuan.
"How odd... I cannot find any information on him."
"What? How is that possible?"
"Look. It says I don't have enough credentials to see his information."
"Huh?"
The people in the room shifted their gaze; their eyes widened with surprise.
"Who the hell is this bastard that blocks even your rank 7 credentials?"
"That would be my recruit," a calm voice suddenly responded.
The people in the room turned to look behind them and saw Mei Feng entering.
"General Mei!" They stood up to greet her.
"Wait... what did you just say?" one of them asked.
"I said I found him, so keep your grubby hands off him. He's mine."
The room fell silent as the soldiers wore shocked looks.
"General Mei, don't you think you're being unreasonable?"
A voice responded as another individual entered the room right behind her.
Mei Feng turned around to see a middle-aged man wearing a rank identical to hers.
"General Gu," she muttered. "How am I being unreasonable?"
"Don't you think having one monster is already enough? You should give the others a chance."
"Hah!" Mei Feng sneered. "That's rich coming from you, who has the most elite soldiers under his command."
General Gu shook his head and said, "It's not like I personally chose them. They were the ones who chose to stand under my banner of their own accord."
"In any case, that one is mine. If any of you dare to touch him, I'll fucking kill you."
After saying that, Mei Feng walked out of the room.
"That was quite intensive even for General Mei..."
"I don't think she reacted that way even for that woman..."
"Are you implying that this 42011 is even more monstrous than her last recruit?"
The soldiers trembled at the thought.
Meanwhile, General Gu took a seat at the table and narrowed his eyes at Yuan.
"Let's not get ahead of ourselves. It's still too early to tell how talented he is."
"General Gu is right. Let's continue watching for now."

chapters.title: Chapter 2580 Military Recruitment(3)
paragraphs: The path for the trial was a simple one-way road, and for the first hundred miles, there were no obstacles or traps.

However, the moment Yuan reached the hundred-mile mark, the real trial began. Arrows suddenly flew at him from both sides, and since his view was obstructed by large bushes on either side of the path, he had to rely on his senses and reflexes to avoid them.

Naturally, such traps were no different from a child's play in Yuan's eyes, and he could avoid them even with his eyes closed. However, for the other participants, the traps were difficult to handle because many had not been properly trained.
Yuan avoided all traps without stopping, but the participants around him had to stop moving to dodge the arrows.
"His senses and reaction are quite spectacular, but it's not unprecedented."
"It's still too early to judge him since the trial has just begun."
The high-ranking soldiers continued to chat as they watched the trial from their private room.
Of course, Yuan wasn't the only one being shown on the screen.
"Recruit 24,192 is mine."
"He's not bad, but I'm calling dibs on 64,123."
Since Mei Feng had already claimed Yuan for herself and nobody wanted to fight with her, they had no choice but to scout other soldiers for their division.
Some time later, Yuan reached the two-hundred-mile mark, and the traps changed slightly. Although arrows continued to fly toward him, something new had been added.
'Hm?'
Yuan noticed a red laser aimed at his body. When he looked down, he saw a red dot marking his heart.
The red dot was initially as large as a fist, but it quickly shrank until it became so small that it vanished entirely.
Just before the red dot disappeared, Yuan twisted his body, narrowly avoiding a bullet that shot toward the exact spot where it had been aimed.
As Yuan continued forward, the number of arrows and bullets flying toward him increased. Still, it was nowhere near enough to challenge him.
'This is a bit boring...' Yuan thought to himself, even feeling an urge to yawn.
Meanwhile, the participants around him continued to fall left and right...With Yuan somewhat contributing to their failure because of how much he distracted them.
"What the hell?! How is he moving at that speed and avoiding the traps simultaneously?!"
Eventually, Yuan ran a thousand miles, completing the first lap.
On the second lap, the traps did not activate for the first hundred miles, just like the first.
Yuan prepared for the traps to activate past the 100-mile mark, but he reached the 200-mile mark without being attacked by a single trap.
Just as Yuan began to wonder whether there were any traps on the second lap, his eyebrows suddenly twitched, and he tilted his head slightly to the right.
Whoosh!
A breeze brushed against his cheek as an invisible arrow shot past him.
"Invisible traps now, huh?"
Although the arrows were completely invisible to the naked eye, they were all imbued with Limitless. As long as one paid close attention, they could still sense them approaching.
By now, Yuan had surpassed every participant who started before him and had reached first place.
"If he continues at this pace, he'll break the record by a landslide!"
"This guy might just be even more monstrous than the last one General Mei recruited!"
Upon realizing this, the high-ranking soldiers began contemplating whether they should try to recruit Yuan despite Mei Feng's warning—whether he was worth offending her over.

Even though Mei Feng had found him first and called dibs on him, there was no rule stating that he had to join her division, nor was there anything preventing the others from trying to recruit him. In fact, such a thing was quite common.

A few of the soldiers suddenly felt the urge to look at General Gu. When they glanced in his direction, they saw an excited—almost perverted—smile on his face, as though he were staring at something he deeply desired.
Seeing this, they quickly realized that General Gu was likely planning to compete with Mei Feng and recruit Yuan to his side.
'Looks like things will get chaotic soon...'
The soldiers sighed inwardly.
After reaching the 700-mile mark, the red dots returned, but several would appear at once, and the frequency of their appearance also increased.
Yet, it did not slow down Yuan in the slightest. If anything, he sped up because he wanted to end the trial as soon as possible since it was too boring.
Eventually, Yuan reached the end.
"T-Two hours and fifty-nine minutes?!" The soldiers cried out loud after seeing Yuan's time.
"He broke the record by seven whole hours!"
Yuan approached one of them and asked, "What now? I just finished my second lap."
The soldiers stared at him in silence, their mouths agape.
"Um... you can keep the badge and bracelet, so you just need to return your necklace."
Once the soldiers acquired Yuan's necklace, they immediately began examining it just in case it was actually broken.
However, they were unable to find anything wrong with it even after looking through it twice, meaning it was working properly, and Yuan's record would stand.
"Hm?"
Meanwhile, Yuan raised his eyebrows when he noticed that Mei Xiaoyun was nowhere to be seen.
'Did she leave? Or did she...?' he thought inwardly.
"You can rest until the others are done," one of the soldiers said to Yuan.
"Alright."
A few hours later, Yuan smiled when he saw Mei Xiaoyun again.
Turns out she did not leave and had decided to participate in the recruitment as well.
Although her performance was nowhere near as spectacular as Yuan's, she still managed to attract some attention.
"Who is that woman?" one of the high-ranking soldiers from the room asked.
"That's number 111,781...Huh?"
"...No way!"
"What is it?"
"T-That woman is Mei Xiaoyun, General Mei's daughter!"
"What?! General Mei has a daughter?!"
"You didn't know?"
"She never talks about her family."
"But from what I heard, they have a rocky relationship."
"If that's the case, there's a good chance she won't go to her mother's division, so we can try to recruit her."

Seeing this, they quickly realized that General Gu was likely planning to compete with Mei Feng and recruit Yuan to his side.
'Looks like things will get chaotic soon...'
The soldiers sighed inwardly.
After reaching the 700-mile mark, the red dots returned, but several would appear at once, and the frequency of their appearance also increased.
Yet, it did not slow down Yuan in the slightest.
If anything, he sped up because he wanted to end the trial as soon as possible since it was too boring.
Eventually, Yuan reached the end.
"T-Two hours and fifty-nine minutes?!" The soldiers cried out loud after seeing Yuan's time.
"He broke the record by seven whole hours!"
Yuan approached one of them and asked, "What now?
I just finished my second lap."
The soldiers stared at him in silence, their mouths agape.
"Um... you can keep the badge and bracelet, so you just need to return your necklace."
Once the soldiers acquired Yuan's necklace, they immediately began examining it just in case it was actually broken.
However, they were unable to find anything wrong with it even after looking through it twice, meaning it was working properly, and Yuan's record would stand.
"Hm?"
Meanwhile, Yuan raised his eyebrows when he noticed that Mei Xiaoyun was nowhere to be seen.
'Did she leave?
Or did she...?' he thought inwardly.
"You can rest until the others are done," one of the soldiers said to Yuan.
"Alright."
A few hours later, Yuan smiled when he saw Mei Xiaoyun again.
Turns out she did not leave and had decided to participate in the recruitment as well.
Although her performance was nowhere near as spectacular as Yuan's, she still managed to attract some attention.
"Who is that woman?" one of the high-ranking soldiers from the room asked.
"That's number 111,781...Huh?"
"...No way!"
"What is it?"
"T-That woman is Mei Xiaoyun, General Mei's daughter!"
"What?!
General Mei has a daughter?!"
"You didn't know?"
"She never talks about her family."
"But from what I heard, they have a rocky relationship."
"If that's the case, there's a good chance she won't go to her mother's division, so we can try to recruit her."

chapters.title: Chapter 2581 Military Recruitment(4)
paragraphs: A little over twelve hours after Yuan finished the first trial, a second participant finally finished their second lap.
The moment the man finished his lap, he looked around until he spotted Yuan, who appeared to be napping beneath a tree, shielded by its shadow.
"Hey, what was that guy's time?" he asked the soldiers as he returned his necklace, sounding a bit hesitant, as if he was nervous to know.
"Two hours and fifty-nine minutes..."
"What?! But the last record was ten hours! How is it even possible to go so low?! There must have been something wrong with his weights!"
"No, we've checked the necklace. It was working and active the entire time."
"No way..."
After a moment of silence, the man approached Yuan and asked, "How did you do it?"
"What do you mean?" Yuan responded without opening his eyes.
"You know what I mean! How did you finish the trial in such a short time?!"
"Well... you know... I ran."
"Are you messing with me?!"
Yuan picked his ears with his pinky and said, "I've already answered your question. Now, can you stop buzzing in my ears like an annoying little bug?"
"You—!"

The man's face turned red in anger. However, he remembered where he was and, not wanting to cause a scene, quickly turned around and walked away. But he continued to stare daggers at Yuan from a distance until the next participant finished the trial a little over half an hour later.
Soon, more and more participants finished the race.

In the military's eyes, anyone who finished within 24 hours was considered average. Those who finished within 20 hours were considered above average. Those who completed the trial within 14 hours were considered talented, while anyone who finished faster than that was considered elite.
As for Yuan... he was considered an anomaly.
Mei Xiaoyun ended up finishing in 12 hours and 22 minutes, earning elite status.
Meanwhile, as Sergeant Zao had predicted, more than half of the participants failed the trial, bringing the total to more than 70,000.

Once the last participant finished the trial, Sergeant Zao appeared before them again and spoke, "Congratulations on finishing the first trial, but this is just the beginning. If you barely passed this one, you might as well just go home now because the second one will be even more difficult."
"Follow me."
Sergeant Zao turned toward the military building and began walking.
After nearly an hour, intentionally giving the participants some time to rest, they reached the building and entered.
Sergeant Zao then led everyone into a massive, dome-shaped room containing an obstacle course filled with various obstacles.
"For the second trial, you will need to complete this obstacle course," he said, giving them a brief and simple explanation."
The participants took a moment to examine the obstacle course, and one of them couldn't help but mutter, "It looks so simple..."
While the obstacle course appeared massive, the courses themselves appeared simple, even easy.
Sergeant Zao chuckled after hearing that and said, "Just wait until you start doing it."
"Now, here are some rules for this trial."

After a moment of silence, he continued, "There are no rules. Anyone who reaches the end will qualify for the next trial. A hundred participants will go at a time, and the selection will be randomized. If you hear your number being called, enter the obstacle course."
Soon, a hundred numbers were announced through speakers.
Once all one hundred participants had gathered at the starting line of the obstacle course, a loud beep signaled the start.
Despite having 100 people standing in a single-file line with 50 meters between each person, there was still plenty of space for them to move around.
At the start of the signal, all of them rushed forward.
However, their movements noticeably slowed the moment they passed the starting line, causing those watching to raise their eyebrows in puzzlement.
Meanwhile, those on the obstacle course were shocked when their bodies suddenly felt sluggish and weak, as if all their energy had been drained.
As a result, some of them even tripped over thin air and fell face-first to the ground.
"What's going on?!"
"My energy! It's all gone!"
"This must be the true trial!"
The participants quickly adapted and began moving toward the first obstacle—a mile-long wooden log barely wide enough for an average man's foot to step on.
Of course, since there were 100 participants, there were 100 such obstacles.
Although all of them struggled at first, as they got used to their exhaustion, they started speeding up.

However, when the first person reached the half-mile mark, an arrow suddenly shot from the ceiling at him. Since he was completely focused on the log and too exhausted to react properly, the arrow struck him directly in the center of his forehead.
As a result, he was knocked off the log and sent falling to the bottom.
When the others saw this, they immediately heightened their senses and prepared to be attacked too.
Yet, when they reached the half-mile mark, none of them were targeted.
Instead, the arrows struck at random intervals, making them impossible to predict.
As they moved closer and closer to the end of the obstacle, the arrows would appear more frequently, slowing many down and completely eliminating others.
While the arrows weren't fatal, they were strong enough to crack bones, so a few participants ended up with cracked skulls in the end.
"Since we have unlimited time, I think it would be better to take our time with this trial." One of the spectators remarked.
"No, that might not be the case. If you haven't noticed, those who are slower have been targeted more than those at the front."
"Are you sure it's not a coincidence?"
"It might be since it's still too soon to tell."
Eventually, someone reached the end of the log and came to the second obstacle—a massive, lengthy pool resembling a sea with a sign right before it.
[Swim To The Other Side]

chapters.title: Chapter 2582 Military Recruitment(5)
paragraphs: When the first participant reached the second obstacle, he walked to its edge and looked down to see if he could spot anything in the water.
After several moments, the man sighed in relief when he saw nothing and, after taking a deep breath, jumped into it and began swimming.
The pool was even longer than the first obstacle. In fact, it was ten times as long.
As the participants continued to swim, they grew increasingly anxious, fearing that something might attack them from below.

Sure enough, once they reached the middle, they encountered a trap, but it was not what they had expected. Rather than arrows or attacks from beneath the water, whirlpools appeared on the surface, disrupting their rhythm and making it difficult to swim.

These whirlpools were weak at first, but they grew stronger and more violent the farther the participants progressed. Eventually, they became powerful enough to drag anyone who was not careful into the depths.

If the participants who were dragged into the water did not resurface after a minute, they would be teleported to safety by the mechanism available in their bracelets. However, this also meant their disqualification from the recruitment.
"Are you not going to say anything to me?"
A voice suddenly rang out behind Yuan as he watched the examination.
He turned around to see Mei Xiaoyun standing behind him, her eyebrows raised.
"What do you mean?" Yuan inquired.
"I was expecting you to make fun of me or something," she replied.
"Do I look like the kind of person to do such a thing?"
"Honestly? Yes, you do."
"Well, sorry to disappoint you, but I won't be making fun of you."
After a brief pause, he added, "As long as you don't fail the recruitment, that is."
Mei Xiaoyun sneered, "I've seen and done it before. Several times, in fact."
"Oh?" Yuan raised an eyebrow in surprise.

"My mother would occasionally bring me along and make me participate. Of course, those were some of the only times she visited—and the only reason she did," she sighed. "And once I told her that I won't be joining the military, she immediately stopped visiting."
"Is that so..."
Some time later, the participants reached the third and final part of the obstacle course. By then, nearly all of the original 100 had been eliminated, leaving only a little over 10 remaining.
The final obstacle was a towering wall designed to resemble a mountain cliff. As for its height, it was a staggering twenty miles, twice as long as the previous obstacle.
"Haa...haaa..."

The participants who made it to the final obstacle did not immediately start climbing; they took some time to rest, just as they had done at the second obstacle. After all, they had all the time in the world.
However, since there was a formation constantly draining their energy, they wouldn't feel refreshed no matter how long they rested.
Once they were mentally prepared, they started climbing the mountain.
At the same time, the next 100 participants were called into the obstacle course.
"My number got called," Mei Xiaoyun said.
"Good luck," Yuan said to her.
Meanwhile, when the first group of participants climbed the first mile, their entire bodies suddenly trembled, as though they had sensed something.
A few seconds later, they heard faint sounds coming from behind them. Sure enough, they were being targeted by arrows once again.
And it was more than just a single arrow, forcing them to move their bodies entirely by leaping to another spot on the wall.

Of course, with their energy constantly near exhaustion, that was far easier said than done. Every movement felt as though they had just run a marathon, forcing them to conserve every bit of motion they could.
One of the participants chose to endure the arrows and allowed them to strike his body. However, the moment one hit a vital area, he was automatically teleported out of the course and disqualified.
"What?!"
"I thought there were no rules!"
The spectators cried out loud when they saw the participant getting eliminated, and they turned to look at Sergeant Zao, who was also watching nearby.
"There are no rules, but it should be common sense not to get hit in the vitals. After all, how are you supposed to continue as a corpse?
What Sergeant Zao said made sense, and a few participants realized that as long as they didn't get hit in the vitals, they wouldn't be disqualified.

Although only a hundred participants could enter the obstacle course at a time, each group only took roughly an hour to reach the third obstacle, with some groups being eliminated entirely long before then.
A few days later, Yuan finally heard his number being called.
The moment the higher-ups in the private spectating room heard it, they all subconsciously straightened in their seats and focused their attention on him.
Shortly after Yuan entered the obstacle course, two individuals appeared beside Sergeant Zao in the room.
"Hm? What are the two of you doing here?" Sergeant Zao raised his eyebrows upon seeing these two individuals, clearly surprised by their appearance.
"We're here to watch," said Shi Fa.
"Since when have you been interested in recruitment? Or did you hear about a certain somebody? I guess I shouldn't be surprised that his record has spread by now."

"Yeah, we heard somebody had gotten a sub-3-hour during the first exam, shattering every single record before it, including that monster's record," said Wu Wang, pretending like he didn't know about Yuan before it.
"Do you think she'll also make an appearance to see him?"
"Doubtful, since she was recently deployed for a mission."
"I bet the higher-ups are all scrambling to recruit him into their division," Shi Fa chuckled.
"He'll probably be scooped up by General Gu, anyway."
"Let's see how he performs in this one, where his stamina is severely limited."
The moment the trial started, Yuan's figure shot forward like an arrow, as if the exhaustion did not affect him in the slightest.
Not only the others in his group, but everyone watching widened their eyes in shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 2583 Military Recruitment(6)
paragraphs: "W-What the hell?! Is the formation not affecting him or something?!"
The spectators cried out loud.
"No... I think he's just showing off and will run out of gas soon."
The participants in Yuan's group, as well as the spectators, believed that Yuan was just trying to show off and was using what little energy he had for the spectacle.
However, Yuan jumped onto the log and continued running on it until he reached the point where arrows began to appear.
Of course, he dodged all of them without slowing down.
"How is he still going?! Where the hell is he getting his energy from?!"
"Hey! Call the technicians!"
The higher-ups immediately asked the technicians on duty to double-check whether the formation suppressing their energy was working properly.
"The technicians have confirmed that the formations are working as intended!"
"How is that possible?!"
Everyone was in disbelief.

General Gu then said, "The formation suppresses everyone at a fixed rate. Therefore, if someone possesses the ability to regenerate their energy faster than the formation can drain it, they could theoretically outpace its suppression."
Sure enough, Yuan was simply regenerating his energy faster than the formation was exhausting it, allowing him to move at full speed.
"What is his physique rank, again?"
"Inexhaustible Heavenly Refinement, sir!" Someone answered.

"Inexhaustible Heavenly Refinement, huh? Although that in itself isn't enough to out-regenerate the formation, if he has a technique to assist him further, it's possible. Still, the formation gets stronger the longer they spend on the course, so it should suppress him sooner or later."
"If he doesn't finish the entire course by then, that is..." someone remarked.
In the blink of an eye, Yuan arrived at the second obstacle course, immediately jumped into the water, and began swimming.

Since swimming was rarely required in the cultivation world, most cultivators actually never swam in their lives. However, because of its simplicity, it was extremely easy to learn, so even if Yuan lacked experience, he was able to quickly master it simply by watching others.
Once Yuan reached the whirlpools, he ignored them entirely and swam straight through, somehow overpowering their attempts to drag him into the depths.
"H-He swam right through the whirlpool! I have never seen anything like that before!"
"Is such a thing even possible without using Limitless?"
"At this rate, he'll catch up to the group who went before him! This is unprecedented!"
Some time later, Yuan reached the third obstacle.
Meanwhile, the group that started before him had only recently started the climb.
"Huh?"
The participants from that group raised their eyebrows when they saw Yuan climbing past them.
They wore puzzled expressions at first, but when they saw his face and realized he wasn't from their group, that confusion turned to shock and disbelief.
"W-Who the hell are you?!" One of them cried out loud.
Yuan stopped briefly and responded, "Do you even have time to worry about me? You should focus on yourself first."
As he said that, arrows started flying at these participants.
While the others struggled to dodge the arrows, Yuan continued climbing the mountain with graceful, seemingly effortless movements, resembling a monkey that had spent its entire life scaling cliffs.
In the end, Yuan reached the top and cleared the entire obstacle course long before the previous group, setting a new record.
"He actually did it! He surpassed the previous group!"
"And look at him! He doesn't even look the slightest bit tired!"
In the other spectators' room, Sergeant Zao muttered in a low voice, "What a monster... he's even more ridiculous than General Mei's latest elite soldier."
"I can't wait to see how he performs in the last two trials..." Wu Wang said with a smile on his face.
After completing the trial, Yuan was teleported back to the room, where everyone who had passed before him was waiting. As for those who were disqualified, they were sent home immediately.
Everyone present stared at him in silence, as if they were standing before an otherworldly being beyond their comprehension.
Meanwhile, Wu Wang approached him and said, "It's been a while."
Yuan looked at him with raised eyebrows and asked, "Do I know you?"
"What are you—"
Wu Wang suddenly paused.
Then, after clearing his throat, spoke in a stiff tone, "I mistook you for someone else. My bad."
He turned around and walked away, leaving the others puzzled.
After all, if the military discovered their relationship, they would likely question him about Yuan, potentially exposing the contract between them.

Some time later, all of the remaining participants had completed the obstacle course. By the end, more than three-fourths of them had been eliminated, bringing the remaining participants to just over 10,000.
"We will proceed to the next trial immediately. Follow me," Sergeant Zao said before leading them into another room located beside the obstacle course.
The room was long and spacious, appearing empty at first glance.
"For the third trial, we will be testing your control over your Limitless. Once we start the trial, the restriction on your cultivation will be temporary removed, allowing you to use Limitless."
"Here is an example."
A moment later, a red target suddenly appeared a thousand meters away.
Then, without warning, Sergeant Zao pointed at the red target and formed a small orb of energy at his fingertip. He fired it like a bullet, striking the target and shattering it.

"The target will begin 100 meters away and move farther back each time you hit it. To pass this trial, you must strike it a total of ten times. Of course, you may continue beyond that. Anyone who manages to hit the 10,000-meter, 20,000-meter, and 40,000-meter target will receive a bonus reward at the end of the recruitment."
"Any questions?"
One of the participants raised their hand and asked, "Is there a limit to how many attempts we get to hit the target?"
Sergeant Zao raised three fingers and replied to the question, "Thirty. You get thirty shots."
