Once Yuan reached the whirlpools, he ignored them entirely and swam straight through, somehow overpowering their attempts to drag him into the depths.
"H-He swam right through the whirlpool!
I have never seen anything like that before!"
"Is such a thing even possible without using Limitless?"
"At this rate, he'll catch up to the group who went before him!
This is unprecedented!"
Some time later, Yuan reached the third obstacle.
Meanwhile, the group that started before him had only recently started the climb.
"Huh?"
The participants from that group raised their eyebrows when they saw Yuan climbing past them.
They wore puzzled expressions at first, but when they saw his face and realized he wasn't from their group, that confusion turned to shock and disbelief.
"W-Who the hell are you?!" One of them cried out loud.
Yuan stopped briefly and responded, "Do you even have time to worry about me?
You should focus on yourself first."
As he said that, arrows started flying at these participants.
While the others struggled to dodge the arrows, Yuan continued climbing the mountain with graceful, seemingly effortless movements, resembling a monkey that had spent its entire life scaling cliffs.
In the end, Yuan reached the top and cleared the entire obstacle course long before the previous group, setting a new record.
"He actually did it!
He surpassed the previous group!"
"And look at him!
He doesn't even look the slightest bit tired!"
In the other spectators' room, Sergeant Zao muttered in a low voice, "What a monster... he's even more ridiculous than General Mei's latest elite soldier."
"I can't wait to see how he performs in the last two trials..." Wu Wang said with a smile on his face.
After completing the trial, Yuan was teleported back to the room, where everyone who had passed before him was waiting.
As for those who were disqualified, they were sent home immediately.
Everyone present stared at him in silence, as if they were standing before an otherworldly being beyond their comprehension.
Meanwhile, Wu Wang approached him and said, "It's been a while."
Yuan looked at him with raised eyebrows and asked, "Do I know you?"
"What are you—"
Wu Wang suddenly paused.
Then, after clearing his throat, spoke in a stiff tone, "I mistook you for someone else.
My bad."
He turned around and walked away, leaving the others puzzled.
After all, if the military discovered their relationship, they would likely question him about Yuan, potentially exposing the contract between them.
Some time later, all of the remaining participants had completed the obstacle course.
By the end, more than three-fourths of them had been eliminated, bringing the remaining participants to just over 10,000.
"We will proceed to the next trial immediately.
Follow me," Sergeant Zao said before leading them into another room located beside the obstacle course.
The room was long and spacious, appearing empty at first glance.
"For the third trial, we will be testing your control over your Limitless.
Once we start the trial, the restriction on your cultivation will be temporary removed, allowing you to use Limitless."
"Here is an example."
A moment later, a red target suddenly appeared a thousand meters away.
Then, without warning, Sergeant Zao pointed at the red target and formed a small orb of energy at his fingertip.
He fired it like a bullet, striking the target and shattering it.
"The target will begin 100 meters away and move farther back each time you hit it.
To pass this trial, you must strike it a total of ten times.
Of course, you may continue beyond that.
Anyone who manages to hit the 10,000-meter, 20,000-meter, and 40,000-meter target will receive a bonus reward at the end of the recruitment."
"Any questions?"
One of the participants raised their hand and asked, "Is there a limit to how many attempts we get to hit the target?"
Sergeant Zao raised three fingers and replied to the question, "Thirty.
You get thirty shots."

chapters.title: Chapter 2584 Military Recruitment(7)
paragraphs: "Huh? Only thirty shots? Is it even possible to reach 40,000 meters with that amount?"
Sergeant Zao sneered and said, "You can worry about that when you reach that point, but I highly doubt anyone here... except one individual who will be able to achieve that."
Everyone there subconsciously turned their heads to look at Yuan when they heard such words.

"One last thing. You have only 15 seconds to take each shot, and if you fail to shoot within that time, you will be disqualified, even if you are on your final shot. Just like the previous trial, if you hear your number, stand at one of the available spots," Sergeant Zao said a moment later.
A total of twenty people were called at once, and once they assumed their positions behind the line, a countdown began.
At the signal, a single holographic red target appeared, hovering one hundred meters in front of the participants.
Seeing this, the participants immediately took aim.
A few seconds later, the first participant fired, striking the red target with their Limitless.
Immediately after the target was shattered, a second one appeared, but it was a hundred meters further than the last.
Whoosh!
The 2nd target was struck down a few seconds later.
Then, the 3rd appeared at 300 meters.
Seeing this made everyone present wonder how they would reach 40,000 meters with only 30 shots.
Eventually, the first participant reached their 5th target.
Although it was exactly where it was supposed to be—at 500 meters—it was no longer a still target. Rather, it moved around in a circle.
The sudden change left the shooter baffled for several seconds, disrupting their concentration and causing their first miss.
The 6th target was also moving, but instead of traveling in circles, it followed a triangular pattern and moved noticeably faster.
Several misses later, the sixth target was finally shot down.
The 7th target appeared and moved in a zig-zag pattern, also noticeably faster than the last.
Then, the 8th target appeared, moving in a completely unpredictable pattern and leaving the shooter speechless.
'Fuck! Why is the recruitment so fucking hard?!' The participants cursed inwardly.
Meanwhile, Yuan felt an urge to yawn at how boring and easy these trials were.
The 9th target followed the same random, unpredictable pattern as the last, but it moved even faster.
Eventually, someone managed to reach the 10th target, and not only did it move in an unpredictable pattern, but it would even turn invisible for two full seconds before reappearing!
"If it is already so difficult at 1,000 meters, I cannot imagine how impossible the 40,000-meter target would be...
After several disqualifications, someone finally managed to hit the 10th target, and when that happened, the 11th target appeared.
But rather than appearing at 1,100 meters, it appeared at 2,000 meters.
Although the distance doubled, it was back to being a still target.
Once the 11th target was conquered, the 12th target appeared at 3,000 meters.
The moment any participant is done shooting, another number would be called to take their place, so there was constant shooting with barely any breaks.
"Number 111,781... range 12."
"Good luck," Yuan said to her.
The moment Mei Xiaoyun stood at her spot, she took a deep breath and aimed at her 1st target.
Whoosh!
The second the 2nd target appeared, she took her second shot, striking it.
Then the 3rd... the 4th...
Mei Xiaoyun's impressive shooting speed raised many eyebrows, as she was practically shooting a target every second until the 10th target, where she took twice as long... or two seconds.
Not only did she qualify in the shortest time among all participants, but she'd done so without missing a single shot.
"W-Who is that beauty?!"
For the first time, the participants began to notice her, shocked by her dazzling performance.
"I don't know, but I think I have seen her before..."
"That's Mei Xiaoyun, and her mother is a General in the military," said someone who actually recognized her.
"Her surname is Mei? So her mother is General Mei, the one they call Ruthless General?!"
"I'm surprised you recognize her."
"If you want to take the military seriously, you should take some time to learn about those at the top..."
Eventually, Mei Xiaoyun reached the 15th target, which began moving in a circle like the 5th target.
Then she reached the 16th...17th...18th...and the 19th.
"Heavens! She's the first one to reach 10,000 meters!"
"And all without missing a single bullet!
"At this rate, she might make it to 40,000 meters!"

The 20th target was reached for the first time, and its distance was doubled, reaching 20,000 meters. Not only that, but it still moved in an unpredictable pattern and turned invisible for two seconds at a time.
Woosh!
For the first time, Mei Xiaoyun missed a shot, but she did not panic and swiftly took another, this time hitting it.
With nine attempts left, Mei Xiaoyun continued shooting with a calm expression until she used her last shot.
In the end, Mei Xiaoyun reached the 25th target at 30,000 meters.
"Amazing!"
The other participants clapped at the end.
"Not bad."
Even Sergeant Zao praised her.
As Mei Xiaoyun walked back, another number was called to replace her.
"Number 42,011, range 12!"
"Huh? 42,011? Isn't that..."
Everyone stopped clapping and turned to look at Yuan, who was already heading to his spot.
"Surely, he won't completely dominate this one, too, right?"
"There's only so much talent one can have..."
The spectators held their breath as Yuan stood at his position.
"Hm? What is he doing?"
They raised their eyebrows in puzzlement when Yuan simply stood there with his arms at his sides, as though he had no intention of participating.
However, their eyes and mouths widened with shock when the trial began.
Without even using his hand to aim at the target like everyone else, Yuan created thirty bullets around him and started shooting them one after another without pausing for more than a split second.
Pop! Pop! Pop!
The targets were destroyed one after another instantly upon their appearance, leaving everyone stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 2585 Military Recruitment(8)
paragraphs: In the blink of an eye, before anyone watching could even comprehend what they'd just witnessed, Yuan had already reached the 25th target at 30,000 meters.
However, he did not stop there and continued shooting at the same pace.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The Limitless-made bullets tore through the air with precision, striking the 26th target at 32,000 meters, then the 27th at 34,000 meters.
Then, in the time it takes for one to blink their eyes, Yuan shattered the 28th target at 36,000 meters and the 29th at 38,000 meters, leaving just a single bullet left.
However, instead of shooting it straight at the target as he'd done with the last 29 bullets, Yuan made the bullet spiral as it flew toward the 30th target at 40,000 meters.
Crack!
The sound of the target being shattered resounded, even though the target was invisible at that moment.
Everyone stared at Yuan with stunned expressions, left completely speechless by his unfathomable performance, which took less than a minute to complete.
After finishing his trial, Yuan casually walked back to the group, all of them still gawking at him with bewildered faces.
However, a voice suddenly resounded through the speakers, "Number 42,011. The higher-ups have requested that you continue the trial until you miss three shots back-to-back."
Yuan halted when he heard this and turned to look at Sergeant Zao with a puzzled expression.
Sergeant Zao swallowed nervously and slowly nodded his head before speaking, "You heard the higher-ups. Continue until you miss three shots at a time."
Without saying another word, Yuan returned to range 12, where the 31st target was already flying 45,000 meters away.
Not only was it turning invisible, but it would stay invisible for five whole seconds before reappearing for a split second. Of course, it was also moving in an unpredictable pattern.
Despite that, Yuan attacked it without hesitation, hitting the target with precision.
The 32nd target appeared a second later at 50,000 meters.
A few moments later, Yuan reached the 40th target at 90,000 meters without missing a single shot, leaving the spectators bewildered.
Many of them couldn't even see that far, let alone hit it!
"Is it possible that he's somehow cheating?" One of the participants suddenly questioned aloud.
"Cheating? And how would he achieve that with so many people watching?"
"I-I don't know... I'm just throwing the possibility out there since it's so hard to believe what I am seeing to be real."
"I don't blame you. I am also in disbelief right now. Just who is that guy? Does anyone know?"
Everyone there shook their heads.
As for Mei Xiaoyun, not wanting to deal with the hassle, she remained silent.
Meanwhile, Shi Fa and Wu Wang watched from afar.
"That fucking monster is casually achieving what experienced elite soldiers could barely achieve after decades of training!" Wu Wang cried out loud.
"He is already beyond what a monster can achieve..." Shi Fa sighed before continuing, "I doubt he's even human."
Some time later, Yuan reached the 50th target at 200,000 meters. However, even though he was capable of hitting it, he deliberately missed all three shots because he couldn't be bothered to continue.
Of course, he also deliberately started missing one or two shots for the last five targets to not make it too obvious.
"Looks like that was my limit," Yuan said in a somewhat disappointed voice, pretending to look sad.
"There's no need to be disappointed. Believe it or not, you're already at the level of our elite soldiers," Sergeant Zaos said.
"Is that so?"
Yuan then asked, "Anyway, do I get any bonus reward for that?
"That's..." Sergeant Zao opened his mouth but was speechless for a moment.
Eventually, he replied in a somewhat awkward tone, "That will be up to the higher-ups. If they decided you deserve a bonus reward, then you will get it."
"Alright."
The trial had stopped momentarily when Yuan was called back to the range, but now that he was done, the remaining participants who had yet to shoot were called to the range.
Meanwhile, in the private spectator's room, the higher-ups spoke about Yuan's achievements.
"Quite frankly, I think we should just make him an elite soldier from the get-go," one of them suggested.
"I agree. Not only are his capabilities far beyond the ordinary soldier, but he even rivals some of our most experienced elite soldiers."

"I am afraid that might set a bad precedent since nobody has ever received such treatment before, and even that monster recruited by General Mei had to climb the ranks normally, albeit faster than others."

"Then are you suggesting we throw him in with the other soldiers? His presence will undoubtedly affect their morale and confidence. Don't you remember what happened with the other one? Her mere presence lowered morale to dangerous levels. I don't even want to imagine how catastrophic it would be with this guy, who's even more monstrous."
"What is your opinion on this matter, General Gu?" Someone there suddenly asked him.

General Gu pondered for a moment before responding, "I agree that we shouldn't mix him with the other soldiers. However, we also shouldn't be too obvious with our favoritism. How about this? We won't outright make him an elite soldier. Rather, we'll give him a mission and promote him after he completes it."
"That's perfect! If we give him a mission that most soldiers cannot handle, nobody would complain about his promotions!"
"That's good and all, but he still has one more trial to pass before he qualifies—"
"What nonsense are you talking about? Even if he fails the next trial, nobody would be dumb enough to actually disqualify him."
"Speaking of the final trial... who should we pair against him? I doubt it would be entertaining if we followed the plan."
"I already have someone in mind," General Gu said with a mysterious grin.
The others swallowed nervously after seeing his expression.
"Try not to go overboard, General... After all, he is General Mei's—"

"General Mei? If we let her get a hold of him, her position within the military will definitely become unshakable. We cannot allow such a thing to happen!" General Gu shouted, slamming the desk in irritation and instantly silencing the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 2586 Military Recruitment(9)
paragraphs: "Listen carefully. I do not care if General Mei found him first. We cannot allow him to join her division!" General Gu declared.

No one in the room responded, as they all understood why he was so determined to stop Yuan from joining General Mei's division. After all, General Gu was currently competing with her for the military's top rank, and she already held a slight advantage thanks to her latest talented recruit.
If she gained someone like Yuan as well, surpassing her would become countless times more difficult.
Although this was mostly a fight between General Gu and General Mei, each had their own people and sides, and everyone in the room sided with General Gu.
Meanwhile, in another room, Mei Feng and several other high-ranking soldiers were also watching the trial.
"Where did you find such a monster? Do you have a special machine that brings you directly to them or something?"
One of the soldiers asked her after witnessing Yuan's performance in the third trial.
Mei Feng smiled and said, "As much as I want to take credit, I wasn't the one who found him. Instead, it was my daughter who found him."
"Speaking of your daughter, why didn't you tell us that she'd participate in this year's recruitment? Do you have any idea how shocked I was to see her?"
Mei Feng shook her head and said, "I am just as surprised as you are since I also had nothing to do with her participation in the recruitment."
"Hm? Does that mean your daughter joined because of 42,011? What's their relationship? Don't tell me that they're lovers..."
"That is none of my business," Mei Feng said nonchalantly.

"This isn't the time for jokes, Captain Jing. Although it's great for us that he's so talented, I'm worried about what General Gu's side might do. I highly doubt they'd let us have him without a fight, after all."
"Do you think there's a chance they might be able to steal him from us?" someone else then asked.
"No, it's not possible," Mei Feng responded with confidence.
"Did you already make a contract with him or something?"
Mei Feng nodded, "But that's not the only reason why.
"What other reason do you have?"
"Sorry, but I can't tell you, even if it's you guys."
"Is that so?"
"As for General Gu..." Mei Feng narrowed her eyes slightly. "Let's see what he has planned first."
Eventually, the third trial ended, and, surprisingly, more than half of the participants passed.
"There is one last trial left before you are accepted into the military," Sergeant Zao said to the remaining 7,000 participants, then led them to another room.
This room was not as large as the previous rooms, and it had a single raised platform in the middle with rows of seats around it, most of them already occupied by soldiers.
"For the final trial, each of you will have to fight a soldier," said Sergeant Zao.
"What?!"
The recruits exclaimed in shock; their expressions quickly turned concerned.
They were all civilians without proper training, and even those who had been trained because of their background couldn't hope to come close to a trained soldier.
"There's no way any of us can defeat a soldier!"
Sergeant Zao shook his head and elaborated, "Nobody is expecting or asking you to defeat a soldier. In fact, regardless of the results, you won't be disqualified."
"Huh? Doesn't that mean we've already..."
"That's right. You have all technically already qualified to join the military, and this is simply a traditional event—a celebration of sorts."

In reality, however, it was anything but a celebration. While Sergeant Zao was telling the truth that no one would be disqualified by this event, its true purpose was to condition the newly recruited soldiers and instill fear into them. More than anything, it served as a humiliation ritual designed to break whatever arrogance or ego they might have.
Of course, several of the recruits, who had family in the military, were aware of this.

"Once your number is called, enter the stage. If you manage to defeat a soldier, you'll be given a special pass to skip the year-long training that everyone will be required to do after joining the military, so work hard," said Sergeant Zao.

Nobody was surprised to hear that they still needed to train for a year before they could become proper soldiers, but since many of them had no hope of defeating a soldier, they'd already resigned themselves to their fate.
Soon, the first recruit was called onto the stage to fight a soldier.
"Number 8,091."
While the soldier could've easily defeated the recruit, they did not rush to do so. Instead, they messed around for a bit, like a hunter playing with its prey before consuming them.

sentences.text: "Listen carefully.
I do not care if General Mei found him first.

No one in the room responded, as they all understood why he was so determined to stop Yuan from joining General Mei's division.
After all, General Gu was currently competing with her for the military's top rank, and she already held a slight advantage thanks to her latest talented recruit.

"Did you already make a contract with him or something?"

"Is that so?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2587 Captain Gu
paragraphs: "I'd be lying if I said that I wasn't even slightly nervous," Mei Xiaoyun admitted. "But I should be fine."
She turned to look at his unconcerned face and continued, "If I were in your shoes, I'd be a little worried."
Yuan raised an eyebrow and asked, "Why?"

"Because this trial's true purpose is to put us in our place so we don't become too arrogant. You've done nothing but show off for the entire recruitment, so they will definitely prepare someone special for you...someone who will be able to defeat you."
"I wouldn't say I was showing off..." Yuan remarked. "If anything, I held back as much as I could."
"You were holding back?" Mei Xiaoyun muttered with a dumbfounded expression.
The other recruits around them also looked at him with dazed expressions, wondering whether he was telling the truth or just bragging.

Time passed quickly as the soldiers continued beating the recruits. However, not everyone received the same treatment. Those from influential families or with connections in the military were beaten far less severely than those from ordinary backgrounds.
Eventually, Mei Xiaoyun was called onto the stage.
"H-Hey! Isn't that Sergeant Lin, an elite soldier?! Why is she getting onto the stage? Don't tell me she's going to fight that recruit?"
The soldiers were shocked when an elite soldier entered the stage, as they only appear for special occasions, and the last time such a thing happened was several decades ago.
"Who is that recruit?" One of the soldiers there asked aloud, hoping someone knew her.
"I think that's General Mei's daughter, Mei Xiaoyun. I've seen her participating in the recruitment when she was much younger, but she'd never participated in the final trial."
"Does this mean she'll be joining the military for real this time? How exciting!"
On the stage, Mei Xiaoyun narrowed her eyes at Sergeant Lin and asked, "Did my mother send you?"
Sergeant Lin smiled and replied, "I don't know what you're talking about, but consider this an honor, as not many people get the chance to fight an elite soldier on this stage."
Mei Xiaoyun did not respond and readied herself.
"Whenever you're ready." Sergeant Lin beckoned to her.
A moment later, Mei Xiaoyun acted, moving to close the distance between them.
"Nice movements," Sergeant Lin whistled.
Once Mei Xiaoyun was close enough, she struck without hesitation, her fist tearing through the air with speed and intensity.
However, Sergeant Lin casually caught her fists.
Mei Xiaoyun immediately prepared for the counter, but it never came.
Instead, Sergeant Lin released her and said, "I'll give you a few more tries."
Mei Xiaoyun did not respond and immediately went for a second strike...then a third...and a fourth.
However, no matter how much she tried, she was unable to even get close to hitting Sergeant Lin.
"Not bad. With enough training, you'll definitely become an elite soldier within twenty years," Sergeant Lin said.
"Unfortunately, we don't have all day, so I'm going to start attacking now."
After saying those words, Sergeant Lin stopped being defensive and went on the offense, quickly overwhelming Mei Xiaoyun.

A punch in the guts. A kick to the sides. A chop behind her neck. A slap in the face. Xiao Meiyun was struck in nearly every part of her body, and while Sergeant Lin wasn't hitting her as heavily as the others, it was still quite brutal.
Despite the beatdown, Mei Xiaoyun did not give up, nor did she make any noises.
The match ended after several minutes, with Mei Xiaoyun barely able to remain conscious by the end.
"Oh? I'm surprised you managed to stay awake. I wanted to knock you out, at the very least," said Sergeant Lin.
"If you hadn't gone easy on me, I would have," said Mei Xiaoyun.

Sergeant Lin shrugged and said, "Well, it's not like I can beat the General's daughter too badly in front of so many people. You can come find me for a rematch whenever. However, I won't go easy like I did today."
Afterward, Sergeant Lin left the stage, her eyes stopping at Yuan for a split second.
Mei Xiaoyun slowly exited the stage shortly after.

One would expect the recruits to receive medical treatment afterward, but most of them received no help and had to naturally recover, and only those who were beaten to the verge of death were treated.
By now, only a few people had not yet taken the stage, and they were all recruits who had shown impressive results during the trials.
Naturally, Yuan was one of them.
One...two...three more matches later, only Yuan and another recruit were left, and he was the one who finished second during the first trial.
"Number 7,441!"
"Here!
Number 7,441 suddenly turned to look at Yuan and said, "Just you watch! I will be the first to defeat a soldier today!"
He entered the stage with enthusiasm the next moment, hoping to fight an elite soldier like Mei Xiaoyun, even if it would drastically lower his chances of winning.
However, his opponent turned out to be an ordinary soldier, leaving him disappointed and bitter.
A few minutes later, number 7,441 was beaten until he was unconscious and had to be carried off the stage.
Once Yuan was the only one remaining, every soldier present turned their attention to him.
Almost everyone there had witnessed Yuan's performance during the trial, so they were aware of what he was capable of.
"Number 42,011!"
Hearing his number, Yuan entered the stage and calmly waited for his opponent to appear.
"Who do you think will fight him?"
"Surely, it has to be another elite soldier."
The soldiers mumbled to each other while they waited.
Suddenly, a massive silhouette leaped onto the platform.
"Heavens!"
The soldiers exclaimed in shock upon seeing the figure, who stood nearly twice Yuan's size.
However, it was the man's size that shocked them.
Rather, it was the man's identity.
"C-Captain Gu?!"
"No way! Are they going to make a Captain fight a recruit?! This is unprecedented!"
After all, the soldier standing on the stage was not just a mere elite soldier but someone who commanded them!

chapters.title: Chapter 2588 Captain Gu(2)
paragraphs: "I'm Captain Gu, leader of the 3rd Company under the 7th Division," Captain Gu introduced himself shortly after making his appearance.
"Yuan," Yuan responded with a simple, even lackluster introduction.
"Before we begin, I have something to tell you. A proposal of sorts," Captain Gu suddenly said.
"I'm not interested," Yuan rejected before even hearing it.
Knowing that the individual before him bore the surname 'Gu', Yuan already knew that it was going to be some nonsense.

Captain Gu immediately frowned and said, "You're arrogant, but I don't blame you. I would be too if I had your talents. However, no matter how talented you are, you won't last long in the military with that attitude, especially toward those with a higher rank than you."
"Anyway, you will listen to me regardless of whether you want to or not, as what I am about to say comes from a position way higher than mine."
"If you're going to say it, hurry up and say it already," Yuan sighed.
"General Gu, who commands the Fifth to Eighth Division, has ordered you to join his division," said Captain Gu.
"That's not possible, since I have already promised to join General Mei's division," Yuan calmly replied, admitting that he'd already made a deal with her.
"Why aren't they fighting? What are they talking about?"
A formation had surrounded the arena the moment Captain Gu entered the stage, so the spectators were not able to hear their conversation.
Yet, many of them could guess what it was about.
"Captain Gu's probably trying to recruit him. There's no way General Gu wouldn't want a talented individual like him in his division, after all."
"Right. He's been anxious to find someone who can rival the monster under General Mei's division."
"I don't blame him. The power dynamic in the military has shifted greatly since her appearance."
"What did General Mei promise you?" Captain Gu inquired before adding, "Whatever she promised you, General Gu can double—even triple!"
"General Mei promised me her daughter," Yuan lied with a straight face.
His unexpected response left Captain Gu speechless, with a dumbfounded expression on his square face.
"Just kidding," Yuan said a moment later.
"YOU!"
Feeling like he'd just been mocked, Captain Gu's face quickly turned beet red.
Yuan continued, "Regardless of what she promised me, it won't change the fact that I am under a contract with her."

Captain Gu quickly controlled his emotions and replied, "So what if you are under contract? There are ways to circumvent it depending on the details. For example, if you only promised to join her division, you can simply join her division and leave immediately afterward."
"Even if you can't, it's not like you will die by breaking the contract, and General Gu will compensate you and more for your troubles. There is literally no disadvantage to joining him."
Yuan fell silent for a moment before asking, "Why are you so desperate to recruit me?"
"What?" Captain Gu frowned.
"You heard me. Your desperation is so obvious and pitiful..." Yuan shook his head.
"Anyway, no matter what you offer me, I have no intention of joining your division."

Captain Gu trembled in anger and spoke in a low voice, "This is your last chance, recruit... If you disobey General Gu's order, you can kiss your career in the military goodbye. And if you think General Mei can save you... Even she won't be able to stop us from destroying you."
"I'll give credit where it's due... you're persistent. However, I won't be repeating myself, so do what you must," Yuan calmly replied.
"Then don't blame me for whatever happens after this point!"
The next moment, Captain Gu leaped into the air before slamming his massive body at Yuan with the intention of flattening him.
Even without the usage of Limitless, Captain Gu was able to crack the platform and even create a small crater on it.
"The fight is finally starting!"
"You rarely get to witness a Captain fight, too!"
Yuan, who had moved away almost instantly after Captain Gu acted, dodged the attack with ease.
"How dangerous. Are you trying to kill me?" Yuan asked, even though he already knew Captain Gu's intentions.
Captain Gu ignored him entirely and continued his relentless assault, his eyes brimming with unmistakable killing intent.
'If he refuses to join us... Kill him!'
General Gu's command resounded inside Captain Gu's mind repeatedly like a broken record.
Despite Captain Gu's clear killing intent and aggressive attacks, Yuan remained calm and avoided all attacks with seemingly no effort.
"I don't know how high your position is within the military, but your combat experience is worse than those two in Gaia's Sanctum," he remarked.
"Hell, it's even worse than some of the ordinary soldiers who'd fought before you."
Yuan shook his head in disappointment.
"Is everyone under General Gu this weak?"
"SHUT UP!"
Captain Gu roared, his aura suddenly expanding.
"Hm?" Yuan raised an eyebrow at the sight of Limitless suddenly emerging from Captain Gu's body.
Unbeknownst to Yuan, soldiers of a certain rank can temporarily unseal their cultivation, and as a Captain, Captain Gu could unleash his cultivation up to the Fourth Ascension.
"Captain Gu?!"
The spectators were shocked to see Captain Gu suddenly use Limitless.
Inside a certain private room, Mei Feng narrowed her eyes at the situation.
"These dirty bastards!" Someone else in the room cursed out loud. "To think they would go as far as to kill him just to stop him from joining my division! They've gone too far!"
"General Mei! We need to stop them before it's too late! There's no way that recruit can handle a soldier using Limitless while being suppressed himself for long!"
However, Mei Feng did not move from her seat and merely said, "Let's watch a little longer."
"What?!"
The others in the room were completely baffled by her lack of reaction, wondering how she could remain so calm in such a situation.
But in reality, Mei Feng was anything but calm.

chapters.title: Chapter 2589 Captain Gu(3)
paragraphs: Despite her calm appearance, Mei Feng was anything but calm. In fact, her heart was burning with fury.

'Even though he has the Perfected Heavenly Refinement physique, he won't be able to deal with a Fourth Ascension cultivator without using Limitless. Not to mention, his opponent is a Captain,' Mei Feng thought to herself.
However, something in her gut told her not to worry about Yuan.
'He's far too calm...' Mei Feng narrowed her eyes at Yuan's nonchalant expression, giving her the impression that he was not worried about Captain Gu in the slightest.
Although that did not completely alleviate her concern about the situation, it was enough to help her to not freak out about the situation.
"General... Are you sure we should just sit here and do nothing?"
Meanwhile, her comrades viewed the situation differently, mistaking Yuan's calmness for shock.

Mei Feng shook her head and said, "Did you really think that I would let such a prominent recruit participate in the recruitment without supervision? I knew General Gu would do something, but even I could've never anticipated he would do something this bold. He won't die, at the very least, so you can all relax."
"If you say so..."
They sat back down and continued watching the events unfold.
On the stage, Yuan smiled.
"I didn't know the soldiers could use their cultivation for this," he remarked.
Of course, they were not allowed to use their cultivation, but Yuan already knew that.
"Now you do!" Captain Gu shouted as he charged at Yuan, his speed several times faster than before.
"Now this is a little more entertaining," Yuan chuckled, still somehow managing to react and dodge Captain Gu's attacks.
"Stop running away like a cockroach and fight me!" Captain Gu roared.
"Fight you? Without being able to use Limitless? You might as well tell me to jump off a bridge—not that it would kill me."
Yuan continued dodging Captain Gu left and right, which left the spectators speechless.
"What the fuck is that idiot doing?!" General Gu slammed his desk in anger upon witnessing Captain Gu's humiliating performance.
"How hard is it to take care of a single recruit?! He's even using his cultivation!"
"Well... in Captain Gu's defense, he cannot make it too obvious, or—"
The individual who had just spoken hastily closed their mouth when General Gu suddenly glared at them with a cold, dangerous gaze.
One minute... two minutes... five minutes...

Soon, the amount of time Yuan and Captain Gu spent on the stage surpassed that of any of the recruits before them, and as Captain Gu's embarrassment grew for not being able to hit Yuan, he stopped caring about concealing his intentions and began using Limitless for real.
"C-Captain Gu's using his Limitless without restraint now! This is my first time seeing such a serious fight during the recruitment!"
"Because as far as I am aware, it has never happened before..."
"I thought we weren't allowed to use our cultivation for this...?" Someone who had participated before mumbled out loud.
"Well, nobody is stopping them, so Captain Gu must have received permission."
"Even so, I think they are going overboard..."
"I think so, too. Captain Gu is fighting like he wants to kill that recruit."
"I don't blame them. That recruit is a freaking monster."
The spectators were divided over the situation. Some felt Captain Gu was taking things too far, while others believed such measures were necessary to deal with someone as powerful as Yuan.
"Unbelievable..." The soldiers in Mei Feng's private room were bewildered by Yuan's performance.
"Just where in heaven's name did he learn to fight like that?!"
"Those movements are something you can only learn through experience and an unfathomable amount of time... but he doesn't look anywhere old enough to have even half of such experience!"
While everyone was baffled by his combat capabilities, Yuan was starting to get bored with the whole thing and wondered how he should handle the situation.
'Should I just defeat him?' he wondered inwardly.
But after some consideration, he decided not to do anything that would draw more unnecessary attention to himself, especially since he already had a target on his back.
If he defeated Captain Gu right now, he would have to deal with those in an even higher position, which would only make things more complicated.
'There are still many things I need to achieve in the military, so it would be unwise to offend too many people now.'
After sighing inwardly, Yuan suddenly pretended to stumble, deliberately leaving himself open.
Captain Gu did not miss the opportunity and immediately took advantage of it.
"DIE!"
The next moment, Captain Gu drove his fist into Yuan's stomach—or at least, that was how it appeared to the spectators—sending Yuan flying off the stage and crashing into the crowd.
However, despite being certain that he had struck Yuan, Captain Gu could not shake the feeling that something was wrong.
'I need to make sure he's actually dead!'
Without hesitation, Captain Gu leaped off the stage and launched another attack at Yuan, who lay unconscious among the crowd.
The soldiers surrounding Yuan were stunned by Captain Gu's actions, yet not a single one of them dared to intervene—not that they could do anything without their cultivation.
However, just before Captain Gu could reach Yuan, someone appeared before him like a ghost, catching his fist that would've directly smashed Yuan's head into a bloody mess.
"What do you think you're doing?!" Captain Gu immediately turned to look at the individual who stopped him.
"I should be asking you that question, Captain Gu. Why are you still attacking him, even though he's clearly unconscious? Are you actually trying to kill him?" A woman's voice responded to him.
"Y-You are—!" Captain Gu's eyes widened with surprise when he finally realized who had blocked his attack. "What the hell are you doing here? I thought you left for a mission!"
"I was on a mission, but I already completed it," she calmly responded.
"You completed a mission that was estimated to take over a year in just a month?! That's outrageous!" Captain Gu exclaimed in disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 2590 End of the Military Recruitment
paragraphs: "Outrageous or not, it doesn't change the fact that I have completed the mission," said the woman.
"You—"
"If you insist on continuing this fight, I'll be more than happy to take his place," she interrupted as Captain Gu opened his mouth. "Or do you only prefer opponents who are unconscious?"
Captain Gu gritted his teeth in frustration, but there was nothing he could do in this situation.
Not only was it no longer possible for him to kill Yuan without ruining his career in the military, but he had utterly no chance of defeating the woman standing before him.
With no other choice, Captain Gu pulled back his arm and said, "It's just a misunderstanding. I wasn't actually going to hit him. I just wanted to see if he was faking it."
Without elaborating further, Captain Gu turned around and quickly left the scene.
The woman didn't pursue things further and immediately went to pick Yuan up, taking him away.
Some time later, Yuan slowly opened his eyes to find himself lying on a bed in a quiet room.
Of course, he was conscious the entire time, but pretended to be asleep until he was finally alone.
'That was...'
Although Yuan didn't get to see the face of the individual who stopped Captain Gu, as she'd immediately left after bringing him to the room, he recognized her just from her voice alone.
Suddenly, he heard the door to the room being opened.
When he turned to the sound, he could see two figures entering the room.
One of them was Mei Xiaoyun, and the other was Mei Feng.
"Are you okay?" Mei Xiaoyun asked him.
Yuan nodded with a smile, "I'm not hurt in the slightest."
"You know you won't die if you stop acting tough for a second, right?" Mei Feng sighed while shaking her head.
Yuan chuckled.
"I am being serious, though. I know it looked brutal, but his attack didn't even land on me."
Yuan patted his stomach aggressively to show them he was perfectly fine.
He then asked, "So, what happens now? Are you going to punish that soldier for attempting to kill me?"

An apologetic expression appeared on Mei Feng's face as she responded, "Unfortunately, it's not that simple. Not only is he a Captain, but he's also General Gu's nephew. Not to mention the trial in itself is meant to rough up the recruits."
"But he used Limitless during the fight, and as far as I am aware, that's not allowed. Surely, you can punish him for that," Mei Xiaoyun said.
Mei Feng shook her head. "Actually, there is no explicit rule prohibiting the use of Limitless during the fight."
"No way... so we're just going to let him get away with almost killing him?" Mei Xiaoyun frowned.
Yuan then said, "That's perfect."
"What?"
The two ladies turned to look at him, their eyebrows raised, puzzled by his words.
"There's no need to punish him because I will do that myself," he elaborated.
"What do you intend to do to him?" Mei Feng asked with a slight frown, looking concerned.
"Nothing... at least not right now," he shrugged.
Mei Feng rubbed her eyes and sighed aloud, "Forget it. I don't care what you do as long as you don't kill him."
"Anyway, with the recruitment done, you've officially joined the military and are a soldier now."

"Never thought I'd join the military again..." Yuan muttered in a low voice, his eyes suddenly full of nostalgia as he recalled his life in the military as Tian Xian, even though it was vastly different from his current situation.
"You've been in the military before?" Mei Xiaoyun asked, looking confused.
"Yes, in my original world."
After a moment of silence, Mei Feng turned to look at Mei Xiaoyun and said to her, "Go outside for a bit. I need some time alone with him."
Mei Xiaoyun nodded and left without question.
Once they were alone, Mei Feng said to Yuan, "Now that you're a soldier, let's get some things straight."

"First, regardless of your capabilities, you must obey anyone with a higher rank than you. Even though we've only spoken a few times, I have a good grasp of your personality, and if you want to stay in the military for long enough to learn about Gaia, you must obey our rules."
"I will do my best," Yuan replied.

"Second, because of your performance during the recruitment, you have been granted an exemption from the mandatory year-long boot camp that every new recruit must complete, allowing you to skip it entirely and begin serving as a soldier immediately."

"Furthermore, for hitting the 10,000-meter target during the third trial, you've been granted an entire month's worth of leave that you can use at any time. This is something that would normally take an ordinary soldier five whole years to accumulate."
"For hitting the 20,000-meter target, you will be able to request personal training from an elite soldier, so someone at the rank of Sergeant."

"As for hitting the 40,000-meter target, you will receive a direct promotion to the rank of Private First Class. Everyone starts out at the lowest rank, Private, upon joining the military, and it can take anywhere between two and five years to be promoted to Private First Class, depending on their merits."

"Now then... You also broke the records for every trial during the recruitment. In recognition of such an extraordinary achievement, the military has decided to grant you another direct promotion—to the rank of Corporal, a position that normally takes ten years to reach after becoming a Private First Class."
"Any questions so far?"
Yuan smiled and said, "I believe you are missing one more reward."
His gaze turned to look at the door behind her, or more precisely, at Mei Xiaoyun, who was standing outside.

Mei Feng sighed. "Don't worry, I haven't forgotten about our deal. I'll reward you for persuading her to join the military, but it will take some time to prepare. And since I want to keep it a surprise, I won't tell you until then."

chapters.title: Chapter 2591 General Gu
paragraphs: "Now that I am in the military... what am I supposed to do next? How do I gain more credentials?" Yuan asked.

"Although you've passed the recruitment, you're technically still not a soldier—at least not until the ceremony and you receive your insignia. Once you become a soldier, your credentials will automatically increase as you increase your rank and gain merits," said Mei Feng.
"When is the ceremony?"
"In a week. Until then, you will need to take some classes, which will tell you more about our world."
"Does that mean you believe my true origins?" Yuan asked with a smile.
"I think your existence is otherworldly, and I will leave it at that," she calmly replied.
"Good enough, I guess."

"Now, about which division you'll be joining... I command the First to the Fourth Division, so you can join any of these four. General Gu commands the Fifth to Eighth Division, so keep that in mind when you meet soldiers from his division."

"Speaking of General Gu... Do you think he'll give up on trying to recruit me? Or rather, will he stop trying to kill me because I refused to join his division? He clearly intends to and has already attempted to kill me because of it," Yuan asked.

After a moment of silence, Mei Feng responded in a weird tone, "As much as I want to assure you of your safety, I cannot do that with a clear conscience. However, I will try my best to get General Gu off your back. I will also have a few people guard you for the time being."
"Thanks."
"It's too early to thank me," she sighed. "But if you really want to thank someone, you can thank the one who saved you."
"I would if I could. Where did she go? She left before I could thank her," Yuan said.
"She's a busy woman, but I'm sure you'll get to meet her again soon."
"I'm sure we will..."
"In any case, a nurse will be coming to check on you soon."
"I'm fine, though."
"That's for the nurse to decide."
"We'll talk more later," Mei Feng said to him before leaving the room.
A few moments later, the door opened again, and Mei Xiaoyun entered the room.
"My mother left, but she told me to stay with you until your nurse and bodyguards show up," she said before Yuan could speak up.
"To think I'd need bodyguards the moment I joined the military. This place is pretty messed up for somewhere that's supposed to be orderly." Yuan shook his head with a bittersweet smile.
"It wasn't always like this..." Mei Xiaoyun sighed.
"Let me guess. It all started after General Gu appeared."

"Not just General Gu. The Gu Family in general. They are one of the most powerful families in the world, with authority and reach in nearly every corner of the world. They started in the business scene, but I guess they weren't satisfied with whatever they had and wanted to control the military, too."
"Is that so?"
A few minutes later, the nurse arrived at the room and started examining Yuan's body.
"Huh? I heard you were struck quite heavily during the recruitment, but there don't seem to be any injuries on your body," remarked the nurse, looking confused by the situation.
"They were exaggerating," Yuan said with a calm smile.
"Well... as long as you're fine, but just in case, let me double-check."
The nurse proceeded to examine Yuan again. Once she was certain that he was not hurt, she signed out and left the room.
"I heard we need to take classes until our ceremony next week."
Mei Xiaoyun nodded and said, "The classes will start tomorrow. They briefed us after you were taken away, and they said that we'll be assigned to our own residents later today."
Some time later, someone knocked on the door.
"Is Corporal Yuan inside?" A voice questioned from outside.
"I am. Did Mei—General Mei send you here?" Yuan asked.
"Indeed."
"Come inside."
The next moment, two soldiers entered the room.
Yuan raised an eyebrow after seeing these two soldiers. One of them was a man who looked like Hong Xiuquan, and the other was a woman who resembled Wang Bingbing.
"I'm Sergeant Quang."
"Sergeant Bing. We were assigned to be your bodyguard by General Mei."
"Nice to meet you," Yuan said.
"I don't know who you are, but you must be fairly important to General Mei if she made two Elite Soldiers guard you," said Sergeant Bing.
"Did you not watch the recruitment?" Sergeant Quang asked her with raised eyebrows.
"No."
"This guy's the top performer. Not only that, but he broke every single record held by the Ironwoman."
"What?! That's impossible!" Sergeant Bing exclaimed in disbelief before turning to stare at Yuan with wide eyes.
"Ironwoman?" Yuan inquired.
"The woman who saved you. That's what we all call her since we don't know her actual name."
"Huh? You don't know her name? That's possible in the military?" Mei Xiaoyun remarked, surprised.
"It's possible to hide your identity in the military if you have enough influence," said Sergeant Bing, and she continued, "So she's definitely from a powerful family."
"And the military is fine with that?" Yuan asked.

Sergeant Quang shrugged and said, "Nobody cares as long as she does her duties as a soldier. And it's not like nobody knows her identity. The higher-ups are aware, and that's all that really matters."
"Anyway, are you okay? Can you leave the infirmary yet?"
Yuan nodded. "The nurse said I can leave whenever."
"Then we'll take you to your living quarters."
Sergeant Bing looked at Mei Xiaoyun and added, "General Mei also told us to show you your living quarters."
"Okay..."
While Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun followed Sergeant Bing and Sergeant Quang to their living quarters, Mei Feng approached a room that was guarded by two soldiers.
"General Mei, what are you doing—"
"Scram," she interrupted. "I have some business with General Gu."
"I'm afraid that's not—"
Before the soldier could even finish his sentence, Mei Feng grabbed him by the collar and tossed him to the other end of the hallway.
"What do you think you're—?!"
The other soldier reacted instinctively and reached for her, but instantly froze when Mei Feng's gaze shifted to him.
"E-Even if you're the General, you can't be doing this..."
"And what are you going to do? Report me to the higher-ups?
The soldier became speechless.
Suddenly, General Gu's voice resounded from inside the room.
"Let her in," he said.
Without another word, Mei Feng walked past the soldiers and entered the room.
At the other end, General Gu was calmly sitting behind his desk.
"You're here much faster than I anticipated," he calmly said.
"If you knew that I would come here, then you must also know why I am here," she said.
"I wouldn't be too sure about that."
"Let's cut the bullshit. You tried to kill my recruit because you couldn't get your hands on him." Mei Feng narrowed her eyes at him.

"That's a serious accusation, General Mei. Do you have any proof? I admit my nephew went a little overboard during the match, but he believed that level of force was necessary to teach such an anomaly a lesson. Moreover, nothing he did was against the rules, and that includes wielding Limitless."
Mei Feng sneered in disdain before responding, "You can spew all the bullshit you want, but if anything happens to my recruit, I will not just come for you, but your entire family."
A stunned look appeared on General Gu's face for a moment before he burst out laughing.
"Are you really threatening me... my family? What can you possibly do to me with your puny little family, let alone my empire? You may be a General, but you have no power outside of the military!"
"Is that what you truly believe?" Mei Feng chuckled. "In that case, you know less about me than I thought. How surprising."

The smile on General Gu's face quickly faded, replaced by a frown. However, before he could say anything, Mei Feng continued, "You may bear the same rank as me, but you're nowhere near being my equal, General Gu—not that I need to tell you, since I'm sure you're already aware of this."
"What did you say, you fucking bitch?!" General Gu slammed his desk as he stood up in anger.

Mei Feng burst out laughing at his reaction. "Don't tell me you actually believe you're my equal. Without your family's influence, I doubt you would have even reached the rank of Major, let alone General!"

"Still, you're free to prove me wrong. Instead of trying to steal my recruits, go find your own. If your Gu Family is truly as almighty as you claim, you shouldn't have any trouble finding a few decent talents."
"That's all I have to say to you today."
With that, Mei Feng turned and walked toward the door. Just before opening it, she added, "I won't warn you again. If I find out you're going after Yuan again, I'll end you."
Once Mei Feng left, General Gu sat back down with a sinister expression on his face.
"There are plenty of ways to kill someone and make it appear to be an accident..." he mumbled to himself. "I will make you regret threatening and belittling me today, Mei Feng!"
Meanwhile, Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun arrived at their living quarters.

"Normally, new recruits will live at the barracks and share rooms with several others, but as a Corporal and the top performer in the recruitment, you get to live in the same area as the Sergeants and have a building all to yourself," said Sergeant Quang.
"I'm not a Corporal, though," Mei Xiaoyun said.
"No, but you're General Mei's daughter," said Sergeant Bing.
"I never asked for special treatment." Mei Xiaoyun frowned.
Sergeant Bing shrugged.
"If you have any complaints, feel free to take them up with your mother. She was the one who arranged your living quarters."

"That's for the nurse to decide."
"We'll talk more later," Mei Feng said to him before leaving the room.
A few moments later, the door opened again, and Mei Xiaoyun entered the room.
"My mother left, but she told me to stay with you until your nurse and bodyguards show up," she said before Yuan could speak up.
"To think I'd need bodyguards the moment I joined the military.
This place is pretty messed up for somewhere that's supposed to be orderly." Yuan shook his head with a bittersweet smile.
"It wasn't always like this..." Mei Xiaoyun sighed.
"Let me guess.
It all started after General Gu appeared."
"Not just General Gu.
The Gu Family in general.
They are one of the most powerful families in the world, with authority and reach in nearly every corner of the world.
They started in the business scene, but I guess they weren't satisfied with whatever they had and wanted to control the military, too."
"Is that so?"
A few minutes later, the nurse arrived at the room and started examining Yuan's body.
"Huh?
I heard you were struck quite heavily during the recruitment, but there don't seem to be any injuries on your body," remarked the nurse, looking confused by the situation.
"They were exaggerating," Yuan said with a calm smile.
"Well... as long as you're fine, but just in case, let me double-check."
The nurse proceeded to examine Yuan again.
Once she was certain that he was not hurt, she signed out and left the room.
"I heard we need to take classes until our ceremony next week."
Mei Xiaoyun nodded and said, "The classes will start tomorrow.
They briefed us after you were taken away, and they said that we'll be assigned to our own residents later today."
Some time later, someone knocked on the door.
"Is Corporal Yuan inside?" A voice questioned from outside.
"I am.
Did Mei—General Mei send you here?" Yuan asked.
"Indeed."
"Come inside."
The next moment, two soldiers entered the room.
Yuan raised an eyebrow after seeing these two soldiers.
One of them was a man who looked like Hong Xiuquan, and the other was a woman who resembled Wang Bingbing.
"I'm Sergeant Quang."
"Sergeant Bing.
We were assigned to be your bodyguard by General Mei."
"Nice to meet you," Yuan said.
"I don't know who you are, but you must be fairly important to General Mei if she made two Elite Soldiers guard you," said Sergeant Bing.
"Did you not watch the recruitment?" Sergeant Quang asked her with raised eyebrows.
"No."
"This guy's the top performer.
Not only that, but he broke every single record held by the Ironwoman."
"What?!
That's impossible!" Sergeant Bing exclaimed in disbelief before turning to stare at Yuan with wide eyes.
"Ironwoman?" Yuan inquired.
"The woman who saved you.
That's what we all call her since we don't know her actual name."
"Huh?
You don't know her name?
That's possible in the military?" Mei Xiaoyun remarked, surprised.
"It's possible to hide your identity in the military if you have enough influence," said Sergeant Bing, and she continued, "So she's definitely from a powerful family."
"And the military is fine with that?" Yuan asked.
Sergeant Quang shrugged and said, "Nobody cares as long as she does her duties as a soldier.
And it's not like nobody knows her identity.
The higher-ups are aware, and that's all that really matters."
"Anyway, are you okay?
Can you leave the infirmary yet?"
Yuan nodded.
"The nurse said I can leave whenever."
"Then we'll take you to your living quarters."
Sergeant Bing looked at Mei Xiaoyun and added, "General Mei also told us to show you your living quarters."
"Okay..."
While Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun followed Sergeant Bing and Sergeant Quang to their living quarters, Mei Feng approached a room that was guarded by two soldiers.
"General Mei, what are you doing—"
"Scram," she interrupted.
"I have some business with General Gu."
"I'm afraid that's not—"
Before the soldier could even finish his sentence, Mei Feng grabbed him by the collar and tossed him to the other end of the hallway.
"What do you think you're—?!"
The other soldier reacted instinctively and reached for her, but instantly froze when Mei Feng's gaze shifted to him.
"E-Even if you're the General, you can't be doing this..."
"And what are you going to do?
Report me to the higher-ups?
The soldier became speechless.
Suddenly, General Gu's voice resounded from inside the room.
"Let her in," he said.
Without another word, Mei Feng walked past the soldiers and entered the room.
At the other end, General Gu was calmly sitting behind his desk.
"You're here much faster than I anticipated," he calmly said.
"If you knew that I would come here, then you must also know why I am here," she said.
"I wouldn't be too sure about that."
"Let's cut the bullshit.
You tried to kill my recruit because you couldn't get your hands on him." Mei Feng narrowed her eyes at him.
"That's a serious accusation, General Mei.
Do you have any proof?
I admit my nephew went a little overboard during the match, but he believed that level of force was necessary to teach such an anomaly a lesson.
Moreover, nothing he did was against the rules, and that includes wielding Limitless."
Mei Feng sneered in disdain before responding, "You can spew all the bullshit you want, but if anything happens to my recruit, I will not just come for you, but your entire family."
A stunned look appeared on General Gu's face for a moment before he burst out laughing.
"Are you really threatening me... my family?
What can you possibly do to me with your puny little family, let alone my empire?
You may be a General, but you have no power outside of the military!"
"Is that what you truly believe?" Mei Feng chuckled.
"In that case, you know less about me than I thought.
How surprising."
The smile on General Gu's face quickly faded, replaced by a frown.

However, before he could say anything, Mei Feng continued, "You may bear the same rank as me, but you're nowhere near being my equal, General Gu—not that I need to tell you, since I'm sure you're already aware of this."
"What did you say, you fucking bitch?!" General Gu slammed his desk as he stood up in anger.
Mei Feng burst out laughing at his reaction.
"Don't tell me you actually believe you're my equal.
Without your family's influence, I doubt you would have even reached the rank of Major, let alone General!"
"Still, you're free to prove me wrong.
Instead of trying to steal my recruits, go find your own.
If your Gu Family is truly as almighty as you claim, you shouldn't have any trouble finding a few decent talents."
"That's all I have to say to you today."
With that, Mei Feng turned and walked toward the door.
Just before opening it, she added, "I won't warn you again.
If I find out you're going after Yuan again, I'll end you."
Once Mei Feng left, General Gu sat back down with a sinister expression on his face.
"There are plenty of ways to kill someone and make it appear to be an accident..." he mumbled to himself.
"I will make you regret threatening and belittling me today, Mei Feng!"
Meanwhile, Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun arrived at their living quarters.

"Normally, new recruits will live at the barracks and share rooms with several others, but as a Corporal and the top performer in the recruitment, you get to live in the same area as the Sergeants and have a building all to yourself," said Sergeant Quang.
"I'm not a Corporal, though," Mei Xiaoyun said.
"No, but you're General Mei's daughter," said Sergeant Bing.
"I never asked for special treatment." Mei Xiaoyun frowned.
Sergeant Bing shrugged.
"If you have any complaints, feel free to take them up with your mother.
She was the one who arranged your living quarters."

chapters.title: Chapter 2592 The Military's Purpose
paragraphs: Shortly after being brought to their new living quarters, Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun said goodbye to each other before entering their new home.
Since there was nothing to do, they rested for the rest of the day.
The following day, Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun were led to the classroom, where all the new soldiers would spend the next several days learning about the military's purpose.
"You know that monster who fought with a Captain during the recruitment? I heard that he received a special promotion to the rank of Corporal for his performance."
"Imagine starting out one right below an elite soldier... how envious."
"Not just that, but he doesn't even have to participate in the training that we all must."
"Did you not see how he performed during the recruitment? A prodigy like that doesn't need training and deserves whatever special treatment they throw at him!"

The soldiers in the room had been discussing Yuan long before he arrived. The moment he entered, however, their conversations ceased as they stared at him in silence, their gazes filled with awe and, in some cases, envy.
Yet despite their curiosity and desire to approach him, no one dared to do so, mainly because of the two elite soldiers standing nearby and Mei Xiaoyun's presence.
"So that's the General's daughter... I wonder what their relationship is."
"I was told that it was her mother who found and recruited him."
"And who gave you that information?"
"My father... who is also a Captain."
Some time later, the class instructor entered the room and introduced himself, "I am Sergeant Mu, and I will be your instructor for the next several days."
'Xi Murong...' Yuan thought to himself as he recognized the instructor's face.
By now, he'd met pretty much everyone in the Demon Sealing Faction with one exception.
"Before we talk about the military's purpose and your responsibilities as a soldier, let's talk about the history of the military."
"The military was created 2,000 years ago by a certain individual."
Yuan raised an eyebrow when he heard this information.
'Huh? The military is only 2,000 years old? That can't be right...
After all, it seemed too young for such an advanced civilization.
"Does anyone know who created the military?" Sergeant Mu proceeded to question them.
Immediately, half of the room raised their hands.
When one of them was called upon, they answered, "Gaia!"
Yuan turned around to look at the one who'd just spoken with widen eyes.
'Gaia created the military?!' he cried inwardly.
Yuan almost didn't believe his ears. He could've never anticipated that, besides the system, Gaia would also be responsible for the creation of the military.
"Correct. Gaia created not only the system that shaped our society today, but also the military," Sergeant Mu said.
"Now then... who is Gaia?"
Yuan's ears immediately perked at this question, as he'd been wondering about Gaia's identity ever since he learned of their existence.
Fewer people raised their hands this time, but there were still quite a few who knew the answer, which was much more than Yuan anticipated.
'I thought information on Gaia was top secret...' he sighed inwardly.
Unbeknownst to him, the people with their hands raised were already connected to the military one way or another before they joined, so they possessed information that ordinary civilians did not.
"You."
Sergeant Mu pointed at one of the soldiers at random.
"Gaia is the Prophet!" the soldier said in full confidence of their answer.
'A Prophet...?' Yuan rubbed his eyes, immediately recalling how the first Celestial Emperor used the same tactics to take control of the world.
"Indeed, Gaia is known as the Prophet." Sergeant Mu confirmed.
No longer able to remain silent, Yuan raised his hand and said, "I have a question."
"You are..." Sergeant Mu narrowed his eyes at Yuan.
"Corporal Yuan, correct? I've heard a lot about you. I usually don't accept questions until the next, but go ahead.
"What does it mean to be the Prophet? Does Gaia speak with 'God' and relay their message to us?" he asked.
"God?" Sergeant Mu raised his eyebrows, looking entertained by Yuan's question.
"What is a God?"
Rather than Sergeant Mu, someone else in the room asked aloud.
'Does the concept of God not exist in this world or something?' Yuan wondered to himself.
Sergeant Mu then said, "I don't know what you mean by 'God', but as the Prophet, Gaia has the ability to speak to the universe."
"The universe...? Can you elaborate?" Yuan asked, looking puzzled by the response.
"Unfortunately, I cannot." Sergeant Mu shook his head.
"There are many things that even I'm not privy to. If you wish to learn more, you'll have to climb the ranks and earn the necessary credentials."
"Anyway, let's move on to the next subject—the purpose of the military."

After taking a deep breath, Sergeant Mu spoke with a solemn expression. "I'm sure some of you are already aware of this, but the military's purpose is to protect this world and its inhabitants. In other words, us."
The soldiers immediately began mumbling to each other, and it didn't take long before someone remarked out loud, "But that implies our world is in danger..."
"It's not an implication. Our world is not safe. We are not safe."
"What is threatening us?" someone quickly asked.
"Instead of just telling you, I want all of you to experience it yourself in the near future," said Sergeant Mu.
"With that being said, we're not in imminent danger. In fact, it might not even happen in our lifetime."
Yuan raised his eyebrows at Sergeant Mu's words, which implied the military was preparing for something in the distant future.
"Now then, let's go over the military structure, starting with the ranks," Sergeant Mu continued calmly, as if he hadn't just dropped a massive bomb on everyone.

"From lowest to highest, the standard ranks begin with Private, which is where everyone here starts—with the exception of Corporal Yuan. After that come Private First Class, Corporal, and finally Sergeant, the highest standard rank."

chapters.title: Chapter 2593 Ninth Division
paragraphs: "Above Sergeant are Captain, Major, Colonel, and General. However, for most soldiers, Sergeant is the highest rank they can attain. The ranks above it belong to a separate class of military personnel that requires more than just time and merits to reach," Sergeant Mu continued.
"Now let's talk about the military's organizational structure. It consists of nine main Divisions, each made up of its own Battalions, Companies, Platoons, and Squads."

"Each Division has its own mission and area of expertise. For example, the First Division is combat-oriented, while the Second Division specializes in support. The Third Division focuses on logistics, and the Fourth Division specializes in intelligence gathering."

"The Fifth through Eighth Divisions follow a similar structure, with the Fifth Division being combat-oriented, the Sixth specializing in support, and so on. In case you weren't already aware, General Mei commands the First through Fourth Divisions, while General Gu oversees the latter four."
"Even though we're technically part of the same military, it often feels as though we're divided into two factions, with both sides constantly competing against each other."
After a brief pause, Sergeant Mu added, "I probably shouldn't be telling you this, but you'll all find out eventually, so..."
A soldier suddenly raised their hands.
"What is it?"
"Sergeant, what about the Ninth Division? If General Mei commands the First through Fourth and General Gu oversees the Fifth through Eighth, then who commands the Ninth?"
"That would be the Supreme General, the highest-ranking soldier in the military."
"Who is the Supreme General?"
Sergeant Mu shrugged.
"No clue. Only those in the Ninth Division and the higher-ups know the Supreme General's identity."
"Then how does one join the Ninth Division?"
"You don't." Sergeant Mu shook his head. "You can apply to join any Division from the First to the Eighth after your year-long training, but the Ninth Division is by invitation only."
"Is it possible to be rejected by a Division?" Someone then asked.
"Of course, but such cases are rare."
"What happens if you're rejected from all Divisions?"
"I would like to know too, since it has never happened before."
Some time later—

"Let's talk about your year-long training, or what we call boot camp. Everyone here—except Corporal Yuan, once again—will be required to partake in training at the end of the classes. During the training, you will be taught how to fight properly, as well as other skills you will require to flourish in the military."
Sergeant Mu proceeded to spend the next two hours talking about the training and what they can expect.
"Alright, that will be all for today's classes. We will resume class tomorrow at the same time. You are all dismissed."
Sergeant Mu left the classroom immediately after dismissing them, and the soldiers swiftly left, returning to their living quarters since they were still not allowed to roam the military base.
As Yuan followed Sergeant Bing and Sergeant Quang back to his living quarters, he asked them, "When will we learn about the sirens and the reason why everyone has to enter the underground?"
"You won't learn about that until after boot camp," said Sergeant Quang. "However, since you won't be participating in that and are already a Corporal, you will learn about it after the ceremony."
"I don't get it." Yuan suddenly said.
"What do you mean?"
"Why is the military so restrictive with information? If the world is truly in danger, what's the point of keeping everyone in the dark?"
Sergeant Bing shrugged, "Don't ask me. I am merely following the rules."
Yuan narrowed his eyes.
'Something feels off about this...' he thought.
'Why are they withholding such important information? I could understand keeping civilians in the dark to prevent mass panic, but why hide it from their own soldiers as well?'
'No... what if they have no choice but to hide it? If the information is dangerous, then everything makes sense!'
A look of realization appeared on Yuan's face.
'There is a good chance that this information is related to Eternals, and the reason they're not revealing it to everyone is that doing so would harm them!'
Since he experienced first-hand what it was like to learn about Eternals, Yuan understood the military's decision to hide such information from everyone.
'Looks like I have no choice but to climb the ranks if I want to learn more...' he sighed inwardly.
The next day, Yuan returned to the classroom.
"Today, we'll discuss the rules—rules that every soldier must follow, regardless of rank," Sergeant Mu said.
"There are many, but the most important one to remember is that all information concerning the military is strictly classified and must never be shared with civilians."

"I'm aware that some of you come from military families and may have heard certain things from your relatives, but most of that is already public knowledge. The information I'm referring to is what you'll learn during training and after becoming full-fledged soldiers."
"If you're caught sharing classified information, the punishment can be death, so keep that in mind."
For the next several hours, Sergeant Mu would go over many rules of the military, including the unspoken ones.
"That's all for today. Tomorrow, we will talk about the base and its facilities."
After Sergeant Mu left, the soldiers immediately started complaining to each other.
"Man, these classes are so boring. I'd rather we just start training immediately."
"If you knew what boot camp would be like, you wouldn't be uttering such foolish words."
"What is it like? Tell me."
"And spoil the fun? Nah."
Time continued to pass, and several days of classes later—
"That concludes your classroom instruction," said Sergeant Mu at the end of class. "Tomorrow, you will all begin boot camp. If you have any questions, you can ask the instructors there."
He then turned to look at Yuan and Mei Xiaoyun and said, "Corporal Yuan. Private Mei. General Mei has called for you two. Head to her office after this."
"Yes, Sergeant."
Some time later, Sergeant Bing and Sergeant Quang escorted them to General Mei's office.
